title: Emergency Tech
description:
Job Summary

As an Emergency Department team member at Corewell Health, you'll play a vital role in providing top-quality care to our patients. Under the supervision of an RN, you'll perform delegated patient care tasks and be expected to meet all established competencies. You'll be a vital part of our team, making a real difference in the lives of our patients and their families.


Essential Functions

  • Performs routine bedside nursing activities including ambulating, moving and turning patients, assisting patients with bedpans or urinary devices, making patient beds. Responsible for bagging and labeling all patient belongings and completing the patient property record on all admitted patients.
  • Performs higher level of patient care tasks as prescribed by established competencies, and as delegated by the supervising professional Registered Nurse in accordance with departmental policies and procedures which includes starting saline locks, simple suture removal (excluding face or complex lacerations) splinting, phlebotomy which includes (children draws over the age of 2), vital sign measurement, records intake and output and restraint application.
  • Reinforces the patient teaching plan by providing clarification, explanation and/or demonstration to patients/substitute decision-makers regarding treatments, procedures and aftercare.
  • Applies and changes sterile and non-sterile dressing using appropriate techniques. Applies ace bandage or elastic stockings as required. Assists in performing catheterizations, gives enemas, urine and stool testing, glucometer and EKG functions.
  • Gathers subjective and objective patient care data; gathers information from primary and secondary source such as direct observation/measurement, patient/significant other interviews, and the medical record.
  • Documents accurate, complete and precise patient information, interventions and responses in the patient’s medical record. Performs discharge function under the direct supervision of the Registered Nurse.
  • Performs technical skills such as (not all inclusive): collecting blood samples, obtaining vital signs, performing ECG’s, sets up and assists with wound care, sets up and assist with pelvic exams; and assisting with procedures as directed by the nurse and physician.
  • Utilizes and understands sterile technique.
  • Effectively communicates with patients / significant others and other members of the health care team supporting patient and family centered care.
  • Stocks and maintains adequate equipment and supplies in the patient care areas. Ensures vehicle and equipment are ready for response at all times.
  • Performs safe movement/transporting of patients; removes waste materials, sanitizing tools, delivers meals to patients.
  • Completes documentation and records according to department policy.
  • Demonstrates a high degree of professional conduct.
  • Attends all required Safety Training programs and can describe his/her responsibilities related to general safety.
  • Follows the Hospital Exposure Control Plans/Bloodborne and Airborne Pathogens.
  • Demonstrates respect and regard for the dignity of all patients, families, visitors and fellow employees to ensure a professional, responsible and courteous environment.
  • Promotes effective working relations and works effectively as part of a department team inter- and intra-departmentally to facilitate the department's ability to meet its goals and objectives.

Qualifications

Required

  • High School Diploma or equivalent.
  • 6 months of relevant experience Requires a minimum six months' exhibited performance as a nursing assistant or other inpatient caregiver experience, paramedic, EMT, urgent care caregiver experience or a Nursing Student (preferred completion of a Medical Surgical rotation).
  • CRT-Basic Life Support (BLS) - AHA American Heart Association or
  • CRT-Basic Life Support (BLS) - ARC American Red Cross.

Preferred

  • LIC-Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) - STATE_MI State of Michigan.

We are committed to cultivating and investing in YOU. Capital One, a Fortune 500 company and one of the nation’s top 10 banks, offers a broad spectrum of financial products and services to consumers, small businesses and commercial clients. Our goal is to create one of the nation’s great banks, and we have the necessary ingredients: a strong balance sheet, resilient businesses, a massive customer franchise, strong analytical capabilities, and great people. We nurture a work environment where people with a variety of thoughts, ideas and backgrounds, guided by our shared values, come together to make Capital One a great company – and a great place to work.


As a Manager, Project Manager at Capital One in the Partnerships Tech and Operations team, you will drive strategy and execute on high priority projects for the company. You will be responsible for engaging with leaders across U.S. Card and supporting Lines of Business, as well as leaders from our external partners, to develop, drive, and deliver both technical and operational intent while maintaining the highest levels of well-managed excellence. This is a highly collaborative role spanning project, process, and relationship management. Relationship Management

  • Champion the client perspective internally and Capital One externally by building trusted, deep relationships with key stakeholders at all levels to manage, inform and influence outcomes.

Process Management

description:

Wuxi,CHN

As a Field Service Engineer [Customer Engineer] at Applied Materials, you serve as the direct liaison with customers, collaborating closely to install, maintain, and upgrade equipment. Your responsibilities include performing preventative and corrective maintenance on various systems such as electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems. title: 2027 Summer Intern – Research and Development - Power Electronics & Energy Conversion Systems
location: Pontiac, Michigan, United States of America
description:
Job Description

The Role:

Research and Development Intern – Power Electronics & Energy Conversion Systems


As a Research and Development Intern within the Power Electronics & Energy Conversion Systems group, you will support advanced research in power conversion, electric-drive systems, power modules, energy-conversion architectures, and related electrification technologies within GM’s Energy and Propulsion Systems Research organization.


Depending on your background, interests, and project needs, your work may include concept generation, circuit and system analysis, modeling and simulation, proof-of-concept design, hardware build, laboratory testing, troubleshooting, data analysis, and technical documentation.

Potential research areas include embedded PCB power modules,

multilevel inverters, next-generation power semiconductors, gate-drive systems, vehicle inverter and motor-system optimization, multifunctional or multiplexed power electronics, low-voltage vehicle-system cost reduction, onboard chargers, auxiliary DC-DC converters, electromagnetic-interference measurement and mitigation, and advanced power-conversion architectures.


The Team:

The Power Electronics & Energy Conversion Systems group within Energy and Propulsion Systems Research conducts advanced research in vehicle power conversion, inverter architectures, power modules, gate drives, electric machines, charging systems, and related electrification technologies.


The team connects laboratory research, analytical modeling, simulation, prototype hardware, and experimental validation to support future GM electric, hybrid, and propulsion applications. You will work with experienced researchers and cross-functional partners in a collaborative environment focused on improving efficiency, power density, performance, reliability, cost, thermal behavior, and system integration.


What You’ll Do:

  • Support research and development projects involving power electronics, energy conversion, electric drives, charging, and vehicle electrification.
  • Contribute to concept generation and technical evaluation of circuits, converters, inverters, power modules, gate drives, semiconductors, control methods, and system architectures.
  • Perform electrical, thermal, electromagnetic, loss, efficiency, reliability, and performance analyses as appropriate to the assignment.
  • Develop or use engineering models and simulations to evaluate switching behavior, power flow, losses, thermal performance, control response, electromagnetic effects, and system-level tradeoffs.
  • Assist with the design and evaluation of prototype hardware, including schematics, printed circuit boards, gate-drive circuits, power stages, sensors, measurement interfaces, and supporting components.
  • Support laboratory hardware checkout, bring-up, instrumentation, data acquisition, and controlled testing under appropriate supervision.
  • Help plan and execute bench, hardware-in-the-loop, dynamometer, or other laboratory experiments as appropriate to the project.
  • Collect, organize, process, and analyze electrical, thermal, mechanical, and control-system data.
  • Investigate unexpected results, troubleshoot hardware or software issues, identify root causes, and recommend corrective actions or design improvements.
  • Support testing and analysis of emerging semiconductor technologies or other advanced devices, as applicable to the project.
  • Assist with inverter, motor-drive, onboard-charger, auxiliary DC-DC converter, low-voltage power-conversion, multifunctional power-electronics, or EMI research as assigned.
  • Create or update engineering documentation, including schematics, calculations, simulation models, bills of materials, test plans, test procedures, laboratory records, technical reports, and presentations.
  • Maintain accurate records of assumptions, design decisions, test conditions, measurements, results, failures, and conclusions while following applicable laboratory and safety requirements.
  • Collaborate with researchers and cross-functional partners, communicate progress clearly, share technical learnings, and present project findings and recommendations.

Required Qualifications:

  • Currently pursuing a Master’s or Ph.D. degree in electrical engineering, power electronics, power systems, energy conversion, control systems, mechatronics, electromagnetics, or a related science or engineering field.
  • Able to work full-time, 40 hours per week, for the duration of the summer internship.
  • Willing to work in a laboratory and engineering test environment and follow applicable safety requirements.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Coursework, research, or project experience in power electronics, power semiconductor devices, electric machines, motor drives, converters, inverters, power systems, circuit design, control systems, electromagnetics, or thermal management.
  • Experience with multilevel inverter topologies, resonant or high-frequency conversion, gate-drive design, PCB layout, power-module design, or switching-device characterization.
  • Familiarity with SiC, GaN, MOSFET, IGBT, hybrid-switch, or other power-semiconductor technologies.
  • Experience with MATLAB/Simulink, PLECS, LTspice, PSIM, ANSYS, COMSOL, or comparable engineering-analysis and simulation tools.
  • Experience with Python, C/C++, embedded controllers, FPGA or microcontroller platforms, data acquisition, or automated test systems.
  • Familiarity with oscilloscopes, power analyzers, current and voltage probes, thermal cameras, electronic loads, dynamometers, impedance analyzers, or other laboratory instrumentation.
  • Understanding of switching losses, conduction losses, parasitics, dead time, modulation, control-loop design, thermal limits, EMI/EMC, magnetic components, and power-device protection.
  • Experience designing experiments, analyzing measurements, correlating simulation with test results, or performing uncertainty and error analysis.
  • Ability to read technical papers, patents, schematics, datasheets, and engineering specifications.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, written, and verbal communication skills; ability to work safely, maintain organized laboratory records, and collaborate effectively with researchers and cross-functional engineering teams.

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:

You will lead major projects, mentor engineering teams, and drive innovation to achieve superior software performance.

As SNC's corporate team, we provide the company and its business areas with strategic direction and business support spanning executive management, finance and accounting, operations, human resources, legal, IT, information security, facilities, marketing, and communications.

title: Director, Product & Technology Partnerships
description:
Why Join Us


Be part of an organization that’s driving change and consistently recognized as a top employer. At Deluxe, we know that great people build great companies—and we invest in you accordingly.


  • We’re proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work and a top workplace for Moms, Dads, LGBTQ+ employees, and Veterans.
  • We offer competitive benefits starting on day one, designed to support your life both in and out of work.
  • 42% of our employees have stayed for 10+ years, citing our people, benefits, work-life balance, inclusive culture, and team support as key reasons why.

The Director, Product & Technology Partnerships is responsible for developing and scaling the technology partner ecosystem for Deluxe Merchant Services. As part of the Product organization, this role establishes strategic relationships with POS providers, payment gateways, terminal and hardware manufacturers, and software platforms to expand the capabilities and reach of Deluxe's payment solutions.


Serving as both a strategic partnership leader and technical advisor, the Director helps partners understand and integrate with the Deluxe payments platform, translates partner needs into actionable requirements, and collaborates with Product and Engineering to enable successful integrations. The role also establishes scalable processes for partner certification, onboarding, and ongoing enablement while identifying opportunities to address market needs, support evolving platform capabilities, and drive business growth.


What You'll Do:

This impactful position will play a key role in our product and growth strategy, focusing on the following responsibilities:

  • Develop and expand the technology partner ecosystem. Identify, evaluate, and establish strategic relationships with VARs, POS providers, payment gateways, terminal and hardware manufacturers, and software platforms. Prioritize opportunities that extend Deluxe's product capabilities, address market needs, and enable new avenues for business growth.
  • Lead technical partnership engagement and integration strategy. Serve as a technical and strategic point of contact for partners, advising on payment integration models, APIs, gateways, terminal connectivity, certifications, and platform capabilities. Lead technical discovery and solution discussions, translating partner requirements into actionable recommendations for Product and Engineering.
  • Establish scalable partner integration and enablement processes. Collaborate with Product and Engineering to define and support certification requirements, partner onboarding, and integration standards. Maintain visibility into partner capabilities, integration models, certification status, and technical documentation to support effective partner engagement and ongoing platform compatibility.
  • Support product strategy and platform expansion. Partner with Product leadership to identify opportunities where third-party technologies and partnerships can expand Deluxe's capabilities, accelerate time to market, or address gaps in the product portfolio. Evaluate partners based on technical fit, market demand, strategic value, and their ability to support both current and evolving platform capabilities.
  • Drive cross-functional alignment and business impact. Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Sales, and other stakeholders to align partnership initiatives with business priorities. Support the commercialization and adoption of partner-enabled solutions, ensuring partnerships deliver meaningful customer value, operational scalability, and sustainable revenue opportunities.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in payments, fintech, merchant services, technology partnerships, or integrated payment solutions.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and managing technology partnerships, VAR relationships, or payment integration initiatives.
  • Strong technical understanding of payment technologies, including payment gateways, APIs, POS integrations, and payment processing platforms.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working with POS providers, payment terminal manufacturers, payment gateways, or ISV ecosystems within the merchant acquiring industry.
  • Experience guiding technical integration discussions, certification processes, and partner onboarding without direct software development responsibilities.
  • Ability to evaluate technology partnerships from both a technical and business perspective, translating integration opportunities into product capabilities and commercial value.
  • Strong cross-functional communication and relationship management skills, with experience working across Product, Engineering, and Commercial teams.

Benefits

In line with our commitment to employee wellbeing, our total rewards benefits package is designed to support the physical, financial, and emotional health of our employees, tailored to meet their unique and evolving needs. Our approach considers our employees’ whole selves, ensuring they can thrive both in and outside of work. Here are some of the benefits we offer, which may vary based on role, location, or hours worked:

  • Healthcare (Medical, Dental, Vision)

  • Problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

title: Analyst II, Credit Risk
description:
9002 - Carmax Auto Finance - 225 Chastain Meadows Ct NW, Kennesaw, Georgia, 30144

CarMax, the way your career should be!

Position Overview


As an Analyst II, Credit Risk, you will play a critical role in shaping CarMax Auto Finance’s credit strategies and driving operational excellence. In this dynamic position, you’ll leverage advanced data analytics, statistical modeling, and database tools to analyze, test, and implement credit product strategies that enhance both business performance and customer experience. Your insights will help optimize credit processes, improve originations, and deliver actionable recommendations to senior leadership. You’ll also design and maintain reporting dashboards for key metrics such as originations, bookings, and sales trends, ensuring timely and accurate updates for decision-making. This role demands a strong commitment to compliance and operational risk controls, aligning with CarMax’s reputation for integrity and transparency.


Why CarMax?


At CarMax, we are the nation’s largest retailer of used cars with stores from coast to coast, and we are still growing. We’re rethinking the way people buy cars – and it’s our associates that help us do just that. We believe work should feel meaningful and rewarding, with opportunities to make an impact every day. This is where innovation meets passion – be inspired and supported to take us to the future.


Team Overview


Our success is powered by a customer-focused, data-driven approach and a culture that values collaboration and innovation. As part of the Credit Risk team, you’ll work in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment where your analytical expertise will help develop strategies that keep CarMax Auto Finance ahead of industry trends. We value independent thinkers who are passionate about problem-solving and committed to doing what’s right for both the business and our customers.


Role Responsibilities


  • Analyze, test, and implement credit product strategies using statistical and database tools to improve performance.
  • Identify opportunities to optimize credit and originations processes, enhancing value for both the business and customers.
  • Design and maintain reporting dashboards for metrics such as originations, bookings, and sales trends.
  • Deliver insights and updates to senior leadership, supporting strategic decision-making.
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory standards and operational risk controls, maintaining CarMax’s commitment to integrity.

Required Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree required.
  • 0–3 years of experience in an analytical role.
  • Strong ability to access, manipulate, and interpret data using analytical tools.
  • Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and general software applications.
  • Strong communication skills

Preferred Qualifications


  • Degree in an analytical or mathematical discipline.
  • Experience with database systems and programming tools (e.g., SQL, Python).

Work Authorization:

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Sponsorship will not be considered for this specific role.


Work Location:

Associates will have the opportunity to work from our CarMax Auto Finance Office in Kennesaw, GA and associates will work onsite 4 days per week.


About CarMax


At CarMax, we revolutionized the used car buying experience over 30 years ago by introducing transparency and integrity into the process. Our commitment to customer experience, innovation, and community has made us the nation’s largest used car retailer. With over 250 store locations and over 30,000 associates, we are proud to have been recognized as one of the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For® and are committed to helping our communities thrive.


As an associate, you are part of an innovative movement to empower the modern customer and drive progress. Your work fuels change—sparking ideas, overcoming challenges, and shaping what’s next. Join us in creating a better future– for our company, our customers, and the communities we call home.


CarMax is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

$70,200.00 - $105,300.00

Associates that are considered full-time hourly or commission/incentive eligible:

  • To earn up to 48 hours of sick time per year accrued on a per pay period basis and between 80 hours and 200 hours per year of vacation time after a 90 day waiting period depending on years of continuous service with the Company.
  • For 8 hours of pay for each of a total of 6 paid scheduled holidays per year plus 1 floating holiday. If such an Associate does work on a scheduled holiday due to business need, they are eligible for Holiday Premium Pay.

description:
Ready to elevate your career? GESI is expanding! We are officially hunting for our next Operations Integration Specialist to support Operations in Canada & USA—someone ready to bring fresh ideas and grow alongside a dynamic team.


About Us
GFL Environmental Services Inc. ("GESI") is a high-growth environmental services company recently carved out of GFL Environmental Inc. Backed by leading private equity firms, GESI delivers liquid waste, industrial cleaning, and soil remediation services across North America through a vertically integrated platform of over 230 sites and a fleet of 1,800+ vehicles. Our employees, collectively known as 'Team Green,' enjoy numerous benefits: career advancement opportunities, competitive benefits, job stability within an essential services company, and the chance to make a positive impact every day for our customers and communities, Green for Life!


The Role
We are looking for a strategic and empathetic Operations Integration Specialist to lead the transition experience for our newly acquired companies. In this role, you will be the "bridge" that connects new teams to GFL Environmental Services culture, systems, and processes.


You will not just be managing checklists; you will be designing the "Day 1" experience and beyond. Your primary focus will be creating seamless training curriculums and onboarding journeys that allow acquired employees to feel welcome, informed, and productive immediately after a deal closes.


Key Responsibilities


1. Integration Strategy & Planning

  • Playbook Development: Build and maintain a scalable "Acquisition Onboarding Playbook" that can be adapted for deals of different sizes (e.g., acquisition-hires vs. large mergers).
  • Due Diligence Support: Partner with the M&A team during the due diligence phase to assess the target company’s current tools, culture, and skill gaps to prepare a readiness plan.
  • Timeline Management: Create detailed project plans for "Day 1" (Close Date) through "Day 90," ensuring all training milestones are met without disrupting business continuity.

2. Training & Systems Migration

  • Gap Analysis: Conduct rapid needs assessments to identify the gap between the acquired team’s current skills and GFL’s tech stack/processes.
  • Curriculum Design: Collaborate with functional leads (Sales, Operations, Finance) to design role-specific training
  • Delivery: Facilitate or coordinate live training sessions, webinars, and self-paced e-learning to ensure rapid adoption of our internal tools.

3. Onboarding & Cultural Immersion

  • Cultural Harmonization: Act as a culture ambassador, helping acquired employees understand GFL’s values while respecting and celebrating the heritage of their original company.
  • Buddy Programs: Implement mentorship/buddy systems connecting acquired employees with long-tenured staff to foster organic networking.

4. Change Management & Communication

  • Feedback Loops: Conduct pulse surveys and listening tours 30, 60, and 90 days post-acquisition to identify friction points and adjust the integration strategy accordingly.
  • Retention Focus: Identify key talent within acquired groups and ensure they receive "white glove" onboarding support to mitigate attrition risks.

What We’re Looking For (Qualifications)


Required Experience


  • 5+ years of experience in Organization Development, L&D (Learning & Development), M&A Integration, or Project Management.
  • Proven track record of managing complex projects with multiple stakeholders.
  • Experience designing training materials or onboarding workflows for diverse audiences.

Preferred Experience


  • Direct experience working on Post-Merger Integration (PMI) teams.
  • Experience in Waste Management, Project Management, Skills & Competencies
  • High EQ & Empathy: Ability to navigate the anxiety and uncertainty that acquired employees often feel.
  • Strategic Agility: Capable of switching between high-level strategy (planning the roadmap) and tactical execution (hosting a training session).
  • Data-Driven: Ability to define KPIs for integration success (e.g., "Order to Cash," "System Adoption Rates").
  • Travel expectations 50 to 80 percent



What We Offer

Why join us? We believe in taking care of our team. Here is a snapshot of our total rewards you can expect:

● Health: 4 medical plan options including a HSA with employer contribution & match program, dental, and vision coverage.

● Wellness:Employee Assistance Program with free counseling services, Paid time off

● Financial: 401(k) with an employer match and competitive wages

● Culture: Growth opportunities and continuous learning opportunities

Job Description:

What’s the role

Shell is seeking a Refinery Products Blend Scheduler to join its team in Sarnia.

Shell’s business model requires the ability to quickly respond to changing market conditions and production capabilities to deliver the most value. The Refinery Products Blend Schedulers lead blending and scheduling activity for all distillate products (Diesels, Jet Fuel) and gasoline (regular and premium) for the Sarnia asset.

As a Refinery Products Blend Scheduler at Sarnia, you are a key member of the Refinery Asset Optimization team, working closely with the Refinery Process Unit Scheduler, Refinery Economists, Operations and Commercial Products Trading and Supply. You lead blending and scheduling activity for the integrated Sarnia site, ensuring alignment with business objectives to capture market opportunities.

What you’ll be doing

  • Blending products (gasoline) for the Sarnia Refinery.
  • Interfacing with Calgary commercial Trading & Supply pipeline, truck, rail and marine schedulers, and other Trading & Supply personnel, to manage product supply to customers. This includes managing inventory at the Sarnia Refinery.
  • Tracking and optimizing product quality giveaway across the product portfolio, and leverage Sarnia operations personnel to ensure products meet specifications.
  • Issuing daily operating instructions to hourly production workforce indicating how the various blending systems are to be operated
  • Providing off-hours support for gasoline blending and oil movement operations (tank farm operators) as needed on a rotational basis.
  • Coordinating seasonal product recipes with commercial Trading & Supply schedulers to ensure successful blend-up and blend-down is achieved for gasoline products across the supply chain, while minimizing giveaway.
  • Validating blend recipes produced by the linear program (LP) model and translating the monthly operating plan (MOP) into a detailed schedule to provide clear direction for Operations. Close coordination with the Refinery Process Unit Scheduler is required to ensure processing unit operations are optimized.
  • Providing key inputs for internal and external financial and production benchmarking and mandated reporting including but not limited to margin variance analysis (MVA).
  • Providing basic vacation coverage to the other scheduler and blender roles within the Refinery Asset Optimization team.
  • Leading continuous improvement projects in scheduling and blending, including but not limited to leveraging automation and digital technologies.
  • Coordinating with the other schedulers and blenders (and Economic Model Coordinators) needed improvements to the scheduling model to sustain useability of the tool and incorporate any automation and best-practices promptly.

The individual should be able to work as part of a multi-disciplinary team in an ever-changing and fast-paced environment. As the Refinery Asset Optimization department assists Production, extended coverage outside of standard working hours may be required based on business need. Must also be an effective communicator, build strong relationships with the key process performers (Production and Technology), and be able to influence without formal authority.


What you bring

  • The candidate must have legal authorization to work in Canada on a full-time basis
  • Undergraduate degree in Science, Engineering or Business and/or 3 or more years of relevant experience
  • Basic understanding of Refinery/Chemical economics and supply chain
  • Knowledge of production specifications and product quality reporting process an asset

title: Activation Executive, On Trade, Costa Rica
description:
Job Description :

About us:

With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations.

Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other.

Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.


About the role:

Activation Executive

1. Role Identification

Field Input

Details

Role Title

Activation Executive

Band Level

L6 - To be completed by HR

Reports To

Activation Manager / Commercial Head

Function / Pillar

Sales Customer Marketing

Channel / Scope

On Trade / Off Trade / Traditional Trade - specify channel in each role assignment

Blueprint Role Family

Activation Volume Channels

2. Purpose of the Role

This role exists to translate approved commercial priorities into brilliant, customer-centric execution across the assigned channel and geography. The Activation Executive is the field execution specialist closest to customers, outlets and distributor teams, responsible for ensuring activations are delivered on time, in full and to agreed quality standards while creating measurable value for customers, shoppers, consumers and Diageo.

The role is expected to spend approximately 70% of its time in market visiting customers, supervising activations, coaching distributor and agency teams, and identifying opportunities to improve visibility, shopper conversion, customer experience and Rate of Sale (ROS). The remaining time is dedicated to execution planning, day-to-day budget stewardship, agency coordination, Measurement & Evaluation and converting field observations into actionable recommendations for the Activation Manager, Commercial Planning Manager and Channel Managers.

Success in this role is defined by consistent execution excellence, strong customer intimacy, disciplined management of approved activation investment, effective agency leadership and the ability to continuously improve future plans through execution intelligence, for ON Trade and RTDs Segment.

3. Market Context

CCV is one of Diageo's most diverse and dynamic regions, spanning more than 30 countries across Central America, the Caribbean and Venezuela. Our business connects multiple cultures, languages, customer landscapes and routes to market, working through a broad network of distributor partners. This complexity creates a fast-moving environment where local insight, collaboration and adaptability are essential to unlock sustainable growth.

4. Decision Making

Decision Area

What the role decides / recommends

Boundaries, support or escalation

Day-to-day execution priorities

Prioritizes approved activation activities, outlet visits, field follow-up and agency deployment within the assigned channel and geography.

Works within approved commercial plans, activation briefs, budget guardrails and Activation Manager direction. Escalates material changes to scope, timing or investment.

Field corrective actions

Takes immediate action to resolve execution gaps relating to visibility, materials, timing, agency delivery, outlet readiness or distributor coordination.

Escalates structural customer, supply, contractual or investment issues that cannot be resolved within agreed authority.

Opportunity identification

Recommends customer, shopper and execution opportunities based on market visits, competitive observation and customer feedback.

Recommendations must align with market strategy and are brought to the Activation Manager, Commercial Planning Manager and relevant Channel Manager for prioritization.

Agency and budget management

Coordinates day-to-day agency work, validates execution against scope and monitors approved activation spending, estimates, purchase orders and claims.

Operates within approved supplier contracts, procurement processes and financial controls. Escalates forecast overruns or scope changes.

Execution learning

Recommends practical improvements to activation mechanics, field routines and customer execution based on M&E and market intelligence.

Strategic changes to channel plans or resource allocation require manager and cross-functional approval.

5. Functional & Leadership Responsibilities

· Spend approximately 70% of time in market, maintaining close proximity to customers, outlets, shoppers and distributor field teams to supervise activations, verify execution standards and strengthen customer relationships.

· Deliver approved channel activation plans with discipline, ensuring visibility materials, branded execution assets, promotional mechanics and activation tools are deployed on time, in full and to the required quality.

· Develop customer intimacy by understanding outlet needs, execution challenges and growth opportunities, ensuring activation delivery that creates value for the customer while supporting Diageo market strategy and ROS growth.

· Proactively identify opportunities to improve image, presence, visibility, shopper conversion, distribution or outlet experience and bring structured recommendations to the Activation Manager, Commercial Planning Manager and Channel Managers.

· Manage activation agencies and execution partners on a day-to-day basis, setting priorities, supervising in-market delivery, resolving operational issues and providing clear performance feedback.

· Own day-to-day management of approved activation budgets, including spend tracking, estimates, purchase orders, execution costs, claims support and identification of productivity opportunities.

· Coach distributor field teams and agency personnel on execution standards, customer requirements and activation quality, reinforcing consistent ways of working across the assigned channel.

· Capture customer feedback, shopper observations, competitor activity and recurring execution barriers, converting these into execution intelligence that improves future commercial plans.

· Support post-Measurement & Evaluation by documenting execution quality, commercial outcomes, customer response and practical learnings for scale, stop or improve decisions.

· Ensure all activities comply with Diageo policies, brand standards, responsible marketing requirements, procurement processes and financial controls.

6. Key Outputs / Deliverables

· Channel Activation Execution Tracker and Outlet Visit Plan

· Customer-Centric Execution and Visibility Scorecards

· Activation Opportunity and Market Intelligence Pipeline

· Agency Deployment Plan and Performance Feedback

· Day-to-Day Activation Budget, Purchase Order and Claims Tracker

· Execution Issue and Corrective Action Log

· Measurement & Evaluation Inputs and Continuous Improvement Recommendations

· Distributor and Agency Capability Coaching Record

7. Key Interfaces

Key Interface

Nature of Interaction

Activation Manager

Align priorities, receive coaching, escalate risks and review execution intelligence and improvement opportunities.

Commercial Planning Manager

Provide field insights, execution readiness feedback and practical recommendations for future cycle plans.

Channel Managers

Share customer, shopper and competitive insights that inform channel priorities and execution standards.

Sales / Business Development / KAN Manager

Align customer-specific priorities and coordinate outlet-level delivery without taking ownership of customer negotiations.

Customers and Outlet Teams

Build day-to-day intimacy, understand needs, supervise execution and identify mutual value opportunities.

Distributor Field Teams

Coordinate field delivery, coach execution standards and resolve operating issues.

Activation Agencies and Suppliers

Manage day-to-day deployment, quality, timing, scope and cost.

Finance, Procurement and Commercial Operations

Maintain budget, supplier, purchase order, claims and compliance discipline.

8. Experience & Required Qualifications

· Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing or related discipline, or equivalent relevant commercial experience.

· Typically, 3 or more years of experience in Sales, Activation, Trade Marketing, Customer Marketing or Commercial Execution.

· Demonstrated field execution capability and strong comfort spending approximately 70% of working time in market.

· Experience building day-to-day customer relationships and translating field observations into practical commercial recommendations.

· Experience managing agencies, suppliers and approved activation budgets, including purchase orders and claims support.

· Strong planning, organization, problem solving, communication and influencing skills.

· Ability to work effectively within distributor-led business models and across multiple external partners.

· For Traditional Trade assignments, familiarity with B2B digital commerce platforms such as BEES is desirable.



Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you, so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.

Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.

We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.

Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.

Ready to bring your best? This could be your opportunity.

If you require a reasonable adjustment, please ensure that you capture this information when you submit your application.

Recruitment Scam Warning

Protecting candidates is very important to us. All communications regarding your application will come from an email address ending in @diageo.com. In our recruitment process, we'll never ask for money.

Senior Program Manager - Project & Development Services – Americas

Summary: Join JLL’s Project & Development Services team as a Senior Program Manager, providing program-level oversight of our client’s real estate portfolio across the Americas region. In this pivotal role, you’ll act as a trusted advisor and regional point of contact for the account’s Americas stakeholders, monitoring and directing a portfolio of concurrent projects across multiple countries that are delivered day-to-day by in-country variable PM/CM resource and working closely with regional and global JLL leadership to drive efficiency, consistency, and cost savings across the portfolio. You will assume a lead role in program strategy and execution, own financial management, risk and vendor performance across the program, and lead, mentor and develop the project managers who deliver it. Technology-enabled delivery is central to this role, with JLL’s project management and AI-driven platforms – including Ingenious.Build and JLL Azara – underpinning how consistent, data-led standards are maintained across the account.


What this job involves:

· Providing program-level oversight and governance for a portfolio of concurrent projects across multiple countries throughout North, Central and South America, delivered day-to-day by in-country variable PM/CM resource.

· Assuming a lead role in developing and executing portfolio strategies, standardized processes, and reporting tools across programs, including capital plan creation and management

· Championing the adoption of JLL’s technology stack – including Ingenious.Build and AI-driven platforms such as JLL Azara – and working closely with the account’s PMO and Center of Excellence (CoE) to drive consistent global standards

· Acting as trusted advisor to the client, managing relationships and cross-functional partnerships, and leading conflict resolutions

· Overseeing portfolio performance, risk management, and delivery across the full real estate lifecycle – from site selection and design through pre-construction, construction, fit-out and closeout, including programming, entitlements, permitting, bidding, and consultant, contractor and vendor selection

· Leading, supervising, training, mentoring and evaluating project managers at various levels across a national and multi-country platform while contributing to business growth and development efforts.

· Managing performance of contracted vendors and consultants, and identifying and addressing areas of potential liability and risk (e.g., fee, JLL/NCR Atleos reputation, errors and omissions) across the program


What your day-to-day looks like:

· Directing and coordinating in-country PM/CM delivery teams across multiple countries and time zones, ensuring consistent standards and escalating issues requiring regional or client-level resolution

· Overseeing consolidated reporting on schedules, budgets, forecasts, cash flow, risks, and opportunities across the portfolio, and communicating analyzed data to the client and project teams to achieve project goals

· Reviewing procurement and financial activity conducted by in-country teams, including RFP/RFQ development, bid evaluation, contract facilitation, budgets (including hard and soft costs), monthly forecasts, cash flow analysis, anticipated cost reports and construction cost/benefit analysis, as required by the client.

· Overseeing delivery of project management fundamentals across the portfolio, including budgeting, scheduling, submittals and change orders

· Managing vendor and project team performance to ensure compliance with contractual requirements, all regulating entities and client expectations

· Leveraging JLL Azara and other AI-enabled reporting tools to surface real-time portfolio insights and support data-led decision-making across the account

· Monitoring compliance with applicable health, safety and regulatory requirements, and ensuring in-country teams maintain accurate project documentation and reporting systems (e.g., Ingenious.Build, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint)

· Communicating with executive-level and client stakeholders, and developing and cultivating relationships with existing and prospective clients, and identifying opportunities to expand services

· Providing occasional support to wider JLL and NCR Atleos requirements across other global regions (e.g., EMEA and APAC), as needed

· Collaborating with all service lines on account in the delivery of services to include Integrated Facilities Management, Transactions Management, Occupancy Planning, Lease Administration, Center of Excellence and Finance.


Required qualifications:

· Bachelor's degree in architecture, construction management, business management, finance, or related engineering field

· 7+ years of real estate, project management, or program management experience

· PMP (Project Management Professional), LEED AP certification or equivalent project management credential preferred.

· Proven experience providing program-level oversight and governance to a portfolio of concurrent projects delivered by in-country variable PM/CM resource across multiple countries throughout the Americas, rather than direct hands-on execution.

· Comprehensive knowledge of the real estate development lifecycle, approval processes and regulations, including procurement and contract management, and strong working knowledge of accounting and financial reporting, budgeting and scheduling as they relate to corporate real estate.

· Experience overseeing or directing delivery teams across multiple countries and time zones, for example across North America, Latin America, EMEA and APAC

· Previous experience supervising, training, mentoring and evaluating several project managers at various levels, and leading individuals across a national platform to deliver superior client service

· Proven ability to manage all aspects of construction projects, including budgeting, scheduling, submittals and change-orders, and to provide construction cost/benefit analysis

· Strong working knowledge of architectural drawings and furniture and space planning concepts

· Experience working with landlords, developers and institutional owners, and a solid understanding of capital plan creation and management

· Working knowledge of local and international health, safety, and regulatory compliance requirements applicable to capital projects

· Strong interpersonal, communication and organizational skills, with the ability to build relationships and earn trust, including with executive-level internal and external clients and external team members (e.g., architects, contractors and client representatives).

· Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite (including MS Project) and data analysis; highly organized with strong analytical skills, and experience leading and running numerous projects simultaneously

· Technology-literate and AI-driven, with the ability to adopt and champion JLL’s project management technology stack (e.g., Ingenious.Build) and AI-enabled platforms such as JLL Azara to drive data-led decision-making.

· Experience working within or alongside a PMO and/or Center of Excellence (CoE) structure to help embed consistent global standards and continuous improvement.

Preferred qualifications:

· Advanced degree in a relevant field

· Project Management certifications

· Experience within a regional corporate real estate portfolio

· Experience directing and coordinating flexible, in-country variable PM/CM delivery resources across a multi-country portfolio throughout the Americas.

· Knowledge of standard business and account practices, with familiarity in construction or project management technology platforms such as Ingenious.Build

· Exposure to AI-enabled real estate or construction technology platforms (e.g., JLL Azara) and an interest in applying data-led insights to project delivery.

title: Senior Manager, Executive & Internal Communications
description:
Job Description

Senior Manager, Executive & Internal Communications – Chicago, IL (Hybrid - 2-3x, as business requires)


About the Role


We are seeking a strategic, creative and highly skilled communications professional to help elevate our leaders, amplify our business strategy and celebrate our iconic brands for employees around the world.

The Senior Manager, Executive & Internal Communications will play a key role in strengthening the visibility and authenticity of our Mondelēz Leadership Team (MLT), building employee trust in our leaders and business strategy, and creating compelling stories that inspire pride in our company and love for our brands.


The ideal candidate is an exceptional writer and natural storyteller who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution. They know how to find a great story, make complex business topics accessible and bring fresh, creative thinking to how we connect with a diverse, global workforce.


This senior manager-level position reports to the Vice President, Global Internal Communications.


Key Responsibilities

Executive & Leadership Communications

  • Partner with the VP, Global Internal Communications to develop compelling communications for the CEO, COO and other senior leaders, including speeches, talking points, scripts, leadership messages and presentations.
  • Help elevate the visibility and authenticity of the Mondelēz Leadership Team (MLT), strengthening employee trust and confidence in our leaders and business strategy.
  • Build strong relationships with communications leads supporting other MLT members to identify opportunities for greater alignment, collaboration and integrated leadership storytelling.
  • Translate strategic business priorities into clear, engaging and human-centered leadership narratives that help employees understand where we are going and why it matters.
  • Develop creative approaches to leadership communications, including executive videos, town halls, employee engagement moments and digital storytelling.
  • Support leaders in navigating sensitive and high-stakes communications, including organizational changes, business transformation, earnings moments and crisis situations, ensuring messaging is timely, transparent and aligned with company values.

Internal Communications & Brand Storytelling

  • Write and edit engaging articles, short-form content, executive features and employee stories for global internal communications channels.
  • Partner with Marketing, R&D and other business teams to uncover compelling stories about our brands, innovation, consumers and the people behind our products.
  • Translate brand innovations, company achievements and growth milestones into relevant, accessible content that strengthens employee connection to our strategy and inspires employees to become ambassadors for our brands.
  • Identify fresh storytelling formats and creative approaches that make internal content more engaging, shareable and impactful, including the use of AI-assisted content tools and emerging digital formats.

Strategic Collaboration & Execution

  • Partner closely with the Multimedia Content Creator on video concepts, scripts and the development of compelling creative assets across both leadership and brand storytelling.
  • Work across the Global Communications team to connect leadership messaging, business priorities and employee storytelling into a cohesive narrative.
  • Build productive relationships with business and functional partners to proactively identify strong content opportunities.
  • Manage multiple communications projects from concept through execution, ensuring high-quality work and timely delivery.
  • Contribute to the measurement of communications effectiveness - including engagement metrics, post-event feedback - to continuously improve content quality and impact.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Communications, Journalism, Public Relations or a related field.
  • 8+ years of experience in corporate communications, executive communications, journalism, content development or related disciplines.
  • Exceptional writing, editing and storytelling skills, with a portfolio demonstrating the ability to create compelling content for different audiences and formats.
  • Experience developing communications for senior executives, including speeches, talking points, video scripts and leadership messaging.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting communications during sensitive moments, including organizational change, crisis response or business transformation.
  • Strong business acumen and ability to translate complex strategies into accessible, engaging narratives.
  • Experience working across cultures and geographies, with the ability to adapt content for diverse global audiences.

title: Part time Branch Ambassdor - Shirley
description:
Part time Branch Ambassdor - Shirley

Welcome to the future of banking. At Capital One, we believe your bank should be as mobile, intuitive, and human as the rest of your life. We are reimagining the way people interact with their money by creating community hubs where technology meets human empathy.


As a Branch Ambassador, you are the heartbeat of our space. You don't just "process transactions"—you embody our culture of outstanding hospitality. You are a relationship-builder who blends friendly, attentive service with cutting-edge digital innovation. Whether you’re helping a client navigate our latest tools or empowering them to reach their financial goals, you are the face of an exceptional, human-centric experience.

We are looking for curious, empathetic, and tech-savvy individuals who thrive in a fast-moving environment. You are someone who doesn't wait to be asked; you anticipate needs, solve problems before they arise, and have a genuine passion for helping people thrive in an evolving digital world.


What You’ll Actually Do

The Guardian of Trust & Accuracy You are the bedrock of our environment’s safety and integrity. You’ll execute high-volume cash transactions—including deposits, withdrawals, and complex negotiable instrument processing—with 100% accuracy. You maintain a "compliance-first" mindset, ensuring all security, audit, BSA/AML, and federal regulatory standards are met with precision to keep our customers' assets safe.

The Digital Concierge You are a mentor in a digital world. You’ll educate clients on how to leverage mobile banking, remote deposit capture, and contactless payments, helping them gain convenience and security in their daily financial lives.

The First-Line Consultant You aren’t just answering questions; you’re identifying needs. By actively listening, you’ll uncover personal or business goals and pair them with the right digital tools or banking solutions to help them succeed.

The Hospitality Lead You move fluidly throughout the space, greeting customers and ensuring no one ever feels like just a "number." You balance the efficiency of a high-volume operation with the warmth of a community-focused partner.


What You Bring

  • A Hospitality Heart: You have a natural gift for making people feel welcome and heard.
  • Tech Fluency: You are an early adopter of apps and digital tools and love teaching others how to use them.
  • Precision and Detail: You find satisfaction in getting the numbers right every single time and following clear procedures.
  • Adaptability: You enjoy a "fluid" workspace where you might move from a cash drawer to a digital demo in minutes.
  • Curiosity: You want to know the "why" behind the "how" and are always looking for ways to improve the customer journey.

Why Join Us?

This isn't just a job—it’s work with a mission. Because we’ve removed the pressure of traditional sales quotas, you are free to focus on the depth of your impact on customers, teammates, and the community. We provide an inclusive environment where we invest in your confidence, service mindset, and professional growth. We ensure you have the tools to be stronger in your role and more effective in how you show up every day.


The Perks

We provide a comprehensive benefits package designed to fuel your journey. Whether you’re using our education assistance to prepare for your next career move, or taking advantage of our mental and physical health resources to stay at your best, we invest in you as a whole person. Our goal is to ensure that wherever your career takes you—within Capital One or into the wider world—you leave the Branch stronger than when you started.

  • Day 1 coverage for Medical, Dental, Vision and Prescriptions, plus Flexible Spending Accounts, Life and Disability Insurance
  • Paid Time Off
  • Education Assistance
  • Matching 401(k) contribution up to 7.5%
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Mental Health support
  • Back-up Child or Elder Care
  • And much more!

Essential Functions (Included, but not limited to)

  • Support surrounding Branches as needed within a 50 mile radius, with occasional opportunities to assist other locations in the broader Region.
  • Available to work a flexible schedule, including weekends, with hours and days subject to change.
  • While the company provides reasonable notice for permanent schedule changes in accordance with state and local laws, the ability to adapt to business-driven schedule adjustments is required.
  • Applicants must be able to attend all required training sessions, which may occur on a schedule differing from the primary shift.
  • Lifting up to 25 pounds and moving/standing for extended periods of time
  • Regular and consistent attendance

Basic Qualifications

  • High School Diploma, GED, or Equivalent Certification
  • At least 1 year of Retail, Sales, or Customer Service experience
  • At least 6 months of cash handling experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Associate’s degree
  • 2+ years of Retail or Customer-facing experience
  • Proficient in G-Suite
  • Strong written and oral communication skills

After you apply

You may be required to take an assessment. It takes about 35 minutes to complete. If you’re selected to move forward, one of our recruiters will reach out to tell you more about the role and answer your questions.


Does this sound like the career move you’ve been looking for? Let’s build the future of banking together!

title: Coordinator, Ticket Operations
description:
Powered by Passion. United by Purpose. Build for Impact.

At Maple Leaf Sports & Entertainment Partnership (MLSE), we exist to deliver the ultimate fan experience by lifting trophies, spirits, and communities – united as one.

We're more than a workplace. We are a team of passionate people, boldly building the future of sport and entertainment, together. We believe in the power of play, the strength of collaboration, and the energy that comes from showing up with purpose.

From the ice to the pitch, the hardwood to the digital arena, we’re proud to be the driving force behind the Toronto Maple Leafs (NHL), the Toronto Raptors (NBA), Toronto FC (MLS), Toronto Argonauts (CFL) and development teams with the Toronto Marlies (AHL), Raptors 905 (NBA G League), Toronto FC II (MLS NEXT Pro League) and Raptors Uprising Gaming Club, the Toronto Raptors Esports franchise in the NBA 2K League.

We bring these teams – and world-class entertainment – to life at our iconic venues, including Scotiabank Arena, BMO Field, Coca-Cola Coliseum, Ford Performance Centre, BMO Training Ground, and OVO Athletic Centre. Off the field, we serve up elevated dining at e11even, Real Sports, and our signature club spaces like Hot Stove Club, ScotiaClub, and Platinum Club.

Through MLSE Foundation and MLSE LaunchPad, we use the power of sport to help youth facing barriers reach their full potential. Since 2009, we’ve invested more than $45 million into Ontario communities -- and we’re just getting started.

This is what it means to be One MLSE: a culture where everyone plays a role, everyone belongs, and everyone contributes to something bigger than themselves.

So, if you're ready to play with purpose, grow with passion, and win as one, we’d love to have you on our team.

** We know that great candidates come from a variety of backgrounds and experiences. Even if you do not meet every qualification listed, we encourage you to apply. Your unique perspective, transferable skills, and lived experience may be exactly what we’re looking for. **

Job Description

As part of the Ticketing – Operations team located at the Scotiabank Arena, you will be responsible for the execution of events, sales/service and reporting on events as it relates to ticketing. Your attention to detail, technical aptitude, collaboration and commitment to service will contribute to the successful execution of ticketing operations and an extraordinary fan and partner experience.

RESPONSIBILITIES


  • Adopt values that are inclusive and contribute to a collaborative environment, including emphasizing teamwork and mutual respect
  • Contribute to an inspiring team environment with a culture of open communication
  • Responsible for the administration and maintenance of ticketed sports events across MLSE venues, with a particular focus on Host Sports and external partners including Sceptres, Tempo, AFC Toronto, Canada Soccer and other third party events.
  • Liaise with internal and external partners and promoters on ticketing tasks, including but not limited to, price scaling, offer builds, ticket delivery, presale/on sale scheduling, inventory management and show settlement.
  • Execute event builds, including pricing, barcoding, and mobile ticket management as events are announced across multiple venues
  • Work in collaboration with internal teams to ensure manifests and maps are accurate
  • Support internal departments with ticketing requests and troubleshooting ticketing issues including ticket replacement, scanning issues, and refunds
  • Provide timely support and coverage for the department's shared email inbox.
  • Execute and, where assigned, lead event-day ticketing operations across MLSE owned/operated venues, including inventory management, order fulfillment, troubleshooting and post-event settlement.
  • Liaise with Ticketmaster on event builds and system technology
  • Provide a variety of reporting for internal and external contacts on ticket inventory and sales
  • Provide internal departments with details on external sports announcements.
  • Develop and maintain strong working relationships with external partners including Sceptres, Tempo, AFC Toronto, Canada Soccer and other sport promoters, acting as a key ticketing contact for assigned events.
  • Responsible for inventory management and order fulfillment for internal orders.
  • Manage multiple concurrent events and priorities, often working within tight timelines and changing operational requirements.
  • Support the ticketing setup and execution of new programs, fan experiences, member events and other ticketed initiatives as assigned.
  • Communicate effectively and efficiently with colleagues and management.
  • Provide extraordinary fan service both internally and externally.
  • Take pride in the organization and its people; maintaining professionalism and confidentiality.
  • Perform other administrative or service functions as requested by management.
  • Ability to work evenings and weekends as required, including some holidays

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Previous experience and knowledge of ticket operations and administration is required
  • Knowledge of the Ticketmaster Host, Archtics and TM1 Systems are a definite asset
  • Exceptional interpersonal, presentation, and communication skills
  • Excellent administrative and computer skills (Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.)
  • Proven time management skills and must be reliable to adhere to time sensitive deadlines
  • Ability to work as part of a team and independently with minimal supervision
  • An ongoing awareness and responsiveness to client satisfaction

title: Manager, Project Management- Change and Enablement for AI (Hybrid)
description:
Manager, Project Management- Change and Enablement for AI (Hybrid)

Capital One’s Card Shared Services: Learning & Knowledge (L&K) team ensures that customer service agents and their leaders have the knowledge and skills to solve problems and enable brand defining experiences for millions of customers. We’re a team of learning, knowledge, technology, and data experts who are passionate about enabling agent performance through innovative skill development and content solutions. To transform the learning and knowledge experience, maximize our impact, and enable data-driven, tech-centric learning in the flow of work, we are seeking an innovative and forward-thinking Manager, Learning & Enablement Consultant for AI (Card Ops AI Readiness Lead) to consult, design, and implement a comprehensive training, change management, and adoption agenda to integrate Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Generative AI into our associates daily routines.

In this role, you will seamlessly connect business objectives and AI tech intent with impactful, learner-centered experiences and change campaigns. You will liaise with enterprise learning and change leads to leverage scalable resources while customizing strategies to meet the nuanced needs of Card Operations. Whether your background is in AI enablement, learning strategy, management consulting, or change management, your ability to build alignment, drive cultural shifts, and foster AI fluency will be critical to transforming frontline performance in the flow of work.


Who We Are Looking For

The ideal candidate for this role is a/an:

  • AI Enablement & Strategic Learning Partner: Anticipates future operational learning and adoption needs by staying current with Gen AI tools and design trends. Thinks and solves problems systemically, balancing long-term AI vision with execution rigor to bring structure to ambiguity while managing competing operational priorities.
  • Change & Cultural Transformation SME: Deep expert in change management, adoption strategies, and change communications techniques. Crafts campaign-like strategies to drive the knowledge, skills, and mindset shifts required for associates and leaders to confidently embrace AI in their day-to-day operations.
  • Cross-Functional Collaborator & Liaison: Thrives in matrixed environments, serving as a vital bridge between the AI in Ops Tiger Team, Community of Practice (COP) leads, enterprise learning/change leads, and Card Ops Chief of Staff (COS) teams. Leverages and reuses scalable enterprise assets while tailoring solutions for frontline agents and leaders.
  • Product, Program & Campaign Manager: Applies iteration, experimentation, and continuous feedback loops to refine enablement solutions. Effectively manages project scope, timelines, and rollout campaigns while monitoring operational results, mitigating risks, and updating stakeholders on progress.
  • Insight-Driven & Measurement-Focused: Uses data and analytics to craft a robust readiness measurement strategy. Continuously evaluates training, change, and communication efficacy to optimize AI usage, boost associate performance, and ensure measurable business outcomes.
  • Operational Storyteller & Relationship Manager: Cultivates trusted advisor relationships with frontline leaders and Accountable Executives. Communicates complex technical concepts with clarity to both technical and non-technical audiences, sharing compelling narrative updates and best practices across teams.

Key Responsibilities

Operational AI Readiness Campaign

  • Create, manage, and execute a full-scale operational readiness agenda to enhance and maximize AI adoption across call center agents, back-office agents, and frontline leaders.
  • Design and develop end-to-end enablement campaigns incorporating customized training materials, change communications, and reinforcement tools to drive long-term adoption.

Strategic Learning & Change Consultation

  • Provide always-on consultation and strategy refinement to bridge audience needs, stakeholder expectations, and frontline operational realities.
  • Partner with Accountable Executives, HR leaders, and Card Ops COS teams to align AI enablement with broader business OKRs and governance models.

Enterprise Integration & Best Practice Sharing

  • Liaise with enterprise learning, change leads, and external partners to bring emerging best practices back to Card Ops.
  • Scale and reuse enterprise content where applicable, while customizing methodologies to address unique Card Ops workflows and compliance guidelines.

Measurement Strategy & Continuous Improvement

  • Craft and maintain a readiness measurement strategy in partnership with the AI in Ops Tiger Team and COP lead.
  • Establish real-time feedback loops to continuously adapt training, change, and communication strategies based on associate feedback and tool telemetry.

Frontline Leader Enablement & Engagement

  • Partner across Learning, Knowledge, and Change Management to ensure seamless alignment across all frontline leader communications, training, and engagement activities.
  • Equip call center and back-office team leaders with coaching toolkits and change enablement resources to guide their teams through AI adoption.

What You Need to Be Successful

  • AI Fluency: Active user of Generative AI tools with a strong understanding of AI applications, prompt engineering concepts, and tech-centric learning workflows.
  • Operations Business Acumen: Deep familiarity with frontline operations, including a clear understanding of a "day/week in the life" of call center agents, back-office support agents, and operational team leaders.
  • Instructional Design & Adult Learning Expertise: Proven capability in adult learning principles, instructional design, and micro-learning formats delivered in the flow of work.
  • Change Management & Communication Mastery: Expert-level mastery of change management frameworks, stakeholder management, and high-impact multi-channel communication techniques.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Strong influencing skills with a proven track record of driving cross-functional alignment in complex, matrixed environments.
  • Agile Program Execution: Ability to lead through ambiguity, manage competing priorities, drive initiatives to completion, and iterate rapidly based on performance metrics.

Location: This role is designated as a hybrid position. You are expected to adhere to Capital One's hybrid policy regarding required on-site presence at your designated office location.


Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or military experience
  • At least 3 years of experience in client-facing consulting or internal strategic advisory roles
  • At least 2 years of experience in learning design, knowledge management, or change management
  • At least 1 year of hands-on experience utilizing or enabling Generative AI tools and technologies
  • At least 1 year of experience in project, program, or campaign management
  • At least 1 year of experience in learning and change strategy creation

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in management consulting or strategic advisory roles influencing senior leadership
  • 3+ years of experience developing change management, communication, or enablement campaigns for large-scale operations or contact centers
  • 3+ years of experience in strategy creation for technology adoption or digital transformation
  • Demonstrated familiarity with change management frameworks (e.g., Prosci) and agile project execution methodologies
  • Experience supporting or training call center agents, back-office support roles, and frontline operations leaders

title: Pricing Strategy Director
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

A Day in the Life

As Strategic Pricing Director, LATAM, you will serve on the Global Pricing and Contracting extended leadership team and lead the regional pricing organization. You will translate enterprise priorities into market-relevant strategies and disciplined execution across LATAM, partnering with LATAM region leadership, Global Operating Units (OUs), Regional Finance, and commercial teams to strengthen price realization, margin, profitable growth, and financial performance.

You will lead pricing and contracting strategy across Medtronic’s portfolio in LATAM, aligning regional and country plans with business priorities and global direction. You will shape pricing for key product launches, oversee core pricing operations, and advance processes, tools, and analytics that enable consistent, data-informed decisions and measurable results.

You will be accountable for regional pricing outcomes and work closely with LATAM Region and Global OU leadership, Portfolio CFOs, and commercial stakeholders to deliver sustainable growth, disciplined contracting, and margin improvement.

This opportunity is open to candidates across Latin America (LATAM). The position follows an onsite working model.

A Day in the Life: People Management

  • Set clear goals, accountabilities, and development priorities that align team performance with LATAM’s financial and strategic objectives.
  • Attract, develop, and retain strong pricing talent; build a future-ready pipeline through coaching, succession planning, and opportunities for growth across the organization.
  • Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performance team culture grounded in engagement, accountability, and continuous development.

Pricing Strategy and Profitable Growth

The Beauty Counter Manager plays a dual role – part salesperson, part teacher – while maximizing sales in their assigned beauty brand. A day in the life…

  • Conduct makeup applications, skincare analyses and recommend products based on customer’s beauty goals
  • Collaborate with team members to create a welcoming and inclusive environment for all customers
  • Set and achieve personal and counter sales goals, utilizing both in-store and digital selling tools (inclusive of text and social media)

  • Keep up with the latest beauty trends, products, and industry knowledge through trainings provided by Nordstrom and luxury brand partners

  • Empathy and respect for all customers, providing a supportive environment during makeup and skincare application
  • Strong multitasking, organization, and follow-through skills
  • Drive to achieve sales goals, with interest in using networking and technology
  • The ability to work a flexible schedule based on business needs, including evenings and weekends

    • Continuous movement for 6-8 hours per shift, which includes frequent bending, twisting, squatting, flexing and reaching in order to handle merchandise and assist customers.
    • Frequent use of hands for grasping, fine manipulation, pushing and pulling
    • Handle bulky and sometimes awkwardly shaped items, which includes reaching for and lifting these items above the head.

$27.00 - $28.10 Hourly
