title: Manager, Data Science - Model Risk Office
description:
Manager, Data Science - Model Risk Office

Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.


As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.


Team Description

In Capital One’s Model Risk Office, we defend the company against model failures and find new ways of making better decisions with models. We use our machine learning, AI, software engineering, and business expertise to drive the best outcomes in both Model Risk Management and the Enterprise.


The successful candidate will join the Card Model Risk team which is tasked with review and oversight of models used for underwriting Capital One’s flagship credit card products. You will use a variety of modeling, statistical, monitoring, and analytical tools to ensure models developed by data science practitioners across the company are effectively governed and lead to positive outcomes for the business.


Role Description

In this role, you will:

  • Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to deliver a product customers love
  • Leverage a broad stack of technologies — Python, Conda, AWS, H2O, Spark, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual data
  • Build machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementation
  • Flex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals

The Ideal Candidate is:

  • Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them.
  • Technical. You’re comfortable with open-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience developing data science solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms.
  • Statistically-minded. You’ve built models, validated them, and backtested them. You know how to interpret a confusion matrix or a ROC curve. You have experience with clustering, classification, sentiment analysis, time series, and deep learning.
  • A data guru. “Big data” doesn’t faze you. You have the skills to retrieve, combine, and analyze data from a variety of sources and structures. You know understanding the data is often the key to great data science.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date:
    • A Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 6 years of experience performing data analytics
    • A Master's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) or an MBA with a quantitative concentration plus 4 years of experience performing data analytics
    • A PhD in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 1 year of experience performing data analytics
  • At least 1 year of experience leveraging open source programming languages for large scale data analysis
  • At least 1 year of experience working with machine learning
  • At least 1 year of experience utilizing relational databases

Preferred Qualifications:

  • PhD in “STEM” field (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics) plus 3 years of experience in data analytics
  • At least 1 year of experience working with AWS
  • At least 4 years’ experience in Python, Scala, or R for large scale data analysis
  • At least 4 years’ experience with machine learning
  • At least 4 years’ experience with SQL

As a Senior Data Scientist focused on data engineering, you will discover, connect, transform, and operationalize engineering data and knowledge so that it can be reliably used by downstream AI systems, applications, and engineering workflows.

  • GCP or comparable cloud data-platform experience.
  • Experience preparing data and knowledge for retrieval and agent use.

  • Experience building reusable headless data services.
  • Experience with GitHub workflows, CI/CD, and automated testing.
  • Experience with requirements, specifications, constitutions, contracts, and AI harnesses.
  • Experience with security, access control, privacy, and governance.
  • Production deployment and operational-support experience.

What success looks like

  • You discover and connect priority engineering data and knowledge sources.
  • You deliver reliable ingestion, integration, transformation, and validation pipelines.
  • You improve metadata, lineage, discoverability, and operational observability.
  • You prepare data and knowledge for retrieval, agent use, and downstream applications.

Salary Range: $48,600 - $60,800 per year; DOE


The Gary K. Herberger Young Scholars Academy (HYSA) invites applications for the position of Registrar and Testing Coordinator. The Registrar and Testing Coordinator develops and maintains accurate documentation of student records. Working in collaboration with the administrative team, this position also supports student-facing operations, including, but not limited to, student information system, enrollment, registration, testing, and dual enrollment.


The Gary K. Herberger Young Scholars Academy is a learning environment designed for highly gifted students in grades 7-12 located on the Arizona State University West Valley campus. Funded by an endowment from the Herberger Family and supported by ASU, the Gary K. Herberger Young Scholars Academy was founded to address the needs of academically and intellectually gifted students in the Phoenix area. The Herberger Academy accepts qualified students who have completed the 6th-grade curriculum and are 11 years of age by the student start date. Designed for gifted students who thrive in a highly engaging learning environment, the academy personalizes students’ education by merging individual academic talents and interests with advanced college preparatory coursework and mentorship opportunities. Students at the academy experience a broad-minded, paradigm-shifting education. Herberger Academy scholars engage with dedicated instructors in a small and caring community, with the resources available at a major research university. Upon enrolling in the academy, students first become immersed in an integrated middle school-level curriculum at an accelerated pace. They then complete high school credits while exploring and pursuing their intellectual interests through Cambridge coursework and connections made accessible at Arizona State University. For more information about our school, please visit our website at .


This is an In-Person position at the West Valley campus. Schedule is: Monday - Friday, 7:30 AM to 4:30 PM.


Essential Duties:

  • Serve as Academy Registrar and maintain accurate student records, transcripts, cumulative files, enrollment documentation, and graduation information.
  • Ensure student records are maintained and released in compliance with FERPA and Academy procedures.
  • Process student records requests and support student onboarding and withdrawal activities.
  • Administer the Student Information System (SIS), ensuring the accuracy and integrity of student data.
  • Collaborate with the site principal to develop the master schedule and coordinate class enrollment and student schedules.
  • Coordinate and publish student progress reports and report cards, and maintain academic and distribution groups.
  • Create, distribute, and manage school forms and related documentation.
  • Coordinate external testing programs, including Cambridge, Advanced Placement, PSAT, SAT, PreACT, and ACT.
  • Manage testing enrollment, communications, staffing, facilities, reporting, and testing data for Academy leadership and staff.
  • Coordinate dual enrollment in ASU and Universal Learner courses, including applications, documentation, enrollment, scheduling, and family communications.
  • Serve as the primary backup for front office operations, providing visitor assistance, phone coverage, and general support during absences and peak periods.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience maintaining student records, transcripts, enrollment documentation, and cumulative files in a K–12 or higher education environment.
  • Experience administering a student information system (SIS) and maintaining accurate student data.
  • Knowledge of FERPA requirements and best practices for handling confidential student information.
  • Experience coordinating student enrollment, registration, scheduling, onboarding, and withdrawal processes.
  • Experience coordinating standardized or external testing programs.
  • Experience supporting dual enrollment or other college-readiness programs.
  • Experience preparing reports, analyzing student data, and communicating information to school leadership.
  • Demonstrated attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate records and documentation.
  • Evidence of strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple priorities and meet established deadlines.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills, including experience communicating with students, families, faculty, staff, and external partners.
  • Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively with administrators, counselors, educators, and support staff.
  • Experience providing responsive, professional customer service in a student-facing or front-office environment.

From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI & ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. title: Director, MedTech Safety - Europe
description:
IQVIA MedTech is seeking an experienced Safety leader to oversee a growing team responsible for safety activities supporting Medical Device clinical studies in Europe. This role will provide both technical and operational leadership, with primary responsibility for EU medical-device safety reporting, team management, client delivery, financial oversight, and the continued development of the Safety organization as the portfolio grows.

This leader will initially oversee and help build a team that is responsible for expedited and periodic safety reporting to European Ethics Committees and Competent Authorities, annual progress reporting.


Essential Functions

Medical Device Safety Leadership

  • Provide senior leadership and oversight for safety activities supporting Medical Device clinical studies, with a particular focus on studies conducted in Europe.
  • Ensure appropriate execution of expedited and periodic safety reporting to EU Ethics Committees and Competent Authorities.
  • Oversee preparation and delivery of annual and periodic safety/progress reports.
  • Serve as a senior Safety subject matter expert for clients, internal stakeholders, operational teams, and integrated partners.
  • Provide guidance on European Medical Device safety requirements and ensure operational processes meet applicable regulatory, contractual, quality, and reporting requirements.
  • Partner with US Safety team and cross-functional leaders to resolve complex operational, regulatory, and client issues.

Team Leadership

  • Lead, develop, and manage a team of Safety Specialists and Safety Managers.
  • Support the continued build-out of the Safety organization as additional positions are approved and client work expands.
  • Provide day-to-day leadership, coaching, workload oversight, performance management, and professional development.
  • Ensure appropriate staffing, resource allocation, utilization, training, and operational readiness across the team.
  • Establish clear accountability for quality, timelines, compliance, and client delivery.
  • Foster a collaborative, solutions-oriented culture focused on accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement.

Client and Program Leadership

  • Serve as a senior point of contact for assigned clients and programs, establishing strong and trusted client relationships.
  • Oversee scope, objectives, timelines, quality, and delivery for assigned Safety programs.
  • Ensure appropriate communication and escalation channels are maintained with clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Lead resolution of significant quality concerns, operational issues, and customer escalations.
  • Partner with customers to establish working practices, KPIs, SLAs, quality expectations, and processes for ongoing oversight.
  • Provide strategic consultation regarding Safety delivery and recommend solutions based on evolving client and program requirements.
  • Represent Safety in governance meetings, steering committees, operational reviews, and other high-visibility client forums.

Operational and Financial Management

  • Provide oversight of the financial and operational performance of assigned Safety work.
  • Manage and monitor revenue, billing, utilization, budgets, resourcing, and financial performance.
  • Ensure resources and staffing plans remain aligned with current and anticipated client demand.
  • Monitor program-level quality, productivity, utilization, and financial metrics and implement corrective actions when needed.
  • Support adherence to change-control processes and ensure changes in scope are appropriately assessed, documented, and reflected financially.
  • Partner with operational and commercial stakeholders as the team's responsibilities and book of business evolve.

Business and Strategic Leadership

  • Identify opportunities for repeat business and additional client services based on customer needs.
  • Participate in RFPs, proposals, solution development, budgeting, and customer presentations.
  • Provide Safety subject-matter expertise in the development of operational solutions for new opportunities.
  • Assess the operational feasibility, staffing requirements, regulatory considerations, and financial impact of proposed solutions.
  • Support development and negotiation of scopes of work, budgets, work orders, service-level agreements, and other applicable contractual documentation.
  • Lead or contribute to global initiatives designed to improve Safety delivery, processes, systems, oversight, and service offerings.
  • Collaborate across functions to develop practical solutions and ensure consistent delivery across programs and geographies.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree, preferably in a health science, life science, nursing, pharmacy, or related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant experience.
  • At least 10 years of progressive Safety, clinical safety, or related experience within a CRO or Medical Device environment.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting Medical Device clinical studies.
  • Working knowledge and practical experience with European Medical Device safety requirements and EU safety reporting, including interactions or submissions involving Ethics Committees and Competent Authorities.
  • At least 3-5 years of leadership, people-management, or line-management experience.
  • Experience leading Safety professionals and managing priorities across multiple programs or studies.
  • Experience with client-facing delivery and senior stakeholder management.
  • Demonstrated understanding of operational and financial management, including revenue, billing, utilization, budgets, and resource planning.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and make independent operational decisions in a complex, matrixed environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, negotiation, and client-management skills.

title: Control COE Lead
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.

Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

About the role


The Control COE Lead is responsible for developing, governing, and continuously improving the enterprise-wide control framework within Digital & Technology. The role leads the design, simplification, automation, standardisation, and rationalisation of controls across D&T, ensuring the control environment is efficient, modern, risk‑based, and aligned to regulatory, audit, and operational expectations.


The role oversees the definition of control standards, patterns, and reusable frameworks and works with control owners, product teams, architects, engineering, and compliance stakeholders to embed high-quality, sustainable control designs. The Control COE Lead drives automation opportunities across the control lifecycle, including preventative controls, detective controls, continuous monitoring, and digital evidence collection.


As a central authority for control excellence, the role ensures alignment across SOx, ITGC, cybersecurity, privacy, GxP and other compliance domains, reducing duplication, improving efficiency, and enabling a scalable, tech‑enabled control environment.


Role Responsibilities


  • Lead the enterprise-wide redesign, simplification, and optimisation of the D&T control environment, including control mapping, duplication elimination, standardisation, and creation of reusable design patterns.
  • Define and maintain D&T control standards, methodologies, and frameworks, ensuring alignment with SOx, ITGC, cybersecurity, and privacy control expectations.
  • Drive automation of controls and evidence collection, partnering with engineering, automation teams, and GRC tooling teams to enable continuous monitoring, preventative controls, and tech‑enabled assurance
  • Oversee the rationalisation of existing controls, including removal of redundant or ineffective controls, consolidation of overlapping controls, and replacement of manual processes with automated solutions.
  • Provide expert advisory support to control owners, product teams, architects, and risk & compliance, ensuring new solutions and technology changes embed “compliance by design” and adopt approved control patterns.
  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives across the control lifecycle, measuring control effectiveness, identifying systemic issues, and coordinating enhancements with senior stakeholders and cross‑functional teams.

Business Expertise


  • Requires deep understanding of technology risk, SOx, ITGC, cybersecurity control frameworks, and GxP expectations, including how these apply to modern cloud, data, infrastructure, and product environments.
  • Strong knowledge of control design principles, process optimisation, automation capabilities, and industry best practices for controls engineering.
  • Ability to translate regulatory requirements (SOx, GxP, privacy, cybersecurity) into actionable, scalable, technology‑friendly controls.
  • Broad understanding of modern digital architecture (cloud, identity, data, DevOps), enabling effective collaboration with engineering and architecture teams on embedding automated controls.
  • Commercially aware with ability to prioritise control optimisation activities that drive the biggest impact on risk reduction, cost reduction, audit readiness, and operational efficiency.

Problem Solving


  • Tackles highly complex challenges relating to inconsistent control design, legacy processes, and fragmented control ownership across D&T.
  • Requires ability to evaluate root causes, identify structural issues, and propose scalable and simplified solutions that balance risk, audit needs, regulatory expectations, and business agility.
  • Must innovate by introducing automation, continuous monitoring, control-as-code, and modern assurance methods.
  • Challenges compounded by evolving regulatory requirements (SOx, cybersecurity), continuous technology changes, and differing levels of maturity across teams.
  • Requires structured judgement to redesign controls that are both audit‑ready and aligned to modern technology delivery practices (agile, DevSecOps, product‑centric operating models).

Interactions / Interpersonal Skills


  • Extensive engagement with control owners, engineers, architects, product leaders, security teams, risk & compliance, internal audit, quality (for GxP systems), and external auditors.
  • Requires strong communication and stakeholder management skills to explain complex control redesign concepts in clear, simple terms suitable for both technical and business audiences.
  • Must influence decision-making without direct authority, particularly when simplifying long‑standing legacy control processes.
  • Skilled in negotiation, conflict resolution, and driving adoption of new standards across diverse teams and geographies.

Skills Qualifications


  • Degree or equivalent professional experience in Information Systems, Risk Management, Business, or a related discipline
  • At least 15+ years of experience in IT compliance, auditing, or risk management
  • Experience in technology risk management, control design, or control operations.
  • Hands-on experience with SOx, ITGC, cybersecurity controls, and ideally exposure to GxP control frameworks
  • Demonstrated experience simplifying or redesigning controls or processes.
  • Experience working with engineering teams on automation, workflow design, or continuous monitoring solutions.

Preferences:

  • Leadership experience within a Control COE, Risk Engineering, Internal Controls, or Technology Governance function.
  • Experience implementing control automation, control-as-code, or GRC tooling (e.g., Archer, ServiceNow GRC, SAP GRC).
  • Experience designing enterprise control frameworks in cloud-native or hybrid environments.
  • Experience leading cross-functional transformation or control rationalisation initiatives.

Relevant certifications in IT compliance or auditing such as:

  • Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA),
  • Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control (CRISC),
  • Certified in the Governance of Enterprise IT (CGEIT), or equivalent risk, audit, or technology governance qualifications.

Job Posting End Date

2026-11-14

Equal Opportunities

Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.

During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.

The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.

Adjustment or Accommodations Request

If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.

title: Senior Manager, Data Science - Model Risk
description:
Senior Manager, Data Science - Model Risk

Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.


As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.


Team Description

In Capital One’s Model Risk Office, we defend the company against model failures and find new ways of making better decisions with models. We use our statistics, software engineering, and business expertise to drive the best outcomes in both Risk Management and the Enterprise. We understand that we can’t prepare for tomorrow by focusing on today, so we invest in the future: investing in new skills, building better tools, and maintaining a network of trusted partners. We learn from past mistakes, and develop increasingly powerful techniques to avoid their repetition.


Role Description

In this role, you will:

  • Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to deliver a product customers love
  • Leverage a broad stack of technologies — Python, Conda, AWS, H2O, Spark, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual data
  • Build machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementation
  • Flex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals

The Ideal Candidate is:

  • A leader. You challenge conventional thinking and work with stakeholders to identify and improve the status quo. You’re passionate about talent development for your own team and beyond.
  • Customer first. You love the process of analyzing and creating, but also share our passion to do the right thing. You know at the end of the day it’s about making the right decision for our customers.
  • Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them.
  • Statistically-minded. You’ve built models, validated them, and backtested them. You know how to interpret a confusion matrix or a ROC curve. You have experience with clustering, classification, sentiment analysis, time series, and deep learning.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date:
    • A Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 7 years of experience performing data analytics
    • A Master's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) or an MBA with a quantitative concentration plus 5 years of experience performing data analytics
    • A PhD in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 2 years of experience performing data analytics
  • At least 2 years of experience leveraging open source programming languages for large scale data analysis
  • At least 2 years of experience working with machine learning
  • At least 2 years of experience utilizing relational databases

Preferred Qualifications:

  • PhD in “STEM” field (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics) plus 4 years of experience in data analytics
  • At least 1 year of experience working with AWS
  • At least 1 year of experience managing people
  • At least 5 years’ experience in Python, Scala, or R for large scale data analysis
  • At least 5 years’ experience with machine learning

title: Senior Manager, Lifecycle Management & Reliability
description:
As the global leader in high-speed connectivity, Ciena builds the critical infrastructure powering the AI era. We’re a technology company shaping the future of networking, guided by innovation, integrity, and collaboration. Through development opportunities, meaningful work, and flexibility, Ciena supports growth and well-being—on and off the job. Connect with a career that matters.


.Job Description

We are seeking an experienced engineering leader to join our Hardware Engineering organization in Ottawa, ON, leading multidisciplinary teams across the lifecycle of complex packet and optical networking products. The role provides leadership for product reliability, manufacturability, supply continuity, failure analysis, and technical support across multiple platforms and product families. The successful candidate will combine strong technical leadership with sound business judgment to balance customer commitments, product quality, manufacturing readiness, supply continuity, and engineering priorities.

How you will make an impact:

  • Lead and develop a multidisciplinary hardware engineering team supporting packet and optical networking platforms through development, qualification, manufacturing, sustaining, field support, and end-of-life.
  • Provide technical and team leadership for complex electrical, optical, FPGA, SerDes, memory, interface, power, manufacturing, and product-quality investigations.
  • Drive cross-functional decisions involving hardware design, product engineering, manufacturing, quality, supply chain, software, systems engineering, product management, suppliers, and customer-facing organizations.
  • Lead component obsolescence, alternate sourcing, qualification, cost-reduction, engineering change, and supply-continuity initiatives across multiple product families.
  • Make risk-based decisions on product changes, component substitutions, qualifications, manufacturing readiness, field issues, supplier issues, and corrective actions.
  • Analyze qualification results, manufacturing metrics, field-return trends, reliability data, and failure-analysis findings to identify risks and drive corrective actions.
  • Lead reliability engineering, product reliability prediction, failure investigations, and laboratory capabilities that enable root-cause analysis and resolution of product and customer issues.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives that improve engineering effectiveness, product quality, lifecycle management, and organizational scalability.

The Must Haves:

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  • Experience: 10+ years of hardware engineering experience in telecommunications, networking, or optical systems, including 3+ years leading engineering teams, technical projects, or cross-functional initiatives.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting products through development, qualification, manufacturing, sustaining, field service, and end-of-life.
  • Strong foundation in hardware design, product qualification, reliability engineering, manufacturing, product quality, failure analysis, and root-cause analysis.
  • Technical breadth across electrical, optical, and power technologies with the ability to lead complex investigations.
  • Experience making risk-based decisions involving engineering changes, component substitutions, qualifications, manufacturing readiness, supplier issues, field quality, product lifecycle management, configuration management, and component qualification.
  • Proven ability to hire, develop, and retain engineering talent, prioritize competing technical and business issues, and influence stakeholders across engineering, manufacturing, quality, supply chain, product management, and executive leadership.

Nice to Haves:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  • Experience with telecommunications transport platforms, packet networking systems, or high-speed networking products.
  • Experience with FPGA- and ASIC-based platforms and common high-speed interfaces such as PCIe, DDR, Ethernet, SPI, I²C, and chip-to-chip interconnect technologies.
  • Familiarity with power architectures, analog circuitry, hardware monitoring systems, and manufacturing-test methodologies.
  • Experience with reliability prediction, FMECA, or structured reliability engineering methodologies.
  • Experience with Agile PLM, Jira, Confluence, engineering dashboards, automation tools, and data analytics.
  • Familiarity with global manufacturing operations, supplier management, and contract-manufacturing environments.

Pay Range: The annual salary range for this position is $129,700 - $253,100

title: Pulmonary Function Tech PD_UNAP
description:
SUMMARY:

Under the general supervision of the Director of Pediatric Pulmonology, and following standard policies and procedures, performs a variety of diagnostic pulmonary function tests on patients using spirometers, gas analyzers, oximeters, and other equipment to evaluate and test for lung disease. When assisting a physician, obtains washing samples, tissue samples, and performs other procedures within the lung using bronchosopes, biopsy forceps and other instruments.

Brown University Health employees are expected to successfully role model the organization's values of Compassion, Accountability, Respect, and Excellence as these values guide our everyday actions with patients, customers and one another.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

1.Testing:


  • Receives orders from physicians for pulmonary function tests (PFT) to be performed on patients. Reviews patient medical records, informing physician of any previous difficulty with testing.
  • Explains procedures and gives instructions on various breathing maneuvers to patients to allay fears and obtain accurate results from tests.
  • Records data and reads graphical data from tests and performs routine mathematical calculations.
  • Performs a variety of diagnostic pulmonary function test procedures on patients including:

a.) Routine pulmonary function studies using spirometer, body

box and gas analyzer to measure flow rates.

b.) Drawing arterial blood gas

c.) Measure peak cough flow, FeNO

d.) Methocholine challenge test

e.) Perform impulse oscillometry and infant stress oximetry

f.) More advanced testing such as measurement of carbon

monoxide diffusing capacity, lung volumes and respiratory

muscle pressures.

g.) Monitors patient during six-minute walk test

h.) tcPCO2 monitoring

i.) Assist in other procedures as needed, including

bronchoscopy (see below)


2. Lab Management:

  • Maintain Supplies available in PFT lab
  • Clean equipment after use-Cystic Fibrosis Foundation Infection Prevention and Control guidelines in use, HEPA filtration unit maintenance
  • Calibrate and maintain testing equipment: identify and seek resolution for technical problems
  • Oxygen e-Cylinder for PFT lab
  • Maintain portable suction machine (check daily, stock supplies)
  • Maintain a clean work environment

3. Testing Equipment:


  • Calibrate and maintain spirometer/laptop
  • Troubleshoot as needed for the Respiratory and Immunology Center (RIC) and the satellite offices
  • Maintain spirometer supplies by ordering and restocking

4. General Respiratory Care:

  • Obtain sputum samples (tracheal aspirate, throat swab, induction)
  • Assist in Respiratory Care for VIP clinic
  • Assist in Respiratory Care for CF clinic, including yearly evaluation of all patients
  • Assist in Respiratory Care for Pediatric Pulmonology clinic
  • Assist in Respiratory Care for Asthma allergy clinic
  • Maintain medication supply (bronchodilators, mucolytics, hydration, provocholine)
  • Assist providers with bronchoscopy procedures (procedure room, OR suite, PICU) by preparing equipment, assist with taking samples, cytological washings and tissue biopsy using bronchoscope and biopsy brush
  • Obtain equipment and supplies from various departments/areas, maintain clean storage area, track cleaning and disinfecting of scopes prior to use, maintain bronchoscope travel bag packed with supplies
  • Order medium for transporting of biopsies or cytology washing
  • Order equipment provider deems necessary for the procedure (scissors, clamps)

5. Educate Patients and Families:


  • Act as respiratory therapy liaison for pulmonologists and other medical staff regarding inpatient care/equipment or testing as needed
  • Proper use of inhaled medications and multiple devices for delivery
  • Proper order of inhaled medications in conjunction with airway clearance
  • Airway clearance rational and techniques (Chest PT technique, Autogenic Drainage, PEP/OPEP devices, different Vest therapy systems, etc.)
  • High tech equipment (mechanical ventilators, CPAP and BiPAP machines and cough assist machines
  • Tracheostomy care
  • Pulse Oximetry
  • Create cough assist care plans for patients
  • Complete annual visits for CF patients, update care plans and provide expert airway clearance and equipment guidance
  • Cleaning and disinfection (at home and hospital of devices/equipment) to be taught
  • Educate co-workers/nurses in airway clearance, medication delivery and devices
  • Perform clinical administrative functions as requested such as manage patient test results, document and scan, assign to interpreting provider, send results to ordering provider as needed in EMR
  • Participate in QI and other projects within the department or for special groupsDevelop and present educational tools to staff and patients
  • Attend national and/or regional conferences
  • Attend staff meetings or administrative meetings as needed
  • Performs other duties as assigned

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Completion of High School plus an AMA approved Associate Degree Respiratory Therapy program.
  • Certification or Registry required.
  • Licensed as a Respiratory Care Practitioner in the State of Rhode Island.
  • Maintain BLS
  • Knowledge of test procedures and reactions of patients while undergoing test procedures.
  • Demonstrated knowledge and skills necessary to provide care patients with consideration of aging processes, human development stages and cultural patterns in each step of the care process.

EXPERIENCE:


  • One year of related experience preferred

WORK ENVIRONMENT AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:


  • Works in a patient care environment where both physical and mental effort is required to deal with patients, families, all levels of hospital staff, etc.

title: Commercial Client Specialist III
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

The Commercial Client Specialist III position provides support to the company’s bankers by servicing, maintaining and updating loan documentation and loan files. The position requires substantial interaction with new and current bank customers, both internal and external, and requires excellent customer service skills along with proactive communication abilities. This position often functions as an SME across multiple loan assistants and a go-to person for complex questions, challenges, or processes; typically acts as a peer leader to less experienced loan assistants.

  • Ability to manage high volume and/or complexity of loans consistently and regularly in an efficient manner.

  • Coordinate the preparation of required loan documentation; review documentation for compliance with documentation requirements; coordinate the execution of loan documents; organize workflow for loan renewal; follow up with clients, insurance agents, Title Company and/ or attorney for missing loan documentation as necessary.

  • Responsible for resolving exceptions or any other documentation deficiencies along with actively managing outstanding exception items for compliance with Credit Policy. Ensure proper reporting and compliance for the bank.

  • Work closely with the assigned banker to assist in collecting financial data and client phone/email communication to better manage the overall client relationship. Other client related services include wires, NSF accounts and overdrafts. Should contain a significant ability to interpret complex financial statements and their analyses with ability to translate all details to the appropriate business partner.

  • Responsible for monitoring reports such as past due, paid off loans, criticized assets, and maturing loan lists to assist and proactively inform banker of potential or pending issues along with providing support to minimize administrative issues such client past dues.

  • When needed, coordinate with Portfolio Manager and CCFG to facilitate funding of construction loan disbursements in accordance with bank policy.

  • Promote an outstanding customer experience by exemplifying prompt follow-up and proactive internal/external customer communication, proper etiquette, and all other professional customer service qualities to maximize the most out of the client relationships.

  • Solid partnership with all ancillary departments within the bank to include the Loan Admin group, CIS, Loan Review, Special Assets, Bank Card, and Consumer Special Services.

  • Performs other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Skills

  • Ability to manage problematic situations in a diplomatic manner.

  • In certain markets, thorough understanding and communication ability of the bank’s retail services and processes.

Au sein d’IQVIA, le Centre de sémantique des données de santé offre des services-conseils et des solutions technologiques qui aident les clients à exploiter pleinement la valeur de leurs données grâce à la sémantique et à l’interopérabilité.

Aperçu du poste

Ce poste contribue au développement et à la prestation de solutions de grande qualité dans le cadre de mandats clients, en mettant particulièrement l’accent sur l’accompagnement des clients dans la mise en œuvre de technologies sémantiques, de normes d’interopérabilité et d’approches axées sur les données.

Les mandats peuvent aller de l’analyse des besoins et de la résolution de problèmes au soutien du développement de solutions plus complexes. Vous collaborerez avec des équipes de projet réparties dans différentes régions ainsi qu’avec des experts du domaine dans les secteurs de la santé et des sciences de la vie.

Ce poste convient particulièrement à une personne ayant un vif intérêt pour les données de santé, les technologies sémantiques, l’interopérabilité, les graphes de connaissances et l’intelligence artificielle (IA), ainsi que la capacité à comprendre les besoins des clients et à les traduire en solutions concrètes.

Fonctions essentielles

  • Examiner et analyser les besoins des clients et les enjeux d’affaires, et contribuer à l’élaboration de propositions.
  • Cerner les enjeux et contribuer au développement de solutions, de stratégies de mise en œuvre et de feuilles de route appropriées.
  • Évaluer la valeur commerciale potentielle des technologies et des approches sémantiques.
  • Élaborer une documentation de projet détaillée ainsi que des exigences et des spécifications fonctionnelles et techniques.
  • Soutenir les analystes et les consultants dans l’élaboration et la structuration de présentations, de recommandations et de livrables destinés aux clients.
  • Travailler avec des données provenant des secteurs de la santé et des sciences de la vie en utilisant les normes, les technologies sémantiques et les approches d’interopérabilité pertinentes.
  • Soutenir, lorsque pertinent, des projets portant sur des modèles sémantiques, des graphes de connaissances et des cas d’utilisation liés à l’IA.
  • Utiliser Python, SQL ou des langages similaires de script ou de requête pour traiter et analyser les données.
  • Développer ses connaissances des services-conseils, des méthodologies ainsi que des secteurs pharmaceutique, de la santé et des sciences de la vie.
  • Dans un rôle d’analyste d’affaires, valider les livrables destinés aux clients et fournir des orientations aux équipes de projet à l’étranger.
  • Collaborer efficacement avec des équipes multidisciplinaires et réparties géographiquement afin de contribuer à la réussite des projets.

Qualifications

  • Baccalauréat requis. Un diplôme d’études supérieures ou une formation pertinente dans un domaine informatique, médical, des sciences de la vie ou dans une discipline connexe constitue un atout important.
  • De 3 à 5 ans d’expérience professionnelle, de préférence dans les secteurs de la santé et/ou des sciences de la vie.
  • Bonne compréhension des normes relatives aux données de santé et des technologies sémantiques, notamment : FHIR SNOMED CDISC IDMP RDF/OWL Principes FAIR applicables aux données
  • Une expertise de niveau spécialiste dans chacun de ces domaines n’est pas requise. Les candidats doivent posséder de solides connaissances dans certains de ces domaines, ainsi qu’une compréhension plus générale de l’écosystème de la sémantique et de l’interopérabilité.
  • Compréhension de base de l’IA et des graphes de connaissances, ainsi que de leurs applications dans les secteurs de la santé et des sciences de la vie, y compris une culture de base en matière d’IA.
  • Capacité à travailler avec des données à l’aide de Python, SQL ou de langages similaires de script ou de requête.
  • Solides capacités d’analyse et de résolution de problèmes.
  • Capacité à traduire les besoins d’affaires en solutions claires et concrètes.
  • Capacité à travailler efficacement et en collaboration avec différents intervenants au sein de l’organisation afin d’atteindre les objectifs de l’équipe et des projets.
  • Excellentes aptitudes à la communication écrite et verbale en anglais.
  • Excellentes compétences organisationnelles et en gestion du temps, avec la capacité de gérer plusieurs priorités simultanément et de respecter les échéances.
  • Une connaissance des méthodologies, des outils et des techniques de consultation pertinents au domaine fonctionnel est souhaitée.
  • Une compréhension des tendances et des développements pertinents de l’industrie ainsi que du contexte concurrentiel est souhaitée.

Ce que vous apporterez

Vous apportez votre expertise et un vif intérêt pour la sémantique et l’interopérabilité, ainsi que le désir de contribuer à l’amélioration des secteurs de la santé et des sciences de la vie en aidant les organisations à mieux exploiter leurs données.

Vous avez une approche collaborative et axée sur le client, de solides capacités d’analyse et la capacité de traduire des exigences complexes liées aux affaires et aux données en solutions concrètes.

Vous êtes à l’aise de travailler au sein d’équipes multidisciplinaires, de contribuer à des mandats auprès des clients et de coordonner le travail entre des équipes locales et à l’étranger. Vous vous intéressez également aux technologies émergentes, notamment l’intelligence artificielle et les graphes de connaissances, et comprenez comment celles-ci peuvent compléter des environnements de données sémantiques et interopérables.

Choix de traduction : j’ai privilégié un français professionnel naturel, adapté à une offre d’emploi au Canada, tout en conservant les termes techniques reconnus comme FHIR, SNOMED, CDISC, IDMP, RDF/OWL, Python et SQL.


Sr.Health Data Semantics Consultant

About IQVIA

IQVIA is a global provider of advanced analytics, technology solutions, and clinical research services to the life sciences industry. We bring together data, technology, and expertise to help healthcare organizations make better decisions, accelerate innovation, and improve patient outcomes.

Within IQVIA, the Centre for Health Data Semantics provides advisory services and technology solutions that help clients unlock the value of their data through semantics and interoperability.

Job Overview

This role contributes to the development and delivery of high-quality solutions for client engagements, with a focus on helping clients implement semantic technologies, interoperability standards, and data-driven approaches.

Assignments range from requirements analysis and problem-solving to supporting the development of more complex solutions. You will collaborate with distributed project teams and subject matter experts across the healthcare and life sciences sectors.

The role is well suited to someone with a strong interest in healthcare data, semantic technologies, interoperability, knowledge graphs, and AI, combined with the ability to understand client requirements and translate them into practical solutions.

Essential Functions

  • Review and analyze client requirements and business challenges and contribute to proposal development.
  • Identify issues and contribute to the development of appropriate solutions, implementation strategies, and roadmaps.
  • Assess the potential business value of semantic technologies and approaches.
  • Develop detailed project documentation, business and technical requirements, and specifications.
  • Support Analysts and Consultants in developing and structuring presentations, recommendations, and client deliverables.
  • Work with healthcare and life sciences data using relevant standards, semantic technologies, and interoperability approaches.
  • Support projects involving semantic models, knowledge graphs, and AI-related use cases, where applicable.
  • Use Python, SQL, or similar scripting/query languages to work with and analyze data.
  • Develop knowledge of consulting services, methodologies, and the pharmaceutical, healthcare, and life sciences industries.
  • In a Business Analyst capacity, validate client deliverables and provide direction to offshore project teams.
  • Collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary and geographically distributed teams to support successful project delivery.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required. An advanced degree or relevant educational background in a computational, medical, life sciences, or related discipline is highly valued.
  • 3–5 years of professional experience, preferably within healthcare and/or life sciences environments.
  • Good understanding of healthcare data standards and semantic technologies, including areas such as:
    • FHIR
    • SNOMED
    • CDISC
    • IDMP
    • RDF/OWL
    • FAIR data principles
  • Specialist-level expertise across all of these areas is not expected. Candidates should have strong knowledge in selected areas while maintaining a broader understanding of the semantics and interoperability landscape.
  • Basic understanding of AI and knowledge graphs and their application within healthcare and life sciences contexts, including basic AI literacy.
  • Ability to work with data using Python, SQL, or similar scripting/query languages.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into clear, practical solutions.
  • Ability to work effectively and collaboratively across the organization to accomplish team and project goals.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Knowledge of consulting methodologies, tools, and techniques relevant to the functional area is preferred.
  • Understanding of relevant industry trends, developments, and the competitive landscape is preferred.

What You’ll Bring

You bring expertise and a strong interest in semantics and interoperability, along with a desire to improve healthcare and life sciences by helping organizations better leverage their data.

You have a collaborative and client-focused mindset, strong analytical capabilities, and the ability to translate complex business and data requirements into practical solutions.

You are comfortable working across multidisciplinary teams, supporting client-facing engagements, and coordinating work across onshore and offshore teams. You also bring an interest in emerging technologies, including AI and knowledge graphs, and understand how these technologies can complement semantic and interoperable data environments.

If you are looking to advance your career in a new planning and scheduling leadership role, this is the opportunity for you! The Senior Program Planning and Scheduling Manager oversees the development, management, and optimization of integrated master plans and schedules for the most complex and strategic programs within the Aerospace and Defense industry. This senior leadership role ensures effective coordination, risk management, and alignment with program objectives, while driving continuous improvement in project planning and execution processes. The Senior Program Planning and Scheduling Manager provides strategic direction, resolves high-level conflicts, and mentors program planning and scheduling teams.

Responsibilities:

  • Oversee the preparation, development, and coordination of integrated master plans and schedules for highly complex and strategic programs.
  • Ensure effective tracking and maintenance of project plans and schedules to guarantee horizontal and vertical integration across the enterprise.
  • Lead advanced risk analysis efforts to identify, assess, and mitigate significant schedule risks, ensuring robust project execution.
  • Resolve critical path and network logic conflicts using advanced project management techniques, including Gantt, Program Evaluation and Review Technique (PERT), and milestone charts.
  • Evaluate schedule compliance at an organizational level, identifying and addressing underlying reasons for major completion shortfalls through strategic interventions.
  • Prepare and present highly detailed and insightful reports and presentations on schedule status to senior stakeholders and executive leadership, providing strategic insights and actionable recommendations.
  • Foster and enhance collaboration with cross-functional teams to ensure accurate, timely, and comprehensive scheduling data, promoting effective communication and coordination across the organization.
  • Champion the development and implementation of advanced scheduling best practices, supporting program management and driving continuous improvement initiatives across the organization.
  • Mentor and guide junior and intermediate analysts on advanced scheduling techniques and best practices, fostering a culture of learning and professional development within the team.
  • Actively participate in strategic planning and decision-making processes, leveraging scheduling expertise to influence and shape organizational strategy and priorities, and ensuring alignment with overall business objectives.

Qualifications You Must Have:

  • Bachelor’s degree targeting Project Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field
  • 11+ years of experience in program planning and scheduling, with at least 4+ years in a leadership role.
  • Relevant experience can be considered as a substitute for the required educational qualifications. In the absence of a degree, a minimum of 15 years of related experience is required.
  • Higher level relevant degree may substitute for experience.
  • Proven leadership abilities inclusive of successful change management, mentoring, career development, training, succession planning, holding people accountable, and conducting yearly reviews.
  • Advanced skills in Microsoft Project Professional or other similar scheduling tool and familiarity with Earned Value Management (EVM) Tools.
  • Proven experience in the development and maintenance of resource loaded integrated master schedules to include detailed schedule analysis, health assessments, schedule risk assessments, and critical/driving path analysis.
  • The ability to obtain and maintain a Secret U.S. Security Clearance is required

Qualifications We Prefer:

  • Extensive experience with project management tools such as Microsoft Project or similar schedule toolset.
  • In-depth knowledge of Earned Value Management (EVM) principles and systems.
  • Comprehensive understanding of DCMA 14-point & IPMDAR DI_MGMT-81861.
  • Strong understanding of Mil Standard 881.
  • Proven experience with Earned Value Management Systems (EVMS).
  • Advanced application of Critical Path Analysis and Schedule Risk Analysis.
  • Proficient in Schedule Performance and Health Metric Analysis.
  • Strong knowledge of engineering design and life cycle concepts.
  • Expert ability to assemble and build Integrated Master Schedules (IMS).
  • Deep understanding of Event versus Product based schedules.
  • Proficient in Integrated Master Plan (IMP) and Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) development.
  • Thorough understanding of Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) development.
  • Extensive experience in the development and maintenance of resource-loaded integrated master schedules, including detailed schedule analysis, rolling wave planning, health assessments, schedule risk assessments, and critical/driving path analysis.
  • Skilled in the facilitation of resource leveling, validation of remaining work, identification and resolution of critical path conflicts, and analysis of impacts to schedule of any proposed changes.
  • Experience in coaching, mentoring, and teaching team members.
  • Ability to work across multiple software systems and comprehend system relationships.
  • Ability to develop and conduct relevant stakeholder learning sessions.
  • Strong foundational understanding of Program Management processes.
  • Knowledge of DoD, government contracting, and/or public auditing policies, standards, and procedures.
  • Ability to support the development and delivery of key employee training, including new employee onboarding, continuous education curriculum, and certification testing.
  • Spearhead the coordination, generation, and integration of Schedule Risk Assessments (SRA) for enterprise-level projects.
  • Drive the analysis of schedule data to uncover critical risks and opportunities.
  • Present high-level, strategic reports and insights to executive leadership and key stakeholders.

Essential Functions:

  • Ability to work in an office or hybrid environment.
  • Ability to work on a computer for extended periods.
  • Strong hand/finger dexterity for computer tasks.
  • May require occasional travel for training or meetings.

This posting will be open for application for a minimum of 5 days and may be extended based on business needs.

Responsibilities:

Assists pharmacists by compounding, preparing, labelling, and dispensing medications under the direct supervision of a licensed pharmacist. Maintains all requirements for licensure as a registered pharmacy technician, in accordance with New York State Education Law, and performs duties consistent with medication compounding. Identifies problems and provides basic troubleshooting skills to maintain operation of technology to ensure the highest level of safety. Participates in and reinforces environmental monitoring and compliance required by USP standards.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  • Uses and maintains technology and equipment utilized in compounding processes, including workflow devices, robotics, and computer software. Identifies problems and provides basic troubleshooting skills to maintain operation of technology to ensure the highest level of safety in the compounding process. Maintains understanding of eRecord functions, including accessing rate information to provide calculations for required volume production. Effectively utilizes information resources related to compounding processes, including master formulations, compounding records, etc.
  • Demonstrates competency selecting appropriate products or devices for compounding processes. Familiar with and follows all departmental policies and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) related to compounding processes. Follows processes that comply with USP standards, including USP chapters 795, 797, and 800, including but not limited to, assigning appropriate Beyond Use Date (BUD), storage of medications including hazardous medications, proper garbing procedures and use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), proper aseptic technique and processes, cleaning and disinfecting, etc. Utilizes specialized compounding technique related to specific medication preparation requirements. Anticipates patient compounding needs based on orders or information provided to the compounding area. Understands and follows required procedures for storage and disposal of controlled substances, pharmaceutical waste, blood/plasma containing products and hazardous materials. Identifies and reports any safety concerns in the compounding processes to pharmacists and/or supervisor as appropriate. Implements plans related to reduction of waste within the compounding area(s). Understands and follows quarantine and sterility testing procedures as defined in USP standards for compounded medications and extended BUDs.
  • Completes other assigned tasks appropriate for certified pharmacy technicians, including but not limited to, medication order fulfillment, restocking areas, re-packaging of medications, answering and triaging telephone calls, medications delivery, and use of other technology integrated into the medication use system.
  • Participates in and reinforces environmental monitoring and compliance required by USP standards. Demonstrates appropriate infection prevention processes and techniques. Demonstrates and implements mitigating strategies related to protecting oneself and environment in handling medications, including hazardous medications. Understands and maintains USP and Joint Commission compliance related to compounding oversight and quality standards.
  • Completes and comprehends all assigned educational materials specific to compounding, including ASHP training videos on Aseptic Technique, Safe Handling of Hazardous Drugs and Non-Sterile Compounding (if applicable). Completes comprehensive Technician Training and Competency Assessment Tool which includes verbal review, assigned reading material, observation/demonstration, verbal and written testing. Successful completion and evidence of compliance for all aseptic skills tests required, including periodic recertification. Successful completion and passing score for required written compounding exam, including re-examination assignments. Complete technology re-assessment and recertification as required. Other ongoing training/competency as assigned, including non-compounding technician duties as required.
  • Other duties as assigned.

MINIMUM EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

  • High School diploma required
  • 3 years of experience preferred
  • Or equivalent combination of education and experience
  • Completion of all departmental required education for compounding services preferred

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

  • Be of good moral character, including application of ICARE values required

LICENSES AND CERTIFICATIONS

  • Completed ASHP accredited training program or equivalent experience as a pharmacy technician upon hire required
  • Certification from a nationally accredited pharmacy technician certification program (Currently PTCB) and maintain ongoing education requirements upon hire required
  • PHRMTECH-R - Registered Pharmacy Technician upon hire required

title: Manager, Scotia Club (14-month contract)
description:
Powered by Passion. United by Purpose. Build for Impact.

At Maple Leaf Sports & Entertainment Partnership (MLSE), we exist to deliver the ultimate fan experience by lifting trophies, spirits, and communities – united as one.

We're more than a workplace. We are a team of passionate people, boldly building the future of sport and entertainment, together. We believe in the power of play, the strength of collaboration, and the energy that comes from showing up with purpose.

From the ice to the pitch, the hardwood to the digital arena, we’re proud to be the driving force behind the Toronto Maple Leafs (NHL), the Toronto Raptors (NBA), Toronto FC (MLS), Toronto Argonauts (CFL) and development teams with the Toronto Marlies (AHL), Raptors 905 (NBA G League), Toronto FC II (MLS NEXT Pro League) and Raptors Uprising Gaming Club, the Toronto Raptors Esports franchise in the NBA 2K League.

We bring these teams – and world-class entertainment – to life at our iconic venues, including Scotiabank Arena, BMO Field, Coca-Cola Coliseum, Ford Performance Centre, BMO Training Ground, and OVO Athletic Centre. Off the field, we serve up elevated dining at e11even, Real Sports, and our signature club spaces like Hot Stove Club, ScotiaClub, and Platinum Club.

Through MLSE Foundation and MLSE LaunchPad, we use the power of sport to help youth facing barriers reach their full potential. Since 2009, we’ve invested more than $45 million into Ontario communities -- and we’re just getting started.

This is what it means to be One MLSE: a culture where everyone plays a role, everyone belongs, and everyone contributes to something bigger than themselves.

So, if you're ready to play with purpose, grow with passion, and win as one, we’d love to have you on our team.

** We know that great candidates come from a variety of backgrounds and experiences. Even if you do not meet every qualification listed, we encourage you to apply. Your unique perspective, transferable skills, and lived experience may be exactly what we’re looking for. **

Job Description

As the Manager, Scotia Club, you will play an integral role in leading one of Scotiabank Arena’s premium food and beverage experiences. You will provide leadership across all aspects of the Scotia Club operation, creating an exceptional environment for our guests while driving operational excellence, team engagement, and strong business performance.


As a member of the MLSE Restaurants & Catering team, you will lead and develop the Scotia Club team while working closely with Culinary and key partners across MLSE. You will oversee the restaurant and bar operation, guest experience, programming, purchasing, financial performance, and day-to-day execution, ensuring every experience reflects MLSE’s service standards and commitment to hospitality excellence.


RESPONSIBILITIES


  • Lead all aspects of the Scotia Club operation, including restaurant and bar service, guest experience, programming, purchasing, inventory, and operational execution.
  • Provide consistent leadership, coaching, and mentorship to supervisors and team members, creating an engaged, accountable, and high-performing team.
  • Foster a collaborative One Team culture while ensuring MLSE’s Vision, Values, service standards, and operating policies guide the team’s approach.
  • Create a welcoming, elevated, and memorable hospitality experience by maintaining a strong presence in the operation and proactively responding to guest needs and feedback.
  • Develop and execute operating strategies and business plans that support the continued success and evolution of Scotia Club.
  • Prepare, manage, and monitor operating and capital budgets, identifying opportunities to grow revenue, manage expenses, and achieve financial targets.
  • Maintain effective sales tracking, inventory management, purchasing, cost-control, and financial procedures.
  • Partner closely with Culinary to ensure food and beverage quality, menu execution, service standards, and the overall guest experience are consistently delivered.
  • Work collaboratively with Finance, IT, Human Resources, Scheduling, and other internal partners to support the employees and operational requirements of Scotia Club.
  • Partner with Marketing, Global Partnerships, Consumer Products, Live Entertainment, and other MLSE teams to support programming, activations, promotional initiatives, and business objectives.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with guests, clients, business partners, suppliers, and internal stakeholders.
  • Identify opportunities to evolve Scotia Club programming, experiences, and events while supporting revenue growth and guest engagement.
  • Ensure appropriate staffing, training, operating procedures, and resources are in place to deliver consistent service and operational excellence.
  • Monitor operational performance and proactively identify opportunities to improve efficiency, service, profitability, and the overall guest experience.
  • Respond effectively to operational challenges and guest concerns, leading service recovery when required.
  • Ensure compliance with food safety, liquor licensing, Smart Serve, WHMIS, Occupational Health & Safety, and all applicable MLSE operating standards and policies.
  • Perform additional responsibilities as required to support the success of the Scotia Club and MLSE Restaurants & Catering team.

REQUIREMENTS


  • 3+ years of progressive management experience in food and beverage, restaurant, hotel, premium hospitality, or event-based operations.
  • Demonstrated experience leading a high-volume restaurant, bar, or premium hospitality operation.
  • Post-secondary education in Business, Hospitality, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Proven ability to lead, coach, motivate, and develop diverse teams in a fast-paced hospitality environment.
  • Strong financial acumen with experience managing operating budgets, labour, purchasing, inventory, revenue performance, and cost-control initiatives.
  • A genuine passion for hospitality and an ongoing awareness of guest needs, service quality, and opportunities to enhance the guest experience.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to identify opportunities, develop strategies, and translate ideas into operational results.
  • Excellent interpersonal, presentation, communication, and relationship-building skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to build productive relationships with internal stakeholders, external partners, suppliers, and guests.
  • Strong planning, organizational, and decision-making skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • A proactive and solutions-focused approach, with the ability to adapt quickly to changing business and operational needs.
  • Ability to remain composed and make sound decisions in a high-volume, fast-paced environment.
  • Strong knowledge of food, wine, beer, spirits, restaurant service, and premium hospitality standards.
  • Smart Serve Certification required.
  • Knowledge of WHMIS and recognized food-safety practices or certification such as ServSafe, NFSTP, or equivalent.
  • A positive, professional, and team-first approach with a high degree of integrity, confidentiality, and discretion.
  • Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and holidays based on the Scotiabank Arena event and business schedule.

Please note this position is a 14-month parental leave contract with vacation and medical benefits.


Please apply by Sunday, November 9 at 11:59 pm.

$70,000 - 75,000 annual base, plus vacation and medical benefits.

title: Fit Out Manager (West Cairo)
description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

Role Purpose

We are seeking an experienced and technically proficient Fit-Out Manager with a strong MEP and Architecture background to lead the design development, technical coordination, and delivery of MEP and architectural fit-out activities across retail, F&B, administration office, and commercial units. This role combines hands-on site management with technical design oversight, ensuring design intent, buildability, and full compliance with property standards, approved specifications, and mall requirements throughout the fit-out lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

Design Development and Technical Coordination

The Fit-Out Manager leads fit-out design development, space planning, and technical detailing, ensuring design intent, functionality, and buildability are maintained throughout project delivery. This includes reviewing and coordinating architectural, interior, structural, civil, and MEP drawings, identifying design clashes, resolving technical constraints, and ensuring seamless integration of all building services. The role oversees the preparation, technical review, and approval of construction drawings, shop drawings, reflected ceiling plans, joinery details, material submittals, and project specifications.

Multidisciplinary Coordination and Approvals

The Fit-Out Manager drives multidisciplinary coordination with tenants, consultants, contractors, suppliers, and project stakeholders to resolve RFIs, manage design revisions, and secure statutory approvals, NOCs, and mall/building management clearances. This includes reviewing tenant design submissions, shop drawings, material specifications and fit-out proposals, and coordinating closely with mall operations to ensure compliance with approved requirements and RDD standards.

Site Monitoring and Quality Control

The role requires conducting regular site inspections and monitoring fit-out works to ensure quality and compliance with approved drawings, specifications, and engineering standards. The Fit-Out Manager evaluates materials, finishes, construction methodologies, and site conditions to ensure compliance, durability, constructability, and alignment with project requirements, coordinating architectural works with MEP and other disciplines as needed. Technical observations, non-conformances, and corrective actions are tracked and followed through to resolution, along with oversight of technical inspections, testing coordination, and project handover to ensure completed works meet approved design intent and operational requirements.

Cost, Schedule, and Compliance Management

The Fit-Out Manager supports cost optimization and value engineering through BOQ reviews, specification assessments, and design variation control, while mitigating technical and commercial risks. This includes managing design deliverables, submission schedules, quality compliance, and technical interfaces to ensure timely execution in accordance with contractual obligations and project standards, as well as supporting enforcement of the mall's RDD/fit-out requirements and technical specifications.

Leadership and Stakeholder Management

The Fit-Out Manager leads the fit-out department within the property, managing the fit-out team and maintaining professional, effective communication with tenants, consultants, contractors, and key stakeholders. The role includes preparing technical and progress reports, following up on work progress with management, and ensuring strong interfacing and relationship management with clients, tenants, and government entities.

Required Qualifications and Experience

Academic Qualifications

A Bachelor's degree in Architecture, MEP (Mechanical/Electrical Engineering), Interior Design, or a related technical discipline is mandatory. Candidates with complementary knowledge across both architectural and MEP disciplines are strongly preferred given the dual technical scope of this role.

Professional Experience

A minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in interior fit-out design, technical coordination, RDD, or MEP/architectural supervision or project coordination is required, preferably within a fit-out contractor, design-and-build, or mall/retail environment. Experience must include retail, shopping malls, F&B, or commercial projects, with proven experience managing fit-out design packages from concept development through technical documentation and site implementation. Demonstrated schedule recovery cases, authority/landlord approval experience, and vendor management are highly valued.

Technical Skills

Candidates should be fluent in reading and marking up interior design, architectural, MEP, and joinery drawings, with spec governance experience including spec books, spec sections, and submittal workflows. Proficiency in AutoCAD is required, along with familiarity with MS Project/Primavera, SketchUp, Bluebeam, InDesign, or similar tools. A strong understanding of RDD standards, Egypt fit-out approval procedures, authority requirements, and building management guidelines is essential, along with the ability to review and resolve technical conflicts across architectural and MEP scopes.

Personal Skills

The role requires strong communication, coordination, and stakeholder-management skills, with an effective and consistent site presence to provide direct on-site supervision across trades. Strong leadership and team management capabilities are essential, including performance evaluation and identification of training needs, along with excellent organizational and follow-up skills and the ability to work within a multidisciplinary team.

Location

Preferably residing in West Cairo.
