title: Software Engineer, Professional I
description:
Overview:

At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer’s and partner’s needs and solve their challenges.


Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve.

You’ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about—locally and globally.


Come make an impact every day at Zebra.


What We're Looking For:

Your Team and Mission:

As a WLAN Testing and Solutions Engineer in Holtsville, NY, you will join the Connectivity team within the Zebra Enterprise Mobility and Visibility organization. Our mission is to deliver seamless, robust voice and data network connectivity solutions to our enterprise customers worldwide. These wireless configurations act as the critical lifelines powering mission-critical business applications, ensuring warehouse personnel, healthcare workers, and retail staff can run their operations globally without interruption.

Your Impact:

You will play a vital role in validating, designing, and testing complex customer use cases for our next-generation WLAN and Bluetooth solutions. By maintaining and updating our core lab environments and developing automated test suites, you directly contribute to the quality and reliability of the connectivity modules inside millions of Zebra devices globally. Your work will directly expand our value proposition, ensuring that our mobile hardware remains the industry benchmark for wireless performance and seamless enterprise-grade roaming.

Location: Role is based in Holtsville, NY - Hybrid/3 days onsite

Responsibilities:

  • Establishes requirements for less complex Android networking software components and network protocol stack designs.
  • Works on Completing all phases of software engineering design and WLAN testing projects.
  • Works on analysis of test processes and delivers results to necessary stakeholders.
  • Analyzes test results and recommends solutions for wireless performance.
  • Works on developing expected results on a variety of Zebra mobile products.
  • Develops documentation for new projects (including functional test plans and requirements) and reviews previous results.
  • Works with latest technologies and new approaches in automated and manual WLAN testing.
  • Reviews changes or upgrades to existing designs or tests.
  • Exercises judgment in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions on assignments.

Qualifications:

Minimum

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering - Computer Science/ Electrical Engineering/ Electronics Engineering.
  • Solid understanding of WiFi 802.11 principles and functionality. Must be able to speak to topics including Wi-Fi roaming logic, security protocols, TCP/IP, DHCP, etc.
  • Experience with embedded systems and Android Automation using Python, Perl etc

Preferred:

  • Basic understanding of machine learning concepts (training, validation, overfitting, evaluation metrics)
  • Proficient in defining the Wi-Fi solution test setup, installing, and configuring to meet multiple enterprise use case.
  • Familiar with Android debugging capability and able to pull logs, read logs and narrow down the area of problem.
  • Capable in handling Wireshark and omni peek wireless sniffer tools to capture wireless packets and analyze the network and device problems for various 802.11 protocols.
  • Proficient in installing and configuring different Wi-Fi infrastructure access point and wireless controller from Cisco, Aruba, Extreme, Ruckus etc.
  • Quantitative and problem-solving skills.

title: Director, Site Enablement Solutions
description:
Director, Strategic Growth & Customer Partnerships.


IQVIA is changing an entire industry through inspired innovation. Our people make the difference. We believe great ideas can come from anywhere, and we look for talented people and give them meaningful work to do. Join IQVIA and help us drive healthcare forward.

Job Overview


IQVIA Site Enablement Solutions provides site-based clinical research support designed to help sponsors and research sites address capacity, enrollment, and study execution challenges. Reporting to the Senior Director, Global Head of Site Enablement Solutions, the Director, Strategic Growth & Customer Partnerships will lead execution of the business growth strategy through strategic account planning, executive customer engagement, customer expansion, opportunity conversion, and commercialization of emerging capabilities.


This is an execution-focused commercial leadership role requiring deep expertise in site support, site augmentation, and site engagement. The Director will develop customer-specific solutions and creative commercial structures that balance customer needs with pricing, geographic reach, implementation requirements, and operational delivery feasibility. The role will be dedicated to Site Enablement Solutions and will work across Business Development, Operations, Delivery, Finance, Marketing, Technology, and Strategy to convert opportunities into sustainable, deliverable partnerships.

Responsabilities:


  • Lead strategic account planning and growth execution across priority customer relationships.
  • Develop account-specific expansion plans across therapeutic areas, geographies, studies, and delivery models to increase adoption and support repeatable, multi-study growth.
  • Convert study-level and country-level engagements into broader portfolio and enterprise relationships.
  • Build and maintain executive customer relationships, stakeholder maps, sponsorship models, and governance approaches.
  • Identify and advance competitive opportunities where IQVIA can differentiate through global reach, flexibility, integrated capabilities, and measurable customer outcomes.
  • Lead the design of customized site support solutions and commercial structures that align customer requirements with operational feasibility and sustainable delivery.
  • Partner with Business Development and account teams throughout opportunity qualification, solution development, proposal strategy, pricing, negotiation, and bid defense.
  • Increase inclusion and penetration of site support solutions within Full Service opportunities, particularly programs where site capacity or enrollment risk is material.
  • Create repeatable frameworks for account growth, opportunity follow-up, pipeline-to-revenue tracking, objection handling, and conversion discipline.
  • Support competitive pricing approaches, quantified value assumptions, and commercially viable alternatives in collaboration with Finance, Strategy, and Delivery.
  • Translate emerging capabilities into clear, customer-ready propositions, use cases, and integrated solution pathways.
  • Strengthen value articulation through return-on-investment models, key performance indicator frameworks, case studies, proof points, and differentiated customer storytelling.
  • Partner with Delivery and regional teams to incorporate country readiness, resource models, contracting, pricing, and implementation requirements into commercial planning.
  • Capture customer and market feedback and translate insights into offering, process, technology, and geographic expansion priorities.
  • Serve as a member of the Site Enablement Solutions leadership team and provide visible ownership of the growth agenda.
  • Partner with customer-facing and operational leaders to strengthen account management maturity and commercial effectiveness.
  • Establish disciplined account reviews, opportunity ownership, executive stakeholder mapping, and progress reporting against growth priorities.
  • Provide coaching and subject matter guidance to colleagues supporting customer engagement and solution positioning.
  • Initially operate as an individual contributor; the role may assume leadership of customer-aligned delivery resources as the operating model and business needs evolve.

Minimun Requires Education and Experience:


  • Bachelor's degree in healthcare, life sciences, business, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in clinical research, healthcare services, contract research organization services, site services, or a related life sciences environment.
  • Demonstrated experience in strategic account management, customer partnerships, commercial growth, solution development, or business development.
  • Demonstrated experience in site support, site augmentation, site engagement, enrollment acceleration, or related patient and site services.
  • Experience designing and negotiating complex, customized service solutions that require alignment across commercial and operational stakeholders.
  • Experience engaging senior stakeholders within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or clinical research organizations.
  • Experience working within global and highly matrixed organizations.

Additonal Skilss:


  • Deep understanding of clinical trial operations, research-site workflows, site capacity constraints, and sponsor decision-making.
  • Strong commercial judgment and ability to balance customer value, competitive positioning, pricing, operational feasibility, and financial sustainability.
  • Ability to convert strategic priorities into executable account plans and measurable actions.
  • Executive-level communication, influencing, relationship management, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to lead through influence across Business Development, Operations, Delivery, Finance, Marketing, Technology, and Strategy.
  • Strong problem-solving, negotiation, organizational, and prioritization skills.
  • Ability to work effectively across cultures, regions, and time zones, with strong command of English.
  • Knowledge of global delivery models, resource sourcing, site contracting, and country activation considerations is preferred.
  • Experience coaching or leading customer-facing teams is preferred.

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at

description:
Job Profile:

Administrative Operations Specialist 3

Job Family:

Apply before 11:59 PM Arizona time the day before the posted End Date.

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree and five (5) years of experience appropriate to the area of assignment/field; OR, Any equivalent combination of experience and/or training from which comparable knowledge, skills and abilities have been achieved.

Job Profile Summary:
Supports and instructs those served by the department with complex queries, applies specialized knowledge of multiple standards, policies and procedures, and maintains accurate and detailed records.

Job Description:

Salary Range: $75,000 - $85,000 per year; DOE

About the University Innovation Alliance

The University Innovation Alliance is a national coalition of public research universities working together to improve student success and post graduate economic mobility, particularly for low-income students, first-generation college students, and students of color. UIA member institutions collaborate to design, test, refine, and scale practices that help more students persist, graduate, and successfully transition from college to careers. In 2025, the UIA aligned on expanded impact goals. One of the expanded goals is focused on improving value and mobility for students. The future ready graduates initiative is a direct result of the UIA now focusing on student success beyond degree completion. The UIA has secured 2 grant projects under this initiative and anticipates securing another 2 in the next year.

About Future Ready Graduates

Future Ready Graduates is UIA’s portfolio of work focused on helping member institutions expand and improve the number of work based learning experiences available to students to support their career preparation and employment outcomes. Current FRG projects are focused on work integrated learning redesign (focus on internships and project based learning) and student employment redesign leveraging a partnership with the Work + team at ASU. Through coordinated grant-funded initiatives, UIA supports campuses in redesigning student experiences, improving access to meaningful paid opportunities, strengthening employer partnerships, and connecting work-based learning more directly to persistence, completion, and career outcomes.

Position Summary

The Grant Program Manager, Future Ready Graduates is responsible for the day-to-day delivery, implementation, coordination, and program management of UIA’s Future Ready Graduates grant portfolio. The position will initially manage delivery of two active awards and may assume responsibility for up to two additional awards.

The Program Manager will coordinate participating campuses, partners, consultants, employers, and internal UIA contributors to ensure that project activities are completed on time, meet funder commitments, and achieve the expected level of quality. This role will maintain project plans, monitor campus progress, facilitate meetings and events, organize employer feedback processes, maintain accurate records in Salesforce and Google Drive, and represent program implementation during funder meetings and written updates.

The ideal candidate is a highly organized and collaborative program manager who can manage multiple grants and campus workstreams simultaneously. This person will be skilled at setting clear expectations, holding partners accountable, identifying risks early, and helping campus teams translate project requirements into practical implementation.

Key Responsibilities

Grant Portfolio Management

  • Manage the implementation and operations of two active Future Ready Graduates awards, with the potential to manage up to two additional related awards.

  • Translate grant agreements, workplans, budgets, milestones, and funder commitments into coordinated implementation plans.

  • Develop and maintain project plans that identify activities, owners, deadlines, dependencies, decision points, and required deliverables.

  • Monitor implementation across all assigned awards and provide regular updates on progress, risks, delays, and resource needs.

  • Ensure work is delivered on time, within the approved scope, and at the level of quality expected by UIA and its funding partners.

  • Coordinate overlapping activities and shared deliverables across awards so that the Future Ready Graduates portfolio operates as a cohesive body of work.

  • Support grant launch, implementation, reporting, evaluation, dissemination, and closeout activities.

Campus Implementation and Accountability

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for campus teams participating in assigned Future Ready Graduates projects.

  • Lead campus onboarding and establish clear expectations for participation, implementation, reporting, and deliverable quality.

  • Help campuses translate grant requirements into campus-specific implementation plans, milestones, and workstreams.

  • Monitor progress toward campus deliverables and follow up regularly to address missed deadlines, incomplete work, or implementation barriers.

  • Review campus submissions and project materials for completeness, alignment, and quality.

  • Coordinate coaching, technical assistance, and problem-solving support with ASU Work+, consultants, evaluators, and other subject-matter experts.

  • Maintain regular communication with campus leads and ensure institutional teams remain engaged throughout the project period.

Employer Engagement and Feedback Loops

  • Work with UIA colleagues and campus teams to recruit and engage employers as project advisors, co-design partners, and sources of ongoing feedback.

  • Establish and maintain structured employer feedback loops across the Future Ready Graduates portfolio.

  • Plan employer listening sessions, validation meetings, feedback activities, and other engagement opportunities.

  • Ensure employer perspectives inform program design, student journey redesign, implementation testing, and refinement.

  • Document employer feedback and help campus teams translate it into actionable program or system improvements.

  • Track how employer input influences campus decisions and project outcomes. Employer feedback is intended to be embedded throughout the redesign cycle, including discovery, prototype validation, implementation, and planning for scale.

Meetings, Convenings, and Project Events

  • Plan and coordinate project-based meetings, campus working sessions, communities of practice, workshops, employer sessions, and in-person convenings.

  • Develop agendas, participant materials, timelines, run-of-show documents, and follow-up communications.

  • Facilitate selected meetings and working sessions and coordinate facilitation by ASU Work+, consultants, or other partners.

  • Organize cross-campus learning opportunities that allow institutions to compare progress, troubleshoot barriers, and refine their approaches.

  • Coordinate event logistics in partnership with UIA’s Campus Engagement & Events Manager and operations staff.

  • Capture decisions, action items, and follow-up responsibilities after project meetings.

Funder Engagement and Reporting

  • Prepare updates, project summaries, briefing materials, and talking points for funder meetings.

  • Maintain documentation needed to demonstrate progress against funder commitments.

  • Identify risks or changes that may require early communication, funder guidance, or formal approval.

  • Support preparation of continuation requests, change requests, final reports, and grant-closeout materials.

Project Records and Knowledge Management

  • Maintain complete, accurate, and current project records in Salesforce and Google Drive.

  • Establish and maintain a clear folder structure, naming conventions, version-control practices, and documentation standards.

  • Record campus participation, meetings, milestones, deliverables, decisions, risks, employer engagement, and follow-up activities in Salesforce.

  • Ensure key documents, reports, workplans, participant materials, and final deliverables are stored consistently and accessible to the appropriate team members.

  • Maintain project calendars, trackers, contact lists, reporting schedules, and shared implementation tools.

  • Support development of standard templates and processes that can be used across the Future Ready Graduates portfolio.

Progress Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning Capture

  • Track progress toward grant milestones, deliverables, campus participation targets, and intended outcomes.

  • Coordinate collection of implementation updates, participation data, feedback, and supporting documentation from campuses and partners.

  • Work with evaluators and internal partners to ensure campuses understand data requirements and submit information on schedule.

  • Identify common implementation barriers, promising practices, and conditions that influence success across participating institutions.

  • Help translate project learning into case studies, playbooks, implementation guides, employer-feedback resources, and other materials for broader diffusion.

  • Support final evaluation, synthesis, dissemination, and planning for scale.

  • Design and develop evaluation frameworks, data collection instruments, templates, surveys, interview protocols, rubrics, dashboards, and reporting processes that enable campuses to consistently collect, analyze, and use implementation and outcome data.

  • Design AI-enabled workflows that transform complex institutional data into actionable insights, scalable evaluation processes, and decision-making resources.

The Future Ready Graduates work plan calls for shared resources such as campus case studies, dashboard guidance, employer feedback-loop templates, implementation guidance, and a strategy for broader diffusion.

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Work across UIA’s program, learning, development, finance, operations, communications, and campus-engagement functions.

  • Establish clear ownership, review processes, and deadlines for work requiring contributions from multiple teams.

  • Coordinate with the Business Operations & Finance Manager on budgets, campus stipends, contracts, and grant-related financial processes.

  • Coordinate with communications staff on external storytelling, case studies, dissemination, and project visibility.

  • Perform other duties as assigned in support of Future Ready Graduates and UIA’s student-success portfolio.

Desired Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in higher education, education, workforce development, nonprofit management, public administration, project management, or a related field.

  • 3-5 years of relevant experience in program management, grant implementation, higher education, workforce development, student success, or a related area.

  • Demonstrated experience managing multiple complex projects or grants with overlapping milestones and stakeholder groups.

  • Strong experience managing workplans, deliverables, deadlines, risks, and cross-functional dependencies.

  • Ability to hold partners and participating teams accountable while maintaining constructive, collaborative relationships.

  • Experience organizing and facilitating meetings, convenings, workshops, or communities of practice.

  • Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and follow-through.

  • Ability to manage several active workstreams and adjust priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Ability to work independently while maintaining consistent communication across a distributed team.

  • Commitment to improving career readiness and postsecondary outcomes for students.

  • Experience using Salesforce, Google Workspace, and project-management platforms.

  • Experience working in a remote team environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with student employment, paid work-based learning, internships, career readiness, experiential learning, or employer engagement.

  • Experience managing a portfolio of related grants or initiatives.

  • Experience working with employer partners and developing structured feedback or advisory processes.

  • Familiarity with design thinking, human-centered design, service design, process mapping, or journey mapping.

  • Demonstrated experience leveraging AI tools to support institutional evaluation, research, evidence synthesis, and continuous improvement.

Standard Working Environment:

  • Climate-controlled office setting subject to extended periods of being in a stationary position.

  • Regular use of a computer and other office productivity equipment, such as a calculator, copy machine, and printer.

Term of Appointment

This is a full-time, grant-funded position expected to continue for two years. Continuation throughout the two-year appointment is contingent upon satisfactory performance and the ongoing availability of grant funding. The position is not guaranteed to continue beyond the funded grant period.

The future ready graduates initiative is a direct result of the UIA now focusing on student success beyond degree completion. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

Mechatronics & Robotics Technician – JLL

What this job involves:

As a Mechatronics & Robotics Technician, you will use your skills to support the Operations Maintenance team in repairing and maintaining material handling equipment and pneumatic systems throughout the building. You will have the opportunity to install, maintain and repair automated packaging and distribution equipment. In addition to developing your skills, you will have the opportunity to mentor junior technicians to grow in their roles.

What your day-to-day will look like:

  • Promote a safe working environment by following all safety procedures

  • Complete preventative maintenance routines with proper documentation

  • Troubleshoot electrical and mechanical problems related to all Material Handling Equipment (MHE) which includes belts, motors, photo-eyes, relays, and more

  • Maintain a positive working relationship across all the Operations facility

  • Track and store department inventory

  • Move up to 49lbs as well as stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, with or without reasonable accommodation

  • Possible travel up to 20% at a minimum.

Required Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent

  • Ability to work flexible schedules/shifts/areas, including weekends, nights and/or holidays

  • 2+ years of experience in the repair of material handling equipment

  • 2+ years of experience conducting predictive and preventative maintenance procedures

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Associates or higher degree from a vocational school or college with a focus in the Mechanical or Electrical field

  • 2+ years of experience with automated conveyor systems and controls

  • 1+ years of blueprint and electrical schematic reading

  • 1+ year of knowledge with electrical and electronic principles

  • Experience with Material Handling Equipment (MHE) safety standards accordance with Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) and Safety standards

  • Experience with a Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS)

  • Experience with robotic or electromechanical operation and maintenance

  • Able to troubleshoot basic input and output functions

Physical Demands

  • Repetitive bending, crouching, kneeling, reaching, twisting, sitting, standing, and walking

  • Lifting parts and tools weighing on average 20 pounds, occasionally weighing up to 49 pounds

  • Dexterity in eye/hand coordination, feet (foot pedals) manual (picking, pinching, holding, grasping), and wrist motion (repetitive flexion/rotation)

  • Working conditions may include small spaces, dust, fumes/odors, hot/cold temperatures, inside/outside noise, vibration, standing on concrete for long hours and wet or uneven surfaces

  • Standing/walking on concrete surfaces for 10+ hour shifts

  • Working at heights (as stated previously)

  • Pushing/pulling wheeled equipment and carts up to 100+ pounds

  • Maneuvering awkward or bulky equipment parts

  • Working in cramped positions under/behind machinery

title: Sensor & Camera Engineer V
description:
Who We Are


Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.


What We Offer


Salary:

$176,000.00 - $242,000.00

Location:

Santa Clara,CA

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.

As a Systems Engineer, you’ll design, integrate, and optimize complex systems that drive the semiconductor industry forward. Your expertise in systems thinking and problem-solving is essential as you collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop advanced solutions to intricate processes and writing system specifications. You’ll be responsible for analyzing requirements, defining system architectures, conducting thorough testing, and ensuring seamless integration of subsystems. Additionally, you’ll identify and mitigate risks, confirming that our systems meet the highest quality standards and exceed customer expectations.

SUMMARY

Join high-performance engineering team at the forefront of semiconductor inspection & metrology technology development. As a Sensor & Camera Engineer you will be responsible for developing and implementing the roadmap for next generation sensors and sensing solutions. You’ll be part of culture that encourages learning, experimentation, and professional growth.


Role RESPONSIBILITIES

· Develop and own multi-generation sensor and camera system requirements

· Define and drive implementation of multi-year roadmap for sensor development

· Develop sensor design houses and vendors to meet performance, schedule, and cost targets

· Operate in close collaboration with program management, systems, marketing, hardware (optical engineering, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering), SW & Algo development teams.

· Come up with and spearhead novel technical sensing solutions to match market needs.

· Identify and troubleshoot a range of complex engineering problems. Guide system and electrical designers and engineers to implement and deliver solutions as a team.

· Operate as highly technical project manager and leader in semi-matrix system.

· Use effective communication and presentation skills and tools including clear and concise visual tools like diagrams and scorecards, leverage available and emerging analytical analysis and AI tools to drive the design and development decisions with incomplete information. Provide effective documentation.

· Conduct effective design reviews according to Program / PLC development process.

· Develop and implement sensor & camera calibrations, diagnostics, test plans and procedures.

· Support system integration and calibrations efforts.

· Collaborate effectively with and support SW development, manufacturing, reliability, and service teams. Generate requirements, procedures & guidance. Transfer engineering knowledge.


Minimum QUALIFICATIONS

· MS or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Optical Physics, or related technical field.

· Recognized expert on high speed & low noise optical sensors and cameras technology & development.

· 15+ years of experience, ideally in semiconductor capital equipment industry with track record.

title: Development Project Manager
description:
Who we are:

As a global leader in digital infrastructure, QTS designs, builds and operates advanced data centers that support strategic AI, cloud and digital transformation initiatives. We are driven by a mission to connect the world for good and our people make it possible. Every single day, the creativity, dedication and genuine care for our communities are what push us forward and make this a truly special place to be.

The Development Project Manager is primarily responsible for leading and managing the design, preconstruction and construction activities on a given project(s). The Project Manager will interact on a daily basis with Facilities, Contractors, Designers, Engineers, Commissioning Agents, Vendors, and Data Center Operations staff and should have both written and oral communication skills commensurate with this level of regular communication.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES includes the following. Other duties may be assigned.

  • Manage multiple projects on a campus(es) and maintain updated budgets, schedules, and status reports for each
  • Create and communicate updates on development program & project status on a monthly basis suitable for executive level reviews. Effectively present information in a manner to support efficient decision making
  • Work with QTS stakeholders, design, and construction teams to create a master development program for site(s), including a complete campus design solution and capital budget.
  • Manage entitlement and permitting needs for each assigned site project(s)
  • Implement and manage multi-phased site development plans to achieve time, budget, and quality standards in a predictable fashion. Continuously update a campus master plan to provide predictable statistics in a dynamic environment
  • Write scopes of work for design, construction, commissioning services & participate in procurement and project cost estimates
  • Evaluate and level pricing proposals for design, construction, and commissioning services
  • Work closely with strategic procurement team on equipment procurement and delivery process
  • Ensure appropriate submittals are coordinated with site stakeholders
  • Monitor & create project budget / cost-to-date against overall project budget.
  • Establish project schedules and manage teams to on-time completion
  • Review and approve monthly pay applications from the contractors
  • Review change order requests from contractors and negotiate pricing
  • Establish site construction security procedures in conjunction with site security team
  • Develop plans for product deployment and review / communicate plans with QTS staff involved
  • Collaborate with Sales Engineers and Product teams to aid in custom deal solutioning for prospective clients within the applicable schedule and budget for an assigned location.
  • Establish and maintain relationships serving as liaison with key QTS stakeholders
  • Represent QTS Interests as leader in OAC meetings
  • Create & build relationships that enhance QTS’s ability to be a leader in creating the World’s Most Valuable Data Center Real Estate
  • Aid in due diligence efforts for potential new sites on an as-needed basis
  • Work with the internal development team to enhance project management processes and protocols

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Science or Engineering or equivalent professional experience
  • Five or more years of professional experience in commercial construction practices and procedures, including management of Lump Sum, Construction Management @ Risk, and Design Build project delivery methods from conceptual development through procurement to close out
  • Experience with Microsoft Office suite, specifically PowerPoint for use in communicating program updates to executive level, and Excel to create and maintain site program & individual project budgets
  • Be able to travel up to 25% of the time

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • MBA, Masters in Engineering, Management, or related field desirable
  • Experience with delivery of mission critical data center facilities
  • Extensive experience with management of MEP trades

TOTAL REWARDS

This role is also eligible for a competitive beneﬁts package that includes: medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; 401(k) retirement plan; ﬂexible spending and HSA accounts; paid holidays; paid time off; paid volunteer days; employee assistance program; tuition assistance; parental leave; military leave assistance; QTS scholarship for dependents; wellness program, and other company beneﬁts.

title: Site Reliability Engineer Team Lead
description:
SilverTech is an award-winning digital experience agency, with team members across the country that thrives on combining big ideas and creative tech to solve today’s most challenging business problems. Our advanced skillsets and extensive experience have been proven to be successful in helping businesses achieve aggressive growth. Learn more about our team, values, and the individuals who have led the agency since its inception in 1996 at silvertech.com. Our vision is to set the standard for digital excellence by building proactive, enduring partnerships that move clients forward with clarity and confidence.


We are seeking a Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) Team Lead to lead our SRE team and evolve our managed hosting practice. Reporting to the Chief Innovation Officer, this role is responsible for the performance, security, and reliability of client environments across a modern, multi-cloud ecosystem, and for building a team that delivers that reliability consistently.


You’ll be a hands-on technical leader—setting the team’s direction, mentoring and developing team members, and partnering with internal teams and clients to deploy, support, and improve infrastructure, while taking ownership of systems end to end. This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys solving complex challenges, growing other engineers, and driving meaningful improvements in both technology and client experience.


What You'll Do:


Team Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and oversee the SRE team, assigning and prioritizing work, balancing project and operational demands, and keeping the team focused on the highest-impact initiatives.
  • Review the team’s technical output—system changes, configurations, pipelines, and documentation—to ensure quality, security, and consistency with established standards.
  • Support each team member’s growth through regular one-on-ones, coaching, and opportunities for training and certification.
  • Foster a collaborative, accountable team culture where knowledge is shared and people feel supported.
  • Participate in hiring, onboarding, goal setting, and performance evaluations, and partner with the Chief Innovation Officer and other team leads on team structure and staffing needs.

Hosting Operations & Reliability

  • Own day-to-day performance, security, and reliability of client hosting environments across Azure, AWS, WP Engine, and Windows Server/IIS.
  • Maintain proactive monitoring, identifying and resolving issues before client impact, while delivering a high-touch, white-glove support experience.
  • Own the on-call rotation and incident response process to support 24/7 client coverage, participating in the rotation and serving as the lead point of contact for major incidents and outages.

Infrastructure & Cloud Engineering

  • Architect and implement secure, resilient hosting environments with best practices for redundancy, disaster recovery, and multi-cloud strategies.
  • Define and maintain infrastructure as code to ensure consistency and scalability across environments.
  • Manage Azure services (App Services, Azure SQL, Key Vaults, Application Insights) and legacy AWS infrastructure (EC2, RDS, S3).

DevOps & Deployment

  • Own and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps, ensuring reliable and repeatable deployments.
  • Manage SSL/TLS lifecycle, DNS configurations, and domain services across platforms.
  • Support SSO integrations and identity configurations tied to hosted applications.

Systems Administration

  • Administer Windows Server and IIS environments, including performance tuning, patching, and configuration management.
  • Oversee WP Engine-hosted WordPress environments, including updates and platform configurations.

Collaboration & Client Engagement

  • Serve as the senior escalation point for hosting-related issues, providing root-cause analysis and long-term solutions.
  • Partner with development teams to align infrastructure with application architecture and support go-live readiness.
  • Engage directly with clients to gather requirements, communicate technical decisions, and act as a trusted advisor.

Standards & Continuous Improvement

  • Lead the evolution of SilverTech’s hosting practice by improving reliability, security, and operational standards, and ensure they are understood and followed across the team.
  • Partner with the Chief Innovation Officer on hosting strategy, roadmap planning, budgeting, and vendor relationships, providing regular updates on team performance, risks, and priorities.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to enhance processes, tooling, and overall service delivery.

What You Need to Succeed:

  • 7+ years of experience in systems administration, cloud infrastructure, or hosting environments, including 2+ years leadership/management.
  • Expertise in Microsoft Azure hosting services, including App Services, Azure SQL, Key Vaults, Application Insights, and networking.
  • Strong experience administering Windows Server and IIS in production environments.
  • Working knowledge of AWS infrastructure, including EC2, RDS, and S3.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Terraform) and CI/CD pipeline management in Azure DevOps.
  • Proficiency in PowerShell scripting and automation.
  • Solid understanding of cloud security principles, including IAM, network security, and vulnerability management.
  • Strong communication and client-facing skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • A service-oriented mindset with strong ownership, accountability, and responsiveness.

Experience That Will Set You Apart:

  • Working with people, not just pipelines. This role involves interacting with internal and external clients.
  • Advanced experience with Cloudflare, especially in a SAAS setting.
  • Experience supporting .NET-based applications in Azure.
  • Familiarity with WP Engine or similar managed WordPress hosting platforms.
  • Experience leading or mentoring engineers—assigning work, coaching, and contributing to hiring and performance reviews—and influencing technical direction.

Location:

This role offers flexibility based on candidate location and business needs, with the option to work hybrid from our Bedford, NH office or fully remote within the U.S.

  • Strong compensation package
  • Competitive health packages
  • 401k with company match
  • Flexible work schedules
  • Hybrid workweek

  • Regular learning & development opportunities
  • Monthly company-provided lunches
  • A fun, collaborative, and innovative team that actually likes working together
  • Cutting-edge technology and creative freedom

title: Change Management Senior Analyst
description:
The Change Management Senior Analyst is a member of Sidley’s Organizational Effectiveness team and supports the successful adoption of strategic initiatives, business process improvements, and technology transformations across the Firm. Working with business leaders, project teams, and stakeholders, the Senior Analyst develops and implements change management approaches and deliverables that support organizational readiness, stakeholder engagement, user adoption, and sustainable business outcomes while minimizing disruption.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Manage change management activities and deliverables for assigned strategic, operational, and technology initiatives.

  • Develop and implement change management plans, including stakeholder engagement, communications, training, and adoption activities, in alignment with project objectives.

  • Conduct change impact and readiness assessments to identify adoption risks, barriers, and opportunities and recommend appropriate actions.

  • Partner with project managers, business leaders, and key stakeholders to support alignment, readiness, and effective implementation of change initiatives.

  • Develop and deliver communications, presentations, messaging, and other materials to promote awareness and engagement throughout the change lifecycle.

  • Collaborate with Learning & Development to develop and support role-based training, learning resources, and user enablement activities.

  • Monitor and analyze adoption, readiness, and engagement measures and recommend actions to improve change outcomes.

  • Prepare dashboards, status reports, and presentations communicating progress, risks, adoption results, and organizational impacts to project and business stakeholders.

  • Contribute to improvements to the Firm’s change management methodology, processes, tools, and templates based on project experience and identified needs.

  • Research emerging change management, organizational effectiveness, and digital adoption practices and recommend relevant enhancements to Firm practices.

Education and/or Experience:

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Organizational Development, Communications, Human Resources, Psychology, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

  • A minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in organizational change management, business transformation, organizational development, consulting, or strategic project initiatives.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience developing communications and presentations for varied stakeholder audiences.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

Preferred:

  • Experience supporting enterprise technology implementations, such as cloud platforms, collaboration tools, knowledge management, ERP, CRM, document management, or other business applications.

  • Experience in a global professional services organization, law firm, accounting firm, or management consulting environment.

  • Prosci, ACMP CCMP, Change Management Institute, or comparable change management certification.

  • PMP, Agile, Scrum, Lean, Six Sigma, or related project/process improvement certification.

Other Skills and Abilities:

The following will also be required of the successful candidate:

  • Strong organizational skills

  • Strong attention to detail

  • Good judgment

  • Strong interpersonal communication skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

  • Able to work harmoniously and effectively with others

  • Able to preserve confidentiality and exercise discretion

  • Able to work under pressure

$85,600 - $117,700

title: Director, Employee Transport Services
description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

What this job involves:

Driving excellence in ground transportation operations

  • Oversee end-to-end ground transport services for the client's workforce, ensuring safe, efficient, and reliable mobility solutions across PAN India Locations.
  • Own the full employee transportation lifecycle, from vendor onboarding to daily operational execution.
  • Drive continuous improvement across cost, quality, and service delivery

Fleet and vendor management

  • Manage end-to-end relationships with ground transport vendors, including contract negotiation and SLA governance.
  • Conduct regular vendor audits and scorecards to monitor fleet quality, driver conduct, and vehicle maintenance standards.
  • Drive vendor consolidation and cost optimization initiatives without compromising service quality.

Scheduling, login, and log-out operations

  • Design and execute transport scheduling for optimal route planning, vehicle utilization, and on-time performance.
  • Oversee real-time login and log-out tracking of employees, ensuring accurate headcount reconciliation and utilization reporting.
  • Identify scheduling inefficiencies and implement corrective measures to minimize delays and cost overruns.

Compliance management

  • Ensure all ground transport operations adhere to statutory, regulatory, and client-specific compliance requirements.
  • Maintain compliance for driver licensing, vehicle permits, insurance, and labour law adherence.
  • Maintain audit-ready documentation and ensure zero non-compliance incidents through disciplined governance.

AI, automation, and innovation

  • Lead exploration and implementation of AI-driven and automated solutions for route planning, demand forecasting, and fleet tracking.
  • Champion innovation initiatives that enhance employee experience and safety outcomes.
  • Drive data-driven decision-making to reduce operational costs.

Technology platform management – MoveInSync and beyond

  • Own administration and optimization of cab booking platforms such as MoveInSync.
  • Ensure high system uptime, user adoption, and data accuracy.
  • Collaborate with IT and vendor teams to troubleshoot issues and roll out upgrades.

Quality and compliance governance

  • Establish and monitor key quality metrics, including on-time performance, vehicle hygiene, driver behaviour, and customer satisfaction, vendor fair allocation etc.
  • Lead periodic quality audits and corrective action plans.
  • Drive continuous improvement in service delivery standards across both sites.

Employee safety in ground transportation

  • Implement and enforce rigorous safety protocols, including driver background verification, vehicle safety checks, GPS tracking, and panic button systems.
  • Lead emergency response procedures and incident investigation.
  • Conduct root-cause analysis for safety lapses and ensure timely corrective actions.
  • Provide transparent safety reporting to client stakeholders.

Leading and growing your team

  • Manage a team of transportation coordinators, schedulers, and vendor managers.
  • Equip team members with skills, direction, and tools needed for world-class service delivery.
  • Lead recruitment, performance planning, training, succession planning, and reward programs.
  • Build a high-performing team culture in collaboration with line managers.

Risk and resiliency

  • Maintain strong focus on operational resiliency for employee mobility.
  • Develop contingency plans for vehicle breakdowns, driver shortages, extreme weather, and other disruptions.
  • Ensure zero business interruption through proactive risk identification and mitigation.

Sound like you? To apply you need to be:

Subject Matter Expert

  • Minimum 12-15 years of relevant experience in ground transportation, fleet management, or logistics operations.
  • At least 7 years managing large-scale employee transportation programs for corporate or campus environments.
  • Minimum 8-10 years of experience in managing large ground transport teams in a corporate environment.
  • Minimum total experience of 15+ years in ground transportation.

Qualification

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Logistics, Business Administration, Transport Management, Hospitality or an equivalent discipline from a recognized university.
  • Graduation in, Logistics, Business Administration, , or an equivalent degree
  • Certifications in fleet management, transportation safety, or logistics operations are an added advantage.

Roll-up-your-sleeves attitude

  • Passion and aptitude to champion safety, innovation, and operational excellence.
  • Ability to empower clients and people through strategic leadership.
  • Skilled at building a diverse team and inclusive culture that brings out the best in everyone.

What we can do for you:

  • Help you realise your full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment.
  • Empower your ambitions through a dedicated Total Rewards Program.
  • Offer a competitive pay and benefits package.

Apply today!

48

title: Patient Financial Clearance Representative I (Remote)
description:
If you're ready to be part of our legacy of hope and innovation, we encourage you to take the first step and explore our current job openings. Your best is waiting to be discovered.

Day - 08 Hour (United States of America)

This is a Stanford Health Care job.

A Brief Overview
The Patient Financial Clearance Representative, under direct supervision of the Department Management and Patient Financial Clearance Lead, performs specialized functions for SHC patients by completing all activities related to insurance verification and securing authorization. These activities are performed in accordance with established Stanford Health Care regulations, policies, and procedures. The Patient Financial Clearance Representative has knowledge of healthcare payers, such as Medicare, Medi-Cal, Workers Comp, and all Managed Care plans as well as State and Federal regulations.

Locations
Stanford Health Care

What you will do

  • Completes insurance verification, eligibility and benefit determination process utilizing integrated electronic eligibility system, payer websites, and phone for all insurance plans within the scope of the patient financial clearance department and assigned service line.
  • Interprets and documents the appropriate co-pay, deductible, share of cost, co-insurance, maximum benefit levels and/or available days.
  • Contacts patient as appropriate to obtain correct and updated information when necessary.
  • Completes Medicare Secondary Questionnaire as appropriate.
  • Applies authorization rules and requirements for all payors within the assigned work queues.
  • Develops a strong working knowledge of the procedures and diagnosis used in the assigned service-lines to ensure authorizations are properly completed for the scope of services that will be rendered to the patient.
  • Assesses the data required for authorization and securing sponsorship. Communicates with respective clinics and referring providers to secure appropriate information to complete an authorization.
  • Follows up on pending authorization and referral requests to ensure timely completion and secured sponsorship for cases in the assigned work queue.
  • Arranges escalation process for clinics and clinicians to complete peer-to-peer appeal reviews with payor utilization management when needed.
  • Prioritizes work assigned to them to ensure that financial risk is minimized, and timely completion of authorizations is optimized, while meeting daily productivity measure goals.
  • Identifies risk associated with coverage and benefit issues related to the services that are being requested for authorization and escalates these issues to appropriate experts to address.
  • Identifies risk associated with securing financial clearance prior to service date and escalates to clinic and other resources to find an appropriate course of action (e.g. reschedule, cancel, sign PAFR).
  • Understands the role of financial counseling in securing clearance for cases that do not have authorization secured timely. Properly refers these cases as appropriate.
  • Notifies the department manager with issues, instances of errors, or obstacles to successful completion of work.
  • Applies strong writing skills to account documentation, email communication and internal notes/memos.
  • Manages outbound and inbound phone calls.
  • Responds promptly to customer inquiries.
  • Assists team coordinator and department manager with special projects as needed.
  • Serves as a resource for other payor authorization teams.
  • Performs other duties and responsibilities as assigned by the Department.


Education Qualifications

  • High School diploma or GED equivalent


Experience Qualifications

  • One (1) year working knowledge of patient registration and insurance verification and authorization processes in a medical organization
    Epic experience preferred

Licenses and Certifications

  • None


These principles apply to ALL employees:

SHC Commitment to Providing an Exceptional Patient & Family Experience

Stanford Health Care sets a high standard for delivering value and an exceptional experience for our patients and families. Candidates for employment and existing employees must adopt and execute C-I-CARE standards for all of patients, families and towards each other. C-I-CARE is the foundation of Stanford’s patient-experience and represents a framework for patient-centered interactions. Simply put, we do what it takes to enable and empower patients and families to focus on health, healing and recovery.

You will do this by executing against our three experience pillars, from the patient and family’s perspective:


  • Know Me: Anticipate my needs and status to deliver effective care
  • Show Me the Way: Guide and prompt my actions to arrive at better outcomes and better health
  • Coordinate for Me: Own the complexity of my care through coordination

Job Description:

Arizona State University’s Global Education Office (ASU GEO) is hiring a Partnership and Exchange Program Coordinator. The successful candidate will be part of a team of seven (7) working to support ASU’s partnership (third-party) and exchange program portfolio and join a broader office with 25 team members. If you are interested in joining a growing and collegial office that values creativity, innovation and access, then this is the job for you. Come be a part of the future of global education at America’s most innovative university!

ASU GEO is a leader in global education, enrolling over 3,000 students annually in traditional mobility programs including study abroad, internship, service-learning and research opportunities and has developed a growing portfolio of online global learning programs that enroll an additional 1,700+ students each academic year. The office has a strong commitment to professional development. You will have opportunities both internally and externally to grow your skill set and knowledge base.

This is a student-facing, advising intensive position reporting to the Program Manager of Partnership and Exchange Programs. The Coordinator will be assigned to a portfolio of partnership and exchange programs and in addition to general program management will be responsible for advising and recruiting students, managing complex application processes and communicating with university constituents (academic advising units, financial aid, registrar, student life) as well as international and domestic partners.


Salary: $52,000/year


Essential Duties:

  • Advising for an assigned portfolio of outbound partnership (third-party) and reciprocal exchange university programs
  • Developing and facilitating program orientations, materials, and activities for incoming and outgoing study abroad participants
  • Coordinating all aspects of program applications and participant communications
  • Recruiting program participants in cooperation with the marketing team and relevant units on campus
  • Responding to program-related inquiries from students, parents, and university faculty and staff
  • Maintaining the integrity of data in database/website for all assigned programs and participants
  • Maintaining direct contact with various parties to ensure all aspects of assigned programs are implemented and controlled according to plans
  • Representing the office at campus events, conferences, and international site visits as needed
  • Other duties and special projects as assigned

ASU GEO is a leader in global education, enrolling over 3,000 students annually on traditional mobility programs, including study abroad, internship, service-learning, and research opportunities, and has developed a growing portfolio of online global learning programs that enroll an additional 1,700+ students each academic year.

title: Expert Coordinator
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.

Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

The Expert Coordinator provides operational, administrative, and strategic coordination across a 200 person HCP Sales, Marketing, and Operations organization distributed throughout the U.S. This role delivers direct administrative support to the VP Expert while also serving the broader Expert community through team operations, onboarding, logistics, and day-to-day issue resolution.

The Coordinator serves as a critical point of connection between Expert and the broader US Commercial organization, helping ensure seamless processes, consistent communication, and operational excellence across the team.

This position requires strong judgment, exceptional organizational skills, a high degree of autonomy, and the ability to influence and collaborate across multiple functions. It plays an integral part in how the team operates and shows up internally and externally.



Key Responsibilities:


Administrative & Executive Support (VP Expert and Expert LT)

  • Manage complex calendar scheduling and prioritization.
  • Coordinate travel arrangements, itineraries, and logistics.
  • Submit, track, and reconcile expense reports.
  • Prepare meeting materials and agendas.
  • Create and track purchase orders; oversee invoice processing
  • Act as a liaison between the VP Expert and internal/external stakeholders.
  • Handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion.


Operations Support for 200+ Team Members

  • Serve as the primary coordination point for the field-based US Expert organization.
  • Support logistics and execution of national meetings, regional team meetings, and leadership offsites.
  • Own Expert LT meeting forums, including setting agendas and capturing notes and acion items, scheduling and technology support.
  • Facilitate onboarding and offboarding, including system access, equipment, and orientation support.
  • Provide troubleshooting support for expense reporting, fleet issues, operational questions, and general team needs.
  • Serve as the go‑to escalation point for team operational challenges.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & US Commercial Integration

  • Act as a connective tissue between the Expert organization and broader US Commercial teams (Sales, Marketing, Finance, HR, Operations).
  • Drive consistency, process adherence, and communication across organizations.
  • Source, collate, and distribute materials for leadership reviews, town halls, and cross-functional initiatives.
  • Maintain departmental SharePoint sites and digital resources.


Continuous Improvement & Special Projects

  • Identify operational inefficiencies and propose improved workflows.
  • Lead or support mid- to large-scale projects that enhance team performance and organizational structure.
  • Manage ad hoc projects and assignments from VP Expert or Expert Leadership Team.
  • Ensure alignment with Haleon’s Win as One behaviors and culture.

Why you?

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • 3+ years in administrative, operational, project coordination, or similar experience.
  • Proven ability to work at pace, navigate ambiguity, and solve complex problems.
  • Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • High emotional intelligence and ability to support a diverse, geographically dispersed team.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Teams, Copilot).
  • Ability to manage sensitive information with high professionalism and discretion.
  • Must be able to build productive relationships across multiple functions and levels.


Preferred Experience:

  • Experience supporting senior leaders and/or large field-based organizations strongly preferred.
  • Consumer healthcare or CPG industry experience.
  • Experience with vendor management, budget tracking, procurement, or event logistics.
  • Prior experience working with fleet programs is a plus.


Compensation: The salary range for this role is: $61,886 - $85,903 plus an annual bonus.

Location: This role is based in based in Berkley Heights, NJ, and follows a hybrid model, requiring an in-office presence of 3 days per week.

Benefits

Haleon offers a robust Total Reward package that consists of competitive pay and a comprehensive benefits program. This includes a generous 401(k) plan, tuition reimbursement and time off programs including 6 months paid parental leave. On day one, you are eligible for benefits, including our healthcare programs where the company pays for the majority of your medical coverage for you and your family. We also offer the opportunity to receive a discretionary bonus based on the achievement of key business performance and other incentive/recognition programs as part of the offering.

It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. title: Full Stack Developer
location: Remote within 2 hours drive of Washington DC
description:
Concept Solutions is seeking a Full Stack Developer to join a dedicated team of Information Technology (IT) professionals supporting the Federal Aviation Administration's (FAA) Command, Control, and Communications (C3) office. The C3 office carries a critical strategic mandate: ensuring FAA managers maintain daily situational awareness and uninterrupted continuity of communications during severe national emergencies, natural disasters, or critical equipment malfunctions. Should disruptions occur, the C3 office is chartered with executing rapid disaster recovery and restoring essential communication services expeditiously. This position is remote within 2 hours drive of Washington DC.


The Mid-Level Full Stack Developer focuses on building, maintaining, and modernizing critical enterprise web applications, bridging legacy on-premises systems with the Amazon Web Services (AWS) cloud. The primary objective of this role is to participate in a team effort to refactor and migrate legacy web applications and workflows from Microsoft SharePoint Subscriber Edition (On-Premises) to modern, open-source technology stacks hosted on AWS (including AWS GovCloud and AWS Outposts environments). This effort will include the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) to refactor legacy code.


Working as a member of the DevSecOps team, this role ensures all front-end and back-end code is highly performant, accessible, and robustly secure, supporting highly available mission-essential functions under a FISMA Moderate framework. This position is vital to modernizing legacy application interfaces into secure cloud architectures, remediating findings from automated security pipelines, and establishing resilient, error-tolerant workflows for continuity of operations.

Proč právě Fresenius Medical Care?


Společnost Fresenius Medical Care je přední světový poskytovatel produktů a služeb pro osoby s chronickým selháním ledvin. Na celém světě pravidelně podstupuje dialyzační léčbu více než 4,1 milionu pacientů. Naše společnost se v celosvětové síti více než 4 000 dialyzačních pracovišť stará o více než 332 000 pacientů. Na území všech kontinentů provozuje více než 40 výrobních závodů, které vyrábějí dialyzační produkty, jako jsou dialyzační přístroje, dialyzátory a související spotřební materiály.


Naše práce ale není jen o dialyzační technologii a odborných postupech. Důležitá je pro nás také komunikace s pacienty, jejich důvěra a péče, kterou jim poskytujeme při každé návštěvě.


Zaujala Vás naše nabídka?

Rádi Vám přiblížíme, jak práce na našem dialyzačním středisku probíhá, co obnáší zaškolení a co od nové kolegyně nebo kolegy očekáváme.

title: 2027 Summer Intern – Research and Development – Vehicle Health Management
location: Warren, Michigan, United States of America
description:
Job Description

The Role

We are seeking highly motivated, technically exceptional interns to join our team in the rapidly growing field of Vehicle Health Management (VHM). This is an exciting opportunity to work at the intersection of connected vehicles, data science, physics-based modeling, and advanced AI to develop technologies that make vehicle ownership more convenient and seamless for millions of customers. You will also help advance vehicle and propulsion systems in support of enterprise cost reduction through improved warranty performance and greater engineering development efficiency.

In this role, you will transform vehicle engineering data into actionable insights that can predict system issues and identify root causes before they affect vehicle performance or disrupt customers’ daily lives. Our VHM research combines fundamental physics-based understanding with modern machine learning approaches, including but not limited to large language models, causal AI, and reinforcement learning, to deliver scalable solutions for diagnostics, prognostics, and system performance management.

GM is a leader in this field. One example is the industry-first OnStar Proactive Alert for Starting System, which warns customers of potential component failures before they become emergencies, turning unplanned repairs into scheduled maintenance. Now available on more than 15 million GM vehicles, this service demonstrates the real-world impact of our work at scale. By joining this team, you will help advance technologies that improve the ownership experience for millions of customers.

What You’ll Do:

  • Generate innovative ideas in VHM related areas, utilizing physics-based, data-driven, as well as latest AI-based modeling methodologies
  • Develop next-generation technologies for vehicle system diagnosis, prognosis, and fault-tolerant controls as well as integration
  • Develop and execute specific research plans, including concept generation, prototype development, system implementation, and performance evaluation
  • Document and present results

Required Qualifications:

  • Pursuit of an advanced degree (Master or PhD) in one of the following areas: Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or related field of study
  • Must be a current student
  • Able to work fulltime, 40 hours per week during the summer months
  • Background in fault detection and isolation, diagnostics and prognostics, root cause analysis
  • Understanding of AI/ML development workflows, including data preparation, model training and deployment, performance evaluation and monitoring
  • Experience in Python (including familiarity with ML frameworks such as PyTorch or Tensorflow), PySpark, MATLAB/Simulink
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to work both independently and in teams

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior internship experience in automotive, technology, or manufacturing
  • Strong critical thinking and analytical skills, especially the ability to synthesize large amounts of data involving multiple variables into comprehensive, impactful insights
  • Strong theoretical and experimental skills, especially in controls, optimization, signal processing
  • Background in latest AI technologies such as deep learning, LLMs, causal AI, reinforcement learning, foundation models, physics-informed machine learning

GM does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role. Do not apply for this role if you will need GM immigration sponsorship now or in the future. This includes direct company sponsorship, entry of GM as the immigration employer of record on a government form, and any work authorization requiring a written submission or other immigration support from the company (e.g., H1-B, OPT, STEM OPT, CPT, TN, J-1, etc.)

The position is subject to export control restrictions and requires the successful candidate to be a U.S. Person (U.S. citizen, U.S. permanent resident, asylee or refugee).

Work Arrangement:

Hybrid: This role is categorized as hybrid. This means the successful candidate is expected to report to Warren, MI three times per week, at minimum.

Start dates for this internship role are in May 24th & June 14th of 2027.
