title: Senior Manager,  EBRA Business Risk Brex Integration
description:
Senior Manager, EBRA Business Risk Brex Integration

Senior Risk Managers at Capital One are highly motivated risk and process management professionals with excellent analytical, organizational, risk management, project management, and communication skills. These skills allow us to gain insights, and act as a change agent to influence our business partners. A successful candidate for this role will be able to operate from a foundation of knowledge about risk management and make sound decisions within the risk management framework. You are forward thinking, quick to adapt, and technologically adept. The demands and high-visibility nature of this position require an expert with a proven ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment and who can begin contributing immediately.


As a Senior Risk Manager, you will support and oversee Integration efforts for a large scale company merger. This role will be responsible for driving cross functional alignment across multiple lines of business and key partners, managing complex workstreams, mitigating risk, and ensuring successful post merger integration across people, process and technology. This is an exciting opportunity for a well-rounded candidate to help boldly model the future of Capital One.


As part of the Emerging & B2B Risk Advisory team, you will demonstrate a unique blend of analytical and communications skills. You will lead horizontal strategy and problem solving across the Integration program, including creating updates for senior executives. You will identify dependencies, key decisions, and strategic questions to be answered across business, technology, and other key partners. You will also drive the design of an integrated program, leading through influence to ensure the team meets our fast-paced deadlines while bringing the broader organization along.


Here's what we're looking for in an ideal teammate:

  • You’re a strategic thinker and enjoy collecting, organizing, and synthesizing information to make a decision or recommendation
  • You understand that context is key and ensuring people are informed is critical to organizational success
  • You are able to drive all phases of project management to include feasibility, definition, planning, prioritization, implementation and close out
  • You are a confident communicator who feels comfortable presenting program ideas or decisions in front of peers, stakeholders, and leaders
  • You enjoy fast paced environments and can ask tough questions / challenge the status quo
  • You have a high degree of organizational skills and ability to manage multiple, competing priorities
  • You can put structure in place, connect dots, and can find and articulate a clear narrative or vision
  • You are highly collaborative and consultative, and seek out inspiration and feedback from others to always drive towards the best solution
  • You understand the benefits of both process and being nimble
  • You are independent, can work autonomously, and are comfortable owning the end-to-end program with little direction

Responsibilities:

  • Support the end-to-end planning and delivery of an integration program; providing clarity, structured problem solving, and results driven execution
  • Manage program governance structure, interaction model, operating cadence, and executive reporting
  • Translate and communicate complex information into clear, actionable insights for stakeholders at all levels, providing regular updates and progress dashboards
  • Assist and drive project and program delivery, including project and process management, reporting, engagement in senior leadership meetings, and drafting and reviewing materials for senior management
  • Monitor and manage key integration risks, issues, and interdependencies
  • Manage and synthesize input from multiple directions and drive organized execution
  • Be a trusted advisor and drive effective and relevant business, technology, and cyber risk conversations to execute program delivery
  • Support direction, manage expectations, and lead cross-functional teams through various initiatives, including oversight of third party resources
  • Participate in risk and other management forums and contribute to continuous improvement of risk and project/program management practices
  • Support direction, manage expectations, and lead cross-functional teams through various initiatives, including oversight of third party resources

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree or Military Experience
  • At least 7 years of experience in technology (software delivery, distributed systems, cloud-native architecture, infrastructure as code), cybersecurity (identity and access management, application security, cloud security, data protection), technology auditing, systems risk management, technology risk assessments, resilience engineering (operational resilience, business continuity, disaster recovery, high availability), chaos engineering (fault injection, blast radius mitigation, automated security validation), site reliability engineering (SLAs or SLOs, observability, incident response), or a combination.
  • At least 4 years of experience supporting, partnering, and interacting with internal or external business clients
  • At least 3 years of experience planning, analyzing and leading Risk assessments, or performing detailed reviews of control assessments
  • At least 1 year of experience developing risks, associated controls, issues or mitigation plans


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Juris Doctor or Master’s degree
  • 8+ years of compliance, risk management, legal, or audit experience at a financial institution
  • Risk Certifications (CRISC, CISM, CRCM, CIPP, ABA Risk Mgmt Certification)
  • 5+ years of experience supporting, partnering and interacting with internal stakeholders
  • 3+ years of experience consulting with senior executives or strategy building

This role is designated as a hybrid position. You are expected to adhere to Capital One's hybrid policy regarding required on-site presence at your designated office location.


At this time, Capital One will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization, or offer any immigration related support for this position (e.g. H1B, F-1 OPT, F-1 STEM OPT, F-1 CPT, J-1, TN, E-3, and O-1, or any other forms of work authorization that require immigration support from an employer).


The minimum and maximum full-time annual salaries for this role are listed below, by location. Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within one of these locations, and refers to the amount Capital One is willing to pay at the time of this posting. Salaries for part-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked.

Chicago, IL: $182,500 - $208,300 for Sr. Manager, Tech Risk & Analysis


McLean, VA: $200,700 - $229,100 for Sr. Manager, Tech Risk & Analysis


New York, NY: $219,000 - $249,900 for Sr. Manager, Tech Risk & Analysis


Richmond, VA: $182,500 - $208,300 for Sr. Manager, Tech Risk & Analysis

title: Administrative Client Access and Engagement Supervisor
description:
Full Time - In office

General Purpose: The Administrative Client Access and Engagement Supervisor is responsible for day-to-day leadership, supervision, and operational oversight of client administrative, client access, and client engagement functions across Solvista Health locations, including rural and frontier counties. This position ensures consistent, effective, client-centered operations by overseeing engagement efforts, coordinating care and service progression, tracking engagement data, identifying access and engagement gaps, and maintaining accountability for data monitoring and successful outcomes. The supervisor monitors workflows, staff performance, key reports, documentation, and client access processes; uses critical thinking and independent judgment to translate organizational direction into practical plans; leads process improvement and change efforts; provides multi-site coverage as needed; and works closely with the Clinic Supervisor to support continuity of department operations.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Operational and Clinic Oversight

  • Oversee day-to-day Administrative Assistant and Client Engagement operations across assigned Solvista Health locations.
  • Oversee client access and engagement efforts across all rural and frontier counties served, ensuring consistent outreach, follow-up, care coordination, and progression into appropriate services.
  • Track and monitor engagement data across all rural and frontier counties served, including access, outreach, follow-up, enrollment, referral, and service-progression measures.
  • Monitor client progression from initial contact through attendance at the assessment appointment to ensure appropriate follow-up, documentation, scheduling, and payer-source processes are completed.
  • Review key reports, work queues, workflows, and operational indicators to identify delays, barriers, inconsistencies, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Analyze engagement and access data to identify service gaps, geographic differences, barriers to care, and opportunities to improve engagement and successful connection to services.
  • Maintain accountability for timely and accurate data monitoring, follow-up on identified concerns, and progress toward defined engagement and access outcomes.
  • Address daily operational issues and coordinate staffing, coverage, and resources to maintain essential services.
  • Conduct routine site visits to observe operations, support staff, identify needs, and reinforce consistent expectations and workflows.
  • Provide hands-on Administrative Assistant or Client Engagement coverage when necessary to maintain operations during absences, vacancies, or other staffing needs.
  • Establish and reinforce clear customer service expectations and a shared culture of client-centered care, holding staff accountable for providing consistent, welcoming, and responsive experience while anticipating client needs, reducing barriers, taking ownership of concerns, and using coaching, feedback, and training to support successful engagement in services.

Administrative Leadership

  • Oversee administrative functions including front-desk operations, scheduling, registration, records, communication, and Electronic Health Record workflows.
  • Establish and reinforce standardized administrative practices across staff and locations.
  • Ensure administrative processes are completed accurately, timely, consistently, and in accordance with organizational expectations.
  • Identify differences in practices between staff or locations and work toward consistent department-wide processes.
  • Promote professional, responsive, and client-centered service in all administrative interactions.

Supervision and Staff Development

  • Provide direct supervision to assigned Administrative Assistants and Client Engagement staff.
  • Support hiring, onboarding, training, coaching, evaluation, performance management, and corrective action as appropriate.
  • Establish clear expectations and hold staff accountable for performance, communication, quality, and follow-through.
  • Conduct regular staff meetings, individual supervision, coaching, and performance discussions.
  • Develop staff through training, cross-training, delegation, problem-solving, and increased responsibility.
  • Foster a culture of teamwork, accountability, adaptability, communication, and continuous improvement.
  • Lead staff through process and organizational change by clearly communicating expectations, explaining the purpose behind changes, and reinforcing new practices.

Program and Workflow Coordination

  • Translate organizational goals and Program Director direction into practical operational plans with defined steps, assignments, timelines, and follow-up expectations.
  • Use critical thinking and independent judgment to identify problems, determine root causes, develop solutions, and implement sustainable improvements.
  • Develop, implement, monitor, and evaluate workflows supporting Administrative Assistant and Client Engagement operations.
  • Coordinate care and operational handoffs across client engagement, screening, enrollment, clinical services, and other partners to reduce delays and help clients successfully access and remain engaged in care.
  • Develop and monitor action plans when engagement data identifies gaps, missed follow-up, incomplete handoffs, or outcomes that are not meeting expectations.
  • Coordinate across departments to reduce barriers and support timely client access to services.
  • Monitor new processes to determine effectiveness and adjust when expected outcomes are not being achieved.
  • Report engagement trends, identified gaps, corrective actions, and progress toward successful outcomes to the Program Director and other stakeholders as required.
  • Participate in department and organization-wide projects, initiatives, and process improvement efforts.

Regulatory and Quality Support

  • Ensure administrative and Client Engagement workflows align with organizational policies and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Monitor required client documentation, data entry, payer information, and other administrative requirements for accuracy and completion.
  • Ensure engagement and access data are entered consistently, reviewed routinely, and maintained in a manner that supports organizational and grant-related monitoring and reporting requirements.
  • Conduct routine audits, quality checks, and process reviews to identify trends, recurring errors, and areas for improvement.
  • Implement or support corrective actions and additional training when quality or compliance concerns are identified.
  • Maintain appropriate confidentiality and ensure staff follow privacy and information-handling expectations.

Provider and Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Build and maintain effective working relationships with Screening, Enrollment, Billing, clinical teams, providers, leadership, and other internal partners.
  • Serve as a point of coordination and escalation for administrative and Client Engagement issues requiring cross-department collaboration.
  • Work with other departments to resolve barriers affecting client access, scheduling, documentation, payer-source identification, or service progression.
  • Use engagement data and cross-department collaboration to identify where clients are disengaging or encountering barriers and coordinate timely interventions to improve access and continuity of care.
  • Communicate operational concerns, trends, and proposed solutions clearly and professionally.
  • Support communication with external partners, vendors, and stakeholders as needed.

Financial and Resource Support

  • Monitor staffing, supply, equipment, and operational needs across assigned locations and support responsible use of resources.
  • Assist with resource planning and allocation to maintain effective Administrative Assistant and Client Engagement operations.
  • Identify operational inefficiencies or resource needs and communicate recommendations to the Program Director.
  • Support processes that contribute to accurate payer identification and appropriate financial documentation for clients.

Leadership Support and Continuity

  • Partner with the Program Director to support Administrative Assistant and Client Engagement operations through a shared leadership model.
  • Work collaboratively with the Clinic Supervisor to support the overall stability and effectiveness of department operations.
  • Maintain a working understanding of clinic operations sufficient to provide basic supervisory support and continuity when the Clinic Supervisor is unavailable.
  • Provide appropriate supervisory coverage during periods of absence, including staff guidance, operational problem-solving, issue triage, and escalation when necessary.
  • Serve as an appropriate supervisory resource before routine operational matters are escalated to the Program Director.
  • Independently resolve operational issues within established authority and exercise sound judgment regarding when matters require Director-level or other leadership involvement.
  • Maintain clear primary accountability for Administrative Assistant and Client Engagement operations while supporting broader department continuity.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Participate in meetings, trainings, and organizational initiatives as required.
  • Conduct or support staff training, onboarding, and cross-training efforts.
  • Travel between Solvista Health locations as necessary to provide operational oversight, staff support, training, and coverage.
  • Demonstrate sound judgment, integrity, reliability, discretion, and consistent follow-through in employee, client, and operational matters.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Supervisory Duties (if any)

  • Participate in hiring, onboarding, training, evaluation, performance management, corrective action, and employee development as appropriate.
  • Establish clear performance expectations and hold staff accountable for quality, productivity, communication, professionalism, and follow-through.
  • Hold assigned staff accountable for accurate engagement-data entry, timely outreach and follow-up, effective care coordination, and completion of actions needed to address identified access or engagement gaps.
  • Monitor staff workload, scheduling, attendance, timecards, coverage, and operational needs across assigned locations.
  • Conduct regular individual supervision and team meetings to review performance, priorities, barriers, and development needs.
  • Identify training and cross-training needs and ensure staff maintain the knowledge and skills necessary to perform assigned responsibilities.
  • Support staff in problem-solving while encouraging appropriate independence, critical thinking, and ownership of their work.
  • Address performance or conduct concerns timely, consistently, and in coordination with Human Resources and the Program Director as appropriate.
  • Promote consistent workflows, expectations, and service standards across staff and locations.
  • Provide hands-on operational support and coverage when needed while maintaining responsibility for overall supervisory oversight and team performance.

title: Administrator (East Cairo)
description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

Role Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Administrator to join our Property Management team in Egypt. In this role, you will play a crucial part in ensuring the smooth execution of projects by managing documentation, maintaining property records, and implementing efficient document control procedures. You will work collaboratively with professional and technical staff to support property objectives while maintaining the highest standards of organization and accuracy.

Key Responsibilities

The Administrator will manage and organize documents throughout all phases of the property lifecycles, ensuring accessibility and proper categorization, while maintaining comprehensive project directories and filing systems that support efficient property operations. This includes filing and storing original documents, revisions, and reproduced materials in a manner that facilitates easy retrieval and reference.

The role involves developing and implementing property-specific filing structures and document control procedures tailored to property requirements, as well as configuring and utilizing electronic document management systems to streamline document workflows and enhance accessibility. The Administrator will also record, catalog, and store property photographs and visual documentation in organized systems.

The Administrator will interact professionally with property management team members and stakeholders to understand documentation needs and accomplish assigned objectives, while performing routine administrative duties with precision and attention to detail. This includes supporting property management teams by providing timely access to property records and documentation, and assisting in maintaining compliance with document control standards and organizational procedures.

Requirements

The ideal candidate should have a minimum of 3-5 years of administrative experience, with prior exposure to document control, property management administration, or records management within a project-based, malls management, or real estate environment considered an advantage. A relevant Undergraduate degree or diploma in Business Administration, Office Management, or a related field is preferred, though equivalent practical experience will also be considered.

The candidate should demonstrate strong organizational and document management skills, with the ability to develop and maintain structured filing systems and apply document control procedures across multiple concurrent projects. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) is required, and experience organizing and cataloging property records, revisions, and visual documentation.

Strong written and verbal communication skills are essential, as the role requires regular interfacing with property management teams, technical and professional staff, and stakeholders to understand and fulfill documentation needs. The candidate should exhibit a high level of accuracy and attention to detail, discretion in handling project and organizational records, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a team environment.

Qualification

  • 3-5 years of administrative experience, ideally within document control, project administration, or records management in a project-based, mall management, operations, or real estate environment
  • Hands-on experience developing and maintaining structured filing systems and document control procedures across multiple concurrent projects
  • Experience organizing, cataloging, and storing property records, document revisions, and visual/photographic documentation
  • Working knowledge of document workflow processes
  • Preferably residing in East Cairo or around the area.

title: Analyst, Regional Communications

Invenergy is North America’s largest privately held developer, owner, and operator of power infrastructure. With 25 years of trusted execution, we deliver reliable, affordable energy through a diverse portfolio that includes natural gas, solar, land-based wind, energy storage, transmission, and domestic manufacturing. Headquartered in Chicago, we develop, own, and operate large scale projects that power communities and support the energy future.


Invenergy follows a hybrid schedule, working in office Monday through Thursday and remotely on Fridays if work permits.


This position will be open for application for at least 3 calendar days from the posting date. This position will remain open for application based on business need, which may be before or after the 3-day posting window.

Job Description

Position Overview

The Analyst, Regional Communications role at Invenergy focuses on executing external communication strategies that support project execution and Invenergy’s broader reputation across communities. This position requires strong communication skills, supporting the Corporate Affairs, Development, and Construction teams as they execute projects.

title: Sr. Associate, Cash Forecasting
description:
Sr. Associate, Cash Forecasting

Capital One Treasury is seeking a Senior Associate to join the Cash Forecasting team in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. In this operations-focused role, the Senior Associate will lead the daily short-term forecasting of Capital One’s Federal Reserve account balance and drive monthly accuracy refinement processes. Additionally, the Senior Associate will own the development of our Python-based forecasting model, partnering with the Cash Forecasting and Management teams to build robust reporting and analytical capabilities. These contributions will directly improve forecast precision and speed for senior leadership, regulators, and key stakeholders while advancing enterprise technology imperatives.


As a member of the Cash Forecasting team, the Senior Associate will gain a broad understanding of Capital One Treasury’s funding, investment, and reporting mechanics. The team regularly collaborates with cross-functional partners and senior leadership to provide cash activity guidance and support high-profile corporate initiatives. The role also offers direct opportunities to lead Treasury system enhancements, facilitate intercompany lending, and build relationships with traders and business partners.


The ideal candidate is a self-motivated, detail-oriented problem solver with strong intellectual curiosity. They bring experience in data analysis and programming languages, and excel at translating advanced technical material for non-technical audiences. Additionally, the candidate will have the drive and capacity to rapidly understand financial concepts, scaling from foundational principles to complex treasury topics.


Responsibilities:

  • Cash Forecasting & Liquidity Monitoring: Generate daily cash balance forecasts and execute monthly processes to inform funding strategy and liquidity metrics.
  • Model Maintenance & Enhancement: Serve as primary owner of the short-term cash forecast model, continuously optimizing model performance through enhancements and integration of new data sources.
  • Federal Reserve & Settlement Operations: Develop a deep understanding of Federal Reserve payment rails, funds settlement, and liquidity management to support daily cash operations.
  • Process Automation: Partner with team members to streamline existing treasury processes through automation and technical upgrades.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Interact with treasury front office, liquidity, and capital markets teams to communicate cash balance trends and perform ad-hoc financial analysis.
  • Enterprise Integration & Advisory: Advise cross-functional teams on M&A integration, structuring bank accounts, and cash forecasting workflows for acquired entities and new business lines.
  • Technical Communication: Translate complex treasury and financial concepts clearly for business partners across all organization levels.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or military experience
  • At least 2 years of experience in corporate treasury, financial analysis, or management consulting

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics or a related quantitative field
  • 3+ years of experience in corporate treasury, financial analysis, or management consulting
  • 1+ year of experience with SQL
  • 1+ year of experience with Python, R, or a combination
  • 1+ year of experience with AI tools such as Claude Code or Gemini
  • 1+ year of experience with Google Suite
  • Certified Treasury Professional designation

We're more than a workplace. We are a team of passionate people, boldly building the future of sport and entertainment, together. We believe in the power of play, the strength of collaboration, and the energy that comes from showing up with purpose.

Through MLSE Foundation and MLSE LaunchPad, we use the power of sport to help youth facing barriers reach their full potential. Since 2009, we’ve invested more than $45 million into Ontario communities -- and we’re just getting started.

This is what it means to be One MLSE: a culture where everyone plays a role, everyone belongs, and everyone contributes to something bigger than themselves.

So, if you're ready to play with purpose, grow with passion, and win as one, we’d love to have you on our team.

** We know that great candidates come from a variety of backgrounds and experiences. Even if you do not meet every qualification listed, we encourage you to apply. Your unique perspective, transferable skills, and lived experience may be exactly what we’re looking for. **

Job Description

The Manager, Premium Retention & Service is a key leadership role responsible for delivering an exceptional experience for some of our most valued premium Members. This role will lead the strategy and day-to-day execution of premium retention, relationship management and service across a sophisticated portfolio of premium products and spaces.


The ideal candidate brings a strong understanding of premium clientele and what differentiates a truly elevated experience. They are a relationship builder, people leader and creative thinker who is constantly looking for new ways to strengthen Member loyalty, enhance the premium experience and evolve how we serve our clients.


RESPONSIBILITIES


  • Lead, coach and develop the Maple Leafs and Raptors Premium Retention team who oversee and manage all Maple Leafs Platinum Club and Maple Leafs & Raptors ScotiaClub Members, creating a culture of accountability, collaboration and exceptional client service.
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with premium Members, understanding their individual needs, preferences and expectations.

  • Work collaboratively with the Maple Leafs and Raptors retention managers to develop and execute the Membership program
  • Champion the Member experience across our premium spaces (Platinum Club and ScotiaClub) alongside the Premium Club Experience and Food & Beverage Teams.
  • Bring fresh thinking to the premium business by identifying new service concepts, engagement opportunities and Member experiences that strengthen loyalty and differentiation.
  • Partner closely with Premium Sales, Premium Club & VIP Experiences, Ticketing, Food & Beverage, Venue Operations, Marketing and other internal teams to deliver a seamless end-to-end experience.

Job Description:

What’s the role

Shell is seeking a Refinery Products Blend Scheduler to join its team in Scotford.

Shell’s business requires the ability to quickly respond to changing market conditions and production capabilities to deliver the most value. The Refinery Products Blend Schedulers lead blending and scheduling activity for all distillate products (Diesels, Jet Fuel) and gasoline (regular and premium) for the Scotford integrated asset.

As a Refinery Products Blend Scheduler at Scotford, you are a key member of the Refinery Asset Optimization team, working closely with the Refinery Process Unit Scheduler, Refinery Economists, site Operations and Commercial Products Trading and Supply. You lead blending and scheduling activity for the integrated Scotford site, ensuring alignment with business objectives to capture market opportunities.

What you’ll be doing

  • Blending products (Diesels/ Jet fuel, and/or regular/premium gasoline) for the Scotford Refinery.
  • Interfacing with Calgary commercial Trading & Supply pipeline, truck, rail and marine schedulers, and other Trading & Supply personnel, to manage product supply to customers.
  • This includes managing inventory at Scotford Refinery for rail loading, and at the Sherwood Marketing Terminal (SMT) which distributes a significant volume via truck sales and serves as the staging area to inject into two product pipelines to outlaying terminals.
  • Tracking and optimizing product quality giveaway across the assigned product portfolio and leveraging Scotford operations personnel to ensure products meet specifications.
  • Issuing daily operating instructions to hourly production workforce indicating how the various blending systems are to be operated.
  • Providing off-hours support for blending and oil movement operations (tank farm operators) as needed on a rotational basis.
  • Coordinating seasonal product recipes with commercial Trading & Supply schedulers to ensure successful blend-up and blend-down is achieved for products across the supply chain, while minimizing giveaway.
  • Validating blend recipes produced by the linear program (LP) model and translating the monthly operating plan (MOP) into a detailed schedule to provide clear direction for Operations. Close coordination with the Refinery Process Unit Scheduler is required to ensure processing unit operations are optimized.
  • Providing key inputs for internal and external financial and production benchmarking and mandated reporting including but not limited to margin variance analysis (MVA).
  • Providing basic vacation coverage to the other scheduler and blender roles within the Refinery Asset Optimization team.
  • Leading continuous improvement projects in scheduling and blending, including but not limited to leveraging automation and digital technologies.
  • Coordinating with the other schedulers and blenders (and Economic Model Coordinators) needed improvements to the scheduling model to sustain useability of the tool and incorporate any automation and best-practices promptly.

The individual should be able to work as part of a multi-disciplinary team in an ever-changing and fast-paced environment. As the Refinery Asset Optimization department assists Production, extended coverage outside standard working hours may be required based on business need. Must also be an effective communicator, build strong relationships with the key process performers (Production and Technology), and be able to influence without formal authority.

What you bring

  • The candidate must have legal authorization to work in Canada on a full-time basis
  • Undergraduate degree in Science, Engineering or Business, and/or 3 or more years of relevant experience
  • Basic understanding of Refinery/Chemical economics and supply chain
  • Knowledge of production specifications and product quality reporting process an asset
  • Advance skill level in MS Excel or demonstrated capability to analyze large amounts of data
  • Understanding of IT technologies, Data Analysis techniques, databases, and reasonable computer programming skills is a plus
  • Ability to manage priorities effectively, balance multiple objectives and cope with occasionally high levels of stress in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent analytical, oral and written communication skills
  • Team player and self-motivated

description:
Job Description

The Role

General Motors is seeking a highly motivated research intern to support advanced electrification and propulsion research within the Energy and Propulsion Systems Research organization. The intern will contribute to the development of advanced motor topologies, control methods, and artificial-intelligence-enabled engineering tools for future hybrid-electric and battery-electric vehicles.


This role offers opportunities to combine analytical work, simulation, laboratory experimentation, and hands-on testing in a collaborative research environment.


What You'll Do:

  • Investigate advanced electric-machine topologies, including rare-earth-free synchronous reluctance machines, induction machines, and switched reluctance machines.
  • Develop, evaluate, and improve control strategies for electric drive systems.
  • Apply artificial intelligence and machine-learning methods to electric-machine design, controls, modeling, diagnostics, or performance optimization.
  • Support simulation, modeling, analysis, and concept development for HEV and EV propulsion systems.
  • Participate in drive-system testing, laboratory experiments, and validation of proof-of-concept hardware.
  • Contribute to power-electronics and circuit-design activities as needed by project assignments.
  • Analyze technical results and communicate findings through presentations, reports, and other research documentation.
  • Collaborate with researchers, engineers, laboratory staff, and cross-functional project teams.
  • Follow applicable laboratory, electrical-safety, data-management, and intellectual-property practices.

Required Qualifications:

  • Current enrollment in an accredited advanced degree (MS or PhD) program in engineering, computer science, applied mathematics, physics, or related field.
  • Demonstrated interest in electric machines, controls, power electronics, vehicle electrification, artificial intelligence, or a related technical area.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently while contributing effectively to a collaborative team.
  • Ability to work in a hybrid environment and participate in onsite laboratory or hardware-testing activities when required.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with electric-machine theory, motor drives, control systems, power electronics, or circuit design.
  • Experience with simulation or modeling tools such as MATLAB/Simulink, finite-element analysis software, or comparable engineering tools.
  • Programming experience in Python, MATLAB, C/C++, or a similar language.
  • Experience applying AI or machine learning to engineering, controls, design optimization, or data analysis.
  • Hands-on experience with laboratory instrumentation, dynamometer testing, motor testing, or power-electronics hardware.
  • Familiarity with HEV or EV propulsion systems.

What You Will Gain

  • Practical experience with advanced electric-drive research for future vehicles.
  • Exposure to rare-earth-free motor technologies and next-generation control strategies.
  • Opportunities to integrate modeling, simulation, AI, hardware development, and experimental validation.
  • Experience presenting technical work to research and engineering stakeholders.

title: Senior HPC Architect / HPC Program Lead
description:
Who We Are


Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.


What We Offer


Salary:

$140,500.00 - $193,000.00

Location:

Santa Clara,CA

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.

We are seeking an experienced HPC Technical Lead to drive the design, implementation and optimization of the organization's High-Performance Computing (HPC) environments. This is a hands-on technical role responsible for building and maintaining scalable, secure and high-performing HPC platforms across on-premises, cloud and hybrid environments.

The Tech Lead will be the go-to technical expert for HPC infrastructure, cloud HPC platforms, schedulers and AI/ML workloads. The ideal candidate will work closely with engineering teams, application users, IT operations and vendors to solve complex technical problems, provide technical guidance to team members, and ensure HPC platforms meet performance and reliability requirements.

Key Responsibilities

HPC Architecture & Engineering

  • Design, build and optimize HPC clusters across on-premises, cloud and hybrid environments.
  • Translate the HPC roadmap into technical designs, implementation plans and working solutions.
  • Evaluate and run proof-of-concepts for new HPC, GPU and cloud technologies, and share technical recommendations.
  • Define and follow technical standards, reference architectures and best practices for HPC environments.

Technical Requirement Analysis & Solutioning

  • Work with engineering, R&D and AI/ML users to understand workload, application and performance requirements.
  • Turn requirements into technical designs, cluster configurations and deployment approaches.
  • Conduct technical feasibility assessments, design reviews and benchmarking for new HPC use cases.
  • Act as the senior technical point of contact for HPC-related issues and solutions.

AI & GPU Computing

  • Design and support GPU-accelerated infrastructure for AI/ML training and inference workloads.
  • Tune GPU clusters, drivers, CUDA libraries and containers for performance and stability.
  • Work with AI/ML teams to optimize job scheduling, resource allocation and data pipelines.
  • Explore and prototype Generative AI and emerging technologies on HPC platforms.

Cloud HPC & Platform Management

  • Implement and maintain cloud HPC solutions on Azure, AWS and other providers.
  • Configure and manage HPC platforms such as Rescale, Azure CycleCloud, Slurm and related tools.
  • Automate cluster provisioning and configuration using infrastructure-as-code and scripting.
  • Ensure HPC environments meet security, compliance and business continuity requirements.
  • Monitor cloud resource usage and recommend technical cost optimizations.

Operations, Performance & Support

  • Act as the highest-level escalation point for complex HPC incidents and troubleshooting.
  • Perform performance tuning, benchmarking and capacity analysis for compute, storage and network.
  • Drive root cause analysis and implement permanent fixes for recurring issues.
  • Contribute to change management, patching, upgrades and platform reliability improvements.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, runbooks and knowledge articles.

Technical Guidance & Collaboration

  • Provide technical mentoring and guidance to HPC engineers and support staff.
  • Conduct code, configuration and design reviews.
  • Work with vendors and cloud providers on technical issues, product evaluations and escalations.
  • Coordinate with infrastructure, storage, networking, security and application teams on technical delivery.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology or a related field.
  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in HPC engineering, infrastructure or architecture roles.
  • 2+ years of experience in a technical lead or senior engineer role.
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of:
  • HPC cluster design, deployment and administration
  • Linux system administration and performance tuning
  • Slurm or equivalent HPC workload schedulers
  • Cloud HPC solutions (Azure, AWS)
  • Parallel file systems and high-performance storage (e.g., Lustre, GPFS, BeeGFS, Weka)
  • High-speed networking (InfiniBand, RDMA)
  • GPU computing (NVIDIA GPUs, CUDA)
  • MPI and parallel application environments
  • Strong scripting and automation skills (Python, Bash, PowerShell).
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code and configuration management tools (Terraform, Ansible or similar).
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting engineering simulation and scientific workloads in enterprise HPC environments.
  • Hands-on knowledge of CAE and CFD applications such as Ansys, Siemens or similar tools.
  • Experience with containers for HPC and AI (Apptainer/Singularity, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Experience with cloud-native AI platforms and MLOps workflows.
  • Familiarity with HPC security, compliance and governance frameworks.
  • Relevant certifications in cloud technologies (Azure, AWS) or HPC environments.

Key Competencies

  • HPC Architecture & Engineering
  • Technical Problem Solving
  • Performance Optimization
  • Cloud & Automation
  • AI/GPU Infrastructure
  • Technical Mentoring
  • Cross-Team Collaboration
  • Documentation & Communication

Success Metrics

  • HPC platform availability, performance and reliability.
  • Quality and timeliness of technical solutions and project delivery.
  • Reduction in incidents and faster resolution of complex issues.
  • Improved job performance and resource utilization.
  • User and engineering team satisfaction.

Scope

Global HPC Infrastructure, Cloud HPC, AI/GPU Platforms, Engineering Applications and Technical Operations.

Additional Information

Time Type:

Full time

Employee Type:

Assignee / Regular

Travel:

Yes, 10% of the Time

Relocation Eligible:

No

description:

title: Product Lifecycle Manager
description:
As the global leader in high-speed connectivity, Ciena builds the critical infrastructure powering the AI era. We’re a technology company shaping the future of networking, guided by innovation, integrity, and collaboration. Through development opportunities, meaningful work, and flexibility, Ciena supports growth and well-being—on and off the job. Connect with a career that matters.


Ready to lead from the front? This is a high-impact opportunity for a seasoned, commercially minded product leader who thrives on momentum, tackles ambiguity with confidence, and wants to maximize the contribution margin of our Broadband FTTx and DCOM Products. You will connect customer and market insight to decisive business execution, formulating strategies to scale profitable products and manage graceful retirements.


As Product Lifecycle Manager, you will operate at the center of customers, Sales, Engineering, Supply Chain, and executive leadership. You will bring a strong point of view on the market, convert complex inputs into clear priorities, and drive measurable customer and business outcomes.


This role is built for someone who enjoys pace, ownership, and variety. You will balance strategy with hands-on execution, developing business cases, evaluating market opportunities, guiding pricing and positioning, tracking business performance, and creating alignment across diverse teams. Success requires sound judgement, curiosity, resilience, and the drive to turn product capabilities into revenue growth, market success, and customer satisfaction.


How You Will Make an Impact

· Business Management: Build and maintain product business cases that connect pricing strategy, margin, revenue opportunity, cost structure, competitive positioning, investment trade-offs, and profitability objectives.

· Lifecycle Management: Formulate strategies for scaling profitable products and managing graceful retirements. Engage directly with account teams and customers to uncover network evolution priorities, support architecture discussions, validate roadmap assumptions, and position Ciena solutions around meaningful customer outcomes.

· Cross-Functional Coordination: Partner with R&D, design, procurement, quality assurance, and sales and support teams to keep product data and timelines synchronized. Turn customer needs, market shifts, standards evolution, technology trends, and competitive insight into crisp product requirements, compelling business cases, investment priorities, and lifecycle plans.

· Risk & Change Management: Overcome supply chain bottlenecks, technical roadblocks, or market shifts by implementing engineering change orders (ECOs) and risk mitigation plans.

· Data & Quality Governance: Create urgency and alignment across Engineering, Supply Chain, Marketing, Services, and account teams while making product lifecycle decisions based on data and technical diligence.


The Must Haves:

· Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, business, or a related field; an advanced technical degree is preferred.

· 10+ years of experience in Product Lifecycle Management roles working for telecom, datacom, or networking equipment vendors.

· A track record of leading complex, cross-functional initiatives and delivering results through influence across engineering, commercial, operational, and customer-facing organizations.

· Strong business acumen, including hands-on experience with business cases, pricing, forecasting, portfolio planning, competitive analysis, profitability, investment prioritization, and product lifecycle decisions.

· A proactive, action-oriented approach, with the ability to move quickly, manage competing priorities, and maintain momentum in a fast-paced environment.


What Will Set You Apart

· A proven ability to bring clarity to ambiguity, make smart trade-offs, simplify complexity, and rally teams around execution milestones and measurable outcomes.

· Strong judgement in evaluating innovation through both technical feasibility and business impact, including customer value, execution risk, time-to-market, differentiation, and financial return.

· The ability to communicate with impact at every level, from detailed engineering discussions to executive-level transformation narratives.

General Motors has a need for qualified Mechanical Journeypersons (Machine Repair). You will work under minimal supervision with a high level of independent judgement and problem solving. You should be flexible enough to take on and tackle multiple job assignments in a shift.


Preferred Experience Includes:

  • Experience with planned maintenance systems and predictive technologies
  • Experience with industrial robotics, automation, and conveyance systems


Primary Responsibilities:

  • Follow established safety procedures according to OSHA standards and company procedures
  • Maintain, dismantle, repair, and replace mechanical and hydraulic components (e. g. bearings, seals, details, carriers, etc.) on industrial machinery such as shafting, motors, generators, air compressors, engines, pumps, cylinders, gears, couplings, linkages, ball screws, high speed CNC spindles, coolant systems and filters, and combustion equipment and valves
  • Layout, assemble, fabricate, maintain, and repair piping systems
  • Use various hand or power tools for measuring, cutting, threading, grooving, bending, soldering, assembling, joining, and installing pipes, valves, and fittings
  • Read and interpret blueprints for the mechanical operation and assembly of conveyor systems, material handling systems, robots, and other automation
  • Operate mobile equipment (e.g. forklifts, vertical lifts, cranes)
  • Determine loading requirements to rig equipment and material for lifting
  • Set up and operate conventional or computer numerically controlled (CNC) machine tools such as lathes, milling machines, and grinders to cut, bore, grind, or otherwise shape parts to prescribed dimensions and finishes
  • Fabricate punches, tools, steel rule tools and t-sets to exact specifications
  • Plan sequences of operations for fabricating tools or assemblies using blueprints, sketches, or models

description:
This role is based in Letterkenny and will be 2 days on site a week. This role will be 11am - 7pm (some flexibility).


A GLOBAL LEADING ASSET MANAGER WITH A DIVERSE & INCLUSIVE CULTURE

As the Global Asset Management business of Prudential, we’re always looking for ways to improve financial services. We’re passionate about making a meaningful impact - touching the lives of millions and solving financial challenges in an ever-changing world.


We also believe talent is key to achieving our vision and are intentional about building a culture on respect and collaboration. When you join PGIM, you’ll unlock a motivating and impactful career – all while growing your skills and advancing your profession at one of the world’s leading global asset managers!


If you’re not afraid to think differently and challenge the status quo, come and be a part of a dedicated team that’s investing in your future by shaping tomorrow today.


At PGIM, You Can!


What you will do:

Are you looking for a career that helps you apply your love of data, financial analysis, investments and technology to inform business and system strategy and work with diverse teams on challenging projects? Are you passionate about being a part of an Investment Accounting Business Analysis group that is focused on developing technical and professional skills while collaborating alongside internal business partners and technologists in the asset management and financial management community? If you are results driven, have a real passion for working with financial data, and are deeply analytical, technically adept and highly innovative, then our Prudential Global Services Business Analysis team is the place for you! We provide the technology support that contributes to PGIM being a world-class investment manager through an integrated technology and data strategy.


Our group supports PGIM Investment Accounting Systems through all aspects of the software development life cycle. We work closely with our internal contacts to meet their needs with an increased focus on transformation, automation and improved data/workflow. We look for innovative solutions and continue to add new technology to the mix. Team members work on a variety of projects and support many different systems, applications, programs and processes.


What you can expect:

  • Identifying solutions to complex business problems by gathering, analyzing, and documenting business and systems requirements to enhance operational performance.
  • Reviewing user and/or Operations requests and conducting data-gathering interviews.
  • Writing business specifications/requirements/rules, redesigning applications/processes, creating mockups, and analyzing user data.
  • Partnering closely with clients and developers to work through the phases of systems development lifecycle (SDLC).
  • Creating test plans to validate that system functionality satisfies associated business requirements.
  • Designing and implementing tests for systems changes. Developing test cases matrices, creating actual test cases, executing tests, reviewing of actual vs. expected results, communicating and resolving issues and documenting results.
  • Interacting with product owners/clients, other business analysts, software developers and testers in the group.
  • Utilizing various technologies which may include (but are not limited to) Jira, Excel, SQL, Visio, Python, Selenium, Oracle, SQL Server, Power BI/Tableau, Cognos, Power Automate, data processing/manipulation, compare tools, automated test tools, and Xceptor.

What you will bring:

  • Ideally you will have experience in the banking and financial services industry, fund administration, accounting, tax or operations experience in financial services.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Management Information Systems (MIS), Business Analytics and Information Technology (BAIT). Business, Accounting, Computer Science, Finance, Economics, or a related field.
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills.
  • Strong project management, organization and communication skills.
  • Ability to work with some schedule flexibility to extend overlap and collaboration with U.S. based partners and stakeholders.

What will set you apart?

  • Experience with SQL and related tools (e.g., Microsoft Query, Rapid SQL, DBeaver, etc.) preferred.
  • Knowledge of the Software Development Life-Cycle preferred; experience with Agile methodology is a plus.
  • Experience with Cognos or other reporting platforms is a plus.
  • Experience with business analysis, requirements, software testing or productivity tools (e.g., automated testing tools, compare tools, robotics, data visualization, Python) a plus

*PGIM welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply.

What we offer you

  • Health Insurance: PGIM Ireland partner with Laya and BUPA to provide health insurance schemes that cover eligible employees day to day medical and hospital expenses.
  • Annual Leave of 23 days at full pay.
  • Pension Scheme: Members of the scheme can contribute up to 8% of salary per annum and PGIM Ireland matches contributions up to 8% of salary. Members can also make voluntary contributions to the scheme.
  • Life Assurance: fully paid by PGIM Ireland, employees are covered from their start date and beneficiaries are provided with a lump sum of four times an employee’s salary.
  • Education Assistance: PGIM Ireland have an Education Assistance Programme that reimburses eligible employees for furthering their education.

PGIM is the global asset management business of Prudential Financial, Inc. (NYSE: PRU), a leading global investment manager with nearly US$1.34 trillion in assets under management as of March 31st, 2024. With offices in 18 countries, PGIM’s businesses offer a range of investment solutions for retail and institutional investors around the world across a broad range of asset classes, including public fixed income, private fixed income, fundamental equity, quantitative equity, real estate and alternatives.

title: Sr. Manager RGM Trade Promo (TPM/TPO) Lead
location: East Hanover, New Jersey, United States
description:
Job Description

Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It With Pride.

You ensure that customer plans are developed and executed by supporting the delivery of strategies and tactics for growth. You understand the business metrics and financial drivers needed to unlock profitable growth for Mondelēz International and our customers and work with key account managers to implement plans to deliver our annual target.

How you will contribute

You will:

  • Leads the development of the trade marketing part of the category annual plans (contract process)
  • Understands market dynamics / consumer insights by channel to participate on trade marketing strategic decisions
  • Leads the business planning meeting where the sales quotas are built in order to accomplish the annual plans based on relevant building blocks
  • Suggests and influences investment in category building blocks, according to category and channel need, and is accountable of execution excellence at point of sale
  • Follows up the competition’s commercial activity in the category in order to detect business opportunities and potential threats for the brand
  • Plays a leadership role within the multi categories teams by leading, providing accurate and relevant channel point of sale information that will lead to find business opportunities such as innovations, customer promotions, portfolio, pricing, etc. that will lead to achieve multi categories targets

What you will bring

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career and the following experience and knowledge:

  • Category planning and delivering growth through category leadership
  • Having a future-focused mindset, being curious about industry trends, digital solutions and innovation for consumers, and translating opportunities into business plans
  • Developing and delivering plans, measuring and monitoring results and making recommendations to achieve growth targets
  • Business planning and how to maximize revenue growth
  • Influencing stakeholders and interacting effectively with others with the courage and resilience to hold an alternative point of view
  • Analytical skills and business acumen

Mondelēz is on an RGM transformation journey. Mondelēz operates globally through a decentralized model of 4 regions, with a working motto of “Local First, But Not Local Only”. Each market is at a different starting point in its RGM capability. The Global Product Owner, Trade Promo is an individual contributor role. It sets the global promo direction and leads the global deployment of TPO, together with TPM, with MDS. It works through Regional and Market RGM leaders to improve trade-investment productivity. In this global role, the candidate must be a:


Master of:

  • Functional Skills - trade promotion management and optimization in CPG: promo guardrails, incrementality, ROI and post-event evaluation, and how promo fits with price, pack and terms.
  • Technical Knowledge - TPM and TPO tools, promo and elasticity analytics, and product ownership of RGM tools with MDS.

Job Purpose

  • Improve trade-investment productivity so that markets run fewer, better and more profitable promo events.
  • Lead the global deployment of TPO, with TPM, as a global first for RGM AI, together with MDS and the flying team.
  • Set the global promo standards and guardrails, and deploy them in partnership with Regional and Market RGM leaders.

Responsibilities / Activities: (non-exhaustive)

Global direction (strategic)

  • Set the global promo direction: the role of promo by category and channel type, depth, frequency, mechanics and investment guardrails, and the thresholds above which a promo plan needs global review.
  • Own the standard for incrementality, ROI, opportunity sizing and post-event evaluation, including the baseline method. It builds on the elasticity standard owned by Smart Pricing & Trade Terms, and post-event results feed TPO’s learning.
  • Align promo with price and pack choices through the cross-lever review, and with demand and supply plans with Supply Chain.
  • Run a quarterly promo review with Regional and Market RGM leaders, working from exceptions and a few deep dives, and escalate patterns that need a change in standard.
  • Set the global TPO ambition and value case, including how TPO value is measured. Set the readiness criteria and the market prioritisation for deployment waves.
  • Set the rules for using TPO recommendations, including when a market may override, and monitor override outcomes to improve the rules.
  • Codify what works and build capability: mechanics playbook, TPO ways of working, coaching and a practitioner community.

Product ownership: TPO and TPM, with Mondelez Digital Services (MDS)

  • Own TPO and TPM, each with its own roadmap, backlog and releases, and the TPO deployment plan with MDS. Accept releases against the business requirements.
  • Set adoption targets for both tools, track TPO forecast quality over time, and agree readiness for each deployment wave with the flying team.
  • Define and own the TPO AI use case and its value hypothesis.

Success Metrics:

  • Promo ROI against target.
  • Promo events above the ROI threshold.
  • Volume sold on promo against plan.
  • TPO value delivered against hypothesis.
  • Promo ROI in TPO markets against non-TPO markets.

Results are shared with markets. This role owns the standards and tools behind them.


Qualifications/Requirements:

  • 8-10 years of relevant experience (Band SG13).

Track record of:

  • Set a promo investment guardrail that was adopted across multiple markets.
  • Diagnosed a driver of weak promo ROI and corrected it with Sales and Finance.
  • Built a TPM, TPO or post-event evaluation standard that scaled beyond its original market.
  • Co-owned a tool roadmap with a technology team, not just given requirements.

Knowledge and skills:

  • Deep command of incrementality, promo ROI, elasticity, cannibalization and halo effects.
  • Strong digital and product-management capability, and fluency in AI-assisted analytics.
  • Ability to challenge senior Sales, Finance and regional leaders and steer complex change across regions, with a bias toward investment discipline.



Salary and Benefits:

The base salary range for this position is $140,300 to $192,940; the exact salary depends on several factors such as experience, skills, education and location. In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for participation in a highly competitive bonus program with possibility for overachievement based on performance and company results.

In addition, Mondelez International offers the following benefits: health insurance, wellness and family support programs, life and disability insurance, retirement savings plans, paid leave programs, education related programs, paid holidays and vacation time. Some of these benefits have eligibility requirements. Many of these benefits are subsidized or fully paid for by the company.

No Relocation support available

Business Unit Summary

At Mondelēz International, our purpose is to empower people to snack right by offering the right snack, for the right moment, made the right way. That means delivering a broad range of delicious, high-quality snacks that nourish life's moments, made with sustainable ingredients and packaging that consumers can feel good about.

We have a rich portfolio of strong brands globally and locally including many household names such as Oreo, belVita and LU biscuits; Cadbury Dairy Milk, Milka and Toblerone chocolate; Sour Patch Kids candy and Trident gum. We are proud to hold the top position globally in biscuits, chocolate and candy and the second top position in gum.

Our 80,000 makers and bakers are located in more than 80 countries and we sell our products in over 150 countries around the world. Our people are energized for growth and critical to us living our purpose and values. We are a diverse community that can make things happen—and happen fast.

Mondelēz International is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Regular

Completes assigned close tasks to the close calendar and checklist; confirms task completion in the tracker; flags risks to deadlines to the reviewer before the due date; supports cut-off and accrual data collection.

title: Sterile Processing Tech
description:

Responsible for inspecting, disinfecting, assembling, processing and distributing patient care instruments, equipment and supplies in accordance with established policies, procedures and Association of Advancement of Medical Instrumentation (AAMI) standards. Stores, rotates and ensures all instruments and supplies are correctly labeled.


Essential Functions

Utilizes the insulation tester, leak tester (flex scopes) and other mechanical/digital validation tools to ensures that proper sterilization occurs.

title: Clinical Equipment Technician
description:
SUMMARY:

The Clinical Equipment Technician (PCE) Tech reports to the Supervisor, Patient Care Equipment. Cleans, disinfects, and delivers medical equipment, accessories, and supplies. Tech will be expected to assist with record keeping and re-ordering of supplies for the department.


Brown University Health employees are expected to successfully role model the organization's values of Compassion, Accountability, Respect, and Excellence as these values guide our everyday actions with patients, customers and one another.


RESPONSIBILITIES:

Delivers clean disinfected medical equipment, accessories and supplies as requested by the clinical units. Confirm basic operations of portable equipment to ensure working order and to ensure appropriate repairs are made. Cleans and disinfects returned equipment and accessories according to established policy.

Perform daily rounds to ensure rotation and adequate supply of portable equipment and oxygen cylinders are distributed to clinical areas.

Perform daily rounds to maintain an adequate supply of oxygen cylinders to meet safety guidelines.

Document all PCE activities in the Equipment Management system.

Perform thorough visual inspection of portable medical equipment to ensure all mechanics are intact and functioning properly. Perform troubleshooting where appropriate including but not limited to battery changes, power cord and cable integrity, and hose replacement.

Conduct daily inventories of crash carts, equipment and supplies. Maintain the code cart exchange program including rotation of supplies, replenishment of cart supplies, and documentation in Maximo post event.

Maintain cleanliness and organization of all Patient Care Equipment storage rooms.

Provides input in PCE department procedure changes and assists in implementation.

Communicate equipment problems beyond the scope of departmental resolve to Supervisor or Medical Engineering personnel.

Maintain quality assurance, safety, environmental and infection control in accordance with established hospital department policies, procedures and objectives.

Remove malfunctioning equipment from service and coordinate with Medical Engineering for repair. Collaborate to expedite discharges by delivering durable medical equipment (DME) to patients in a timely manner.

Perform other duties as assigned.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

High School diploma or equivalent is required in addition to six months on-the-job training, or equivalent experience required.


Ability to use Windows based maintenance management program to enter and retrieve service records. Organizational and interpersonal skills are necessary to collaborate with coworkers and/or work independently to ensure task completion. Problem solving, prioritization, and time management skills are required to accommodate fast paced hospital environment. Customer service skills are necessary to deal with vendor and customer requests.


EXPERIENCE:

Six to twelve months experience with hospital environment and familiarity with hospital equipment preferred.


WORK ENVIRONMENT AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

Potential contact with hazardous waste, dust and dirt when cleaning and retrieving equipment may occur.

There is also the potential for exposure to electrical hazards. Occasional exposure to contagious disease through the retrieval of used equipment. Hazards are minimized by adherence to established safety procedures and precautions.

Position requires constant walking and pushing of equipment, and occasional lifting of up to 60 lbs.

Position requires inter- and intra-department communication to complete tasks appropriately.

None.

$18.00-$25.82

The Vice President, Global Inventory and Fulfillment leads global logistics, warehousing, distribution, inventory planning, and fulfillment. This leader balances cost, service, and supply continuity while aligning teams, partners, systems, and controls with manufacturing, commercial growth, and regulatory requirements.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Lead global freight, transportation, and distribution strategies across air, sea, and land to optimize landed cost, inventory carrying cost, and service.
  • Manage finished goods positioning, inventory turns, in-stock rates, peak capacity, and material inventory reporting, including average days on hand (ADOH).
  • Lead 3PL, carrier, and international distributor relationships; negotiate contracts and enforce service-level agreements.
  • Oversee operating budgets, capital plans, purchasing controls, and maintenance, repair, and operating (MRO) procurement.
  • Establishes and rapidly expands international business processes such as planning and distribution, including relationship with International Distributors.
  • Lead department planning for headcount, budgets, training, and systems; select and develop staff and support performance reviews, merit recommendations, and promotions.
  • Set, communicate, and evaluate annual team goals aligned with company priorities.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Operations, or a related technical field; Master’s degree and APICS certification preferred.
  • 15 years of progressive leadership experience in global supply chain, logistics, or fulfillment within a medical device market greater than $500M, including 8 years in senior management leading these teams.
  • Expertise in multi-region distribution centers, international trade and customs, high-volume inventory, production-cycle material planning, and procurement support for new products.
  • Strong financial acumen, including cost modeling, P&L ownership, and annual resource and material budgeting; data-driven process and resource prioritization.
  • Extensive ERP knowledge across planning, scheduling, purchasing, and inventory control.
  • cGMP experience and strong knowledge of QSR/GMP principles, documentation, policies, procedures, protocols, work instructions, and inspection requirements.
  • Ability to lead distributed teams across the US, EMEA, and Asia, collaborate across functions, communicate technical information and timelines, and drive quality and productivity improvements.


WHEN & WHERE YOU’LL WORK:

Remote (U.S.): This is a fully remote position open to candidates located within the United States, with a preference for individuals residing in the Eastern Time Zone. All necessary equipment will be provided, and onboarding and training will be conducted virtually.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:

The starting base pay range for this position is $225,000 - $295,000 annually. Base pay will vary based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience and may also fluctuate depending on candidate’s location and the overall job market. In addition to base pay, Tandem offers a competitive compensation package that includes bonus and a robust benefits package.


Tandem offers health care benefits such as medical, dental, vision available your first day, as well as health savings accounts and flexible saving accounts. You’ll also receive 11 paid holidays per year, unlimited PTO and you will have access to a 401k plan with company match as well as an Employee Stock Purchase plan. Learn more about Tandem’s benefits here!


YOU SHOULD KNOW:

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local Fair Chance laws and regulations. A conditional offer of employment from Tandem is contingent upon successful completion of a pre-employment screening process comprised of a drug test (excluding marijuana) and background check, which includes a review of criminal history information.

Tandem has good cause to conduct a review of criminal history information of candidates for this position, as this role may involve access to proprietary, sensitive and/or confidential information, including customer protected health information. This review is required to ensure that individuals in such roles uphold high standards of trust and integrity so as to protect the interests of our customers, employees, and stakeholders.


SPONSORSHIP:

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE:
At Tandem, we believe joy fuels excellence. That's why we've built a workplace that celebrates your achievements and supports your well-being. Our team thrives on pushing boundaries and fostering growth, all while maintaining a spirit of fun and camaraderie. This is just one of the ways we stay awesome! Explore the benefits and reasons to love Tandem at .

BE YOU, WITH US!

We embrace the value that every single one of us brings to the table. But sometimes we forget that when we don’t meet 100% of a job description’s criteria – maybe you’re feeling that way right now? We encourage you to apply anyway. Because we want you to be you, with us.

Tandem is firmly committed to being an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, sex, race, religion or belief, gender identity or expression, marriage/civil partnership, pregnancy/maternity, or sexual orientation. We are an inclusive organization, and we welcome applications from a wide range of candidates. Selection for roles will be based on individual merit alone.

REFERRALS:
We love a good referral! If you know someone who would be a great fit for this position, please share!

APPLICATION DEADLINE:
The position will be posted until a final candidate is selected for the requisition or the requisition has a sufficient number of applications.
