title: Category Insights Manager
description:
Cheers to a Beer & Spirits Career!

Join the team that has been recognized by both USA Today and The Dallas Morning News as a Top Workplace!

The fact that you landed here indicates you are looking for a better workplace. Maybe you feel unappreciated, and you are tired of being treated like just another employee. When you join our team, you become part of the Andrews

family, a place where you valued and respected.

We invest in our team members and are dedicated to their success by offering:

  • Weekly Pay, Every Friday
  • Health, Dental, & Vision Insurance
  • Paid Vacation & Sick Time
  • 401k with Company Match (FREE Money!!)

And yes, you will receive free Beer throughout the year! (Root beer to those under 21 years old.) After all, you will be working for an award-winning BEER & Spirits distributor, and we want you to enjoy the brands you already love like Modelo, Coors, Miller Lite, Corona, Heineken, Blue Moon, Shiner, Sam Adams, Dos Equis, Revolver, Lakewood, Rahr, Truly, Topo Chico, Twisted Tea, Pacifico, and many more!!

And for those who enjoy spirits, Andrews is now distributing some of the top brands within the Spirits category such as Buffalo Trace, Fireball, Southern Comfort, Corazon, Wheatley, Seagram's, Canadian Mist, and other Whiskey, Rum, Vodka, Gin, Brandy, Cognac, and Tequila brands!

So let's talk about the role...


A Category Insights Manager (Channel/Portfolio) is responsible for analyzing industry and shopper trends, supporting long-term strategies for product categories and channel segments, while managing relationships with internal team members and external customers. They maximize portfolio opportunity through product assortment, pricing, promotion and space planning through a Channel- or Portfolio-focused lens. This role is part of the Customer Growth Strategy team.


A Category Insights Manager can be expected to perform the following tasks in this role as a routine part of their job:


Conducts high quality analysis and synthesizes multiple data sources to generate insights and actionable recommendations. (50%)

  • Leverages critical thinking and problem-solving skills to recognize and anticipate opportunities by elevating analyses beyond reporting and translate insights into retail action.
  • Utilizes internal and external data to optimize new product introduction, distribution, shelving, pricing, and promotional strategies across stakeholders and customer.
  • Conducts analysis using category management capabilities, analytical tools, and data visualizations to identify and communicate opportunities.
  • Prioritizes tasks with focus on strategic versus tactical activities that deliver ROI.
  • Maintains a strong understanding of Andrews’ sales processes, systems, portfolio, markets and the competition.
  • Compiles and conducts data analysis and provides insights and recommendations specifically related to Portfolio or channel.
  • Channel Focus Only: Conducts data analysis and provides insights and recommendations specifically related to the Liquor and On Premise channels.

Partners with cross functional teams and stakeholders to understand strategies and objectives. (30%)

  • Partners and collaborates with the Brand, Andrews’ Center of Excellence (ACOE) and stakeholders to understand and build strategies and objectives.
  • Contributes to Andrews Shopper First Planning process, focusing efforts on measurable value creation with stakeholders.
  • Participates in Annual Planning process with stakeholders.
  • Partners and provides guidance to Category Manager team members.
  • Tracks and reports on category performance and assists in building selling materials for stakeholders.
  • Leads Enterprise efforts in developing category plans.
  • Portfolio Focus Only: Manages communication with brand leadership and channel managers, driving deep understanding of insight and portfolio strategy.
  • Channel Focus Only: Manages communication with channel managers, driving deep understanding of insights and assortment strategy.

Creates insight driven presentations with actionable tactics and strategies with an eye towards storytelling. (20%)

  • Builds compelling presentations utilizing external, internal data resources and other visualization tools.
  • Provides category management reporting, trend analysis, customized reports and special project work for cross functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Collaborates with On/Off Sales teams to develop customer focused presentations representative of the current retail market and environment.
  • Drives Category and Space Management best practices.
  • Collaborates with Category Managers to assist in developing customer focused presentations that represent the current retail market and environment.

This list is not all inclusive of other tasks and subtasks that may be necessary in performing this role, but rather an overview of the role’s primary work tasks.


CAPABILITIES

A Category Insights Manager has a greater opportunity to succeed if they can develop and master the following job-related capabilities and KSAs:


KNOWLEDGE

  • Andrews Portfolio
  • Beer, Spirits and Distribution Industry
  • Category Management/Space Management
  • Competitive Portfolios
  • Customer Centric Planning
  • Customer Service Principles
  • FAVR/Motus
  • Inventory Management - Backroom
  • JDA Planning Software Knowledge
  • LYTX
  • Market Segmentation Principles
  • Merchandising Literacy
  • Model Market Concepts
  • OSHA Policies and Procedures
  • Packaging and Code Dates
  • Quality Standards and Code Dates
  • Retail Channels
  • Retailer Strategies
  • Safety Standards and Procedures
  • Sales Team Structure and Understanding
  • Selling Principles
  • Supplier Expertise
  • Swap and Drop Procedure
  • Syndicated Data Knowledge
  • TABC Guidelines

SKILLS & ABILITIES

  • Ability to Build Trust
  • Ability to Collaborate and Influence at all Organizational Levels
  • Ability to Manage Workflow, Commitments and Meet Deadlines
  • Ability to Organize and Prioritize Workload
  • Ability to Solve Problems and Develop Potential Solutions
  • Ability to Use Data and Insights to Create Actionable Selling Stories
  • Ability to Work Steadily at a Fast Pace to Meet Time Schedules and Deadlines
  • Analytical Thinking and Problem Solving Skills
  • Active Listening and Feedback Skills
  • Change Management Skills
  • Coaching, Training and Mentoring Skills
  • Communication and Interpersonal Skills
  • Customer Service Skills
  • Decision Making Skills
  • JDA Planning Software Proficiency
  • Negotiation Skills
  • Project Management Skills
  • Selling Skills
  • Teamwork Skills
  • Technical Aptitude/Computer/iPad Skills

QUALIFICATIONS

A qualified candidate for the Category Insights Manager role should satisfy the expectations below:


REQUIRED


Category Insights Manager – Channel

  • Three Plus Years of Progressively Responsible Category Management, Sales, and Brand
  • Three Plus Years of Data Analysis and Solutions Development; Ability to Work Across Multiple Datasets
  • Proven Change Management Leadership Skills and the Ability to Influence Others
  • Previous Category Management and Space Planning Software Experience
  • Proven Project Management Skills
  • Strong Understanding of the Beer, Spirits and Beverage Industry

Category Insights Manager – Portfolio

  • Five Plus Years of Progressively Responsible Category Management, Sales, and Brand
  • Three Plus Years of Data Analysis and Solutions Development; Ability to Work Across Multiple Datasets
  • Proven Change Management Leadership Skills and the Ability to Influence Others
  • Previous Category Management and Space Planning Software Experience
  • Proven Project Management Skills
  • Strong Understanding of the Beer, Spirits and Beverage Industry



PREFERRED


Category Insights Manager – Channel

  • Bachelors in Sales, Analytics or Other Related Field
  • Strong Financial and Business Acumen
  • Previous Brand Management Experience
  • Cicerone Certified Beer Server

Category Insights Manager – Portfolio

  • Bachelors in Sales, Analytics or Other Related Field
  • Strong Financial and Business Acumen
  • Previous Brand Management Experience
  • Cicerone Certified Beer Server

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS & ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  • Ability to maintain a sustained posture in a seated position for prolonged periods of time and operate computer equipment.
  • Ability to bend, stoop, and twist is required for filing and general office duties.
  • Requires intermittent periods during which continuous physical exertion is required, such as standing, walking, stooping, climbing, lifting material or equipment, some of which maybe heavy or awkward.
  • Exerts up to 55 lbs of force occasionally and/or negligible amount frequently to move office-related items or materials.
  • Ability to use a personal computer for tasks such as communicating via email, preparing reports and other forms of documentation using company and industry software.
  • Ability to speak, hear, and see is required to communicate with employees, and to operate computers and office machinery.
  • Hand-eye coordination and fine manipulation skills are necessary to operate computers and various office equipment.
  • Continual hand/wrist motion is required to operate computers and office machinery.

  • Ability to perform job functions in compliance with company policies and procedures, including safety policies and best practices.
  • Must be able to maintain a current/valid driver's license.
  • Must maintain regular and punctual attendance.

title: RME Planner
description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

RME Planner - JLL

What this job involves:

The RME Planner will be a member of the Reliability Maintenance and Engineering team and will work with network the Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) team as well as the Reliability Manager to maximize material handling equipment uptime for Operations associates. This position is responsible for developing maintenance plans and schedules based on recurring preventive maintenance activities, predictive maintenance data and KPIs. Key activities for this position include screening EAM work orders, auditing equipment to document work requirements and quality, estimate labor hours, materials, tools and equipment for all assigned work orders to support a proactive, reliability-centered maintenance (RCM) program. This role will work closely with Maintenance management, Maintenance Technicians, Control Systems Technicians and Operations teams to plan, coordinate and schedule proactive maintenance activities during available downtime windows. This will help prevent unplanned downtime of material handling equipment and disruption to production activities. The RME Planner will have a strong focus on our leadership principles of Innovation, Bias for Action and Ownership of their maintenance program.

What your day-to-day will look like:

  • Travel up to 15% is required.
  • Measure and publish facility’s PI metrics to the management team; interpret data, troubleshoot process, and make recommendations based on findings.
  • Develop and maintain accuracy of equipment metadata by regularly collecting and inputting information, such as: manufacturer, model, serial number, and system structure information. The data is maintained in EAM and equipment is labeled/barcoded or identifiable in the facility.
  • Develop and maintain accuracy of Work Order related data.
  • User Setup, Employees, Shifts, Crews, and Supervisors.
  • Adding Equipment to PM Plans, Schedules, and Work Packages.
  • Defining Scheduled due dates or initial meter points of system generated WOs.
  • Develop and maintain FC specific PM Plans, Schedules, Routes, and Work Packages.
  • Support management in the review of WO Data accuracy such as: Equipment on WOs, Booked Hours (Employee and Vendors), parts usage, WO type, closing codes and WO Comments.
  • Support management in the scheduling and assigning of work. Manage work orders in the system, ensure proper creation, planning, update and closure of work orders.
  • Develop and maintain accuracy of spare parts metadata by regularly collecting and inputting information, such as: supplier, catalog number, min/max quantities, pricing, manufacturer, and part numbers.
  • Drive materials management process in the facilities store.
  • Create and or Generate Requisitions, POs, PO Receipts (EAM & Oracle).
  • Develop and maintain the 5s of the store.
  • Work with facilities team to develop and maintain lists of critical spares.
  • Audit materials management process with regularly scheduled cycle counts.
  • Support management with data to implement corrective action as discovered in cycle counts, KPIs or other EAM data.
  • Work with facilities team to reduce costs and improve parts quality.
  • Works with corporate EAM Business Analysts to roll out new functionality, standard object coding scheme, Preventive Maintenance (PM) procedures and scheduling, and EAM reports.
  • Provides software trainings to end users and new EAM Administrators; serves as liaison for problem solving and escalation.
  • Coach and educate staff on the EAM functions and best practices for performing tasks. Serves as Tier 1 EAM support for the facilities team.

Required Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma or equivalent diploma
  • 2+ years’ experience planning, scheduling, and auditing overall facilities/maintenance activities.
  • 1 year of experience working with computers and Microsoft Office (Including Outlook, Word, Excel)
  • Ability to work flexible schedules/shifts/areas, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
  • Travel up to 15% is required

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 2-year Associate degree (or professional training) in Business Administration, Information System, Engineering, or related fields.
  • 3+ years’ experience working with enterprise software and an understanding of standard work process.
  • Project management experience.
  • 4+ years’ working experience working with enterprise asset management software suit. Infor EAM ASE is highly desired.
  • 2+ years’ data analysis experience in the facilities maintenance program, specifically in asset management and spare part optimization.

Physical Demands:

  • Repetitive bending, crouching, kneeling, reaching, twisting, sitting, standing, and walking during
  • Lifting parts and tools weighing on average 20 pounds, occasionally weighing up to 49 pounds
  • Dexterity in eye/hand coordination, feet (foot pedals) manual (picking, pinching, holding, grasping), and wrist motion (repetitive flexion/rotation)
  • Working conditions may include small spaces, dust, fumes/odors, hot/cold temperatures, inside/outside noise, vibration, standing on concrete for long hours and wet or uneven surfaces

description:

  • 5 years of previous banking experience, including consumer lending and exposure to business lending origination experience required.

title: Senior Director of Fleet Services
description:
Job Overview:

The Senior Director of Fleet Services provides strategic and operational leadership for the company’s fleet repair and maintenance function, supporting a geographically dispersed construction fleet across multiple business units and regions.

This position is responsible for improving equipment availability and reliability, reducing downtime, strengthening preventive maintenance, controlling costs, and establishing consistent maintenance practices. The role partners with Fleet, Operations, HSE, Procurement, and business-unit leadership to ensure maintenance resources effectively support field operations.

Core Accountabilities

Fleet Services Strategy & Leadership

  • Develop and execute the Fleet Services strategy for the Utilities segment.
  • Establish maintenance standards, operating practices, performance expectations, and priorities across Utilities operations.
  • Align staffing, facilities, tooling, service vehicles, and vendor resources with operational demand.
  • Drive consistency, accountability, and continuous improvement across geographically dispersed operations.

Maintenance, Reliability & Asset Availability

  • Improve equipment availability and reliability while reducing controllable downtime and repair-cycle time.
  • Establish standards for preventive maintenance, repair planning, work-order management, documentation, and equipment status.
  • Identify recurring failures and ensure corrective actions are implemented.
  • Establish escalation protocols for critical equipment outages and prolonged repairs.
  • Partner with Fleet asset management on significant repair-versus-replace and lifecycle decisions.

Performance, Systems & Cost Management

  • Establish and monitor key metrics including PM compliance, availability, downtime, repair-cycle time, work-order aging, and maintenance cost.
  • Ensure accurate and timely maintenance, labor, parts, meter, and repair-history data.
  • Use operational and financial data to identify performance gaps, cost reduction opportunities, and reliability improvements.
  • Manage Fleet Services with an emphasis on total cost of ownership.
  • Support operating and capital planning for facilities, service vehicles, tooling, technology, and equipment.

People, Vendors & Service Capability

  • Develop Fleet Services leaders, technical capabilities, and succession plans.
  • Evaluate staffing and organizational needs based on fleet size, complexity, geography, and workload.
  • Establish performance expectations for repair vendors, dealerships, manufacturers, and service providers.
  • Optimize internal versus outsourced repair capabilities and maximize warranty recovery.
  • Partner with Procurement and Parts to improve availability, pricing, and supplier performance.

Safety & Operational Partnership

  • Ensure Fleet Services activities support company safety requirements and applicable regulations.
  • Establish appropriate controls for safety-critical equipment conditions and partner with HSE on equipment-related risks.
  • Serve as the senior Fleet Services partner to Utilities business-unit and field leadership.
  • Provide visibility into major repairs, equipment downtime, maintenance backlogs, and expected return-to-service dates.
  • Ensure Fleet Services resources adapt effectively to changing project and operational requirements.

Experience & Qualifications

  • Experience supporting utility construction, infrastructure, energy, or other equipment-intensive field operations.
  • 5+ years of leadership experience with responsibility for multi-location or geographically dispersed maintenance/service operations.
  • Demonstrated experience leading managers and developing technical and operational teams.
  • Experience managing maintenance budgets, repair costs, vendors, staffing, and operational KPIs.
  • Working knowledge of preventive maintenance, work-order management, equipment reliability, repair-versus-replace analysis, and lifecycle cost management.
  • Experience using fleet-management, maintenance-management, or enterprise asset-management systems and operational data to manage performance.
  • Ability to travel regularly to Utilities operating locations, shops, and project sites.
  • Prefer relevant credentials such as NAFA Certified Automotive Fleet Manager (CAFM), AEMP Certified Equipment Manager (CEM), ASE credentials, or comparable fleet/equipment certifications.

Company Overview:

Primoris Services Corporation is a premier specialty contractor providing critical infrastructure services to the utility, energy, and renewables markets throughout the United States and Canada. Built on a foundation of trust, we deliver a range of engineering, construction, and maintenance services that power, connect, and enhance society. On projects spanning utility-scale solar, renewables, power delivery, communications, and transportation infrastructure, we offer unmatched value to our clients, a safe and entrepreneurial culture to our employees, and innovation and excellence to our communities. To learn more, visit www.prim.com and follow us on social media at @PrimorisServicesCorporation.

description:

This is your opportunity to join Capital One’s fast-growing consumer app: Capital One Shopping. Within Capital One, the Shopping team is working on a new consumer product that seeks to change the way people buy things online. Our mission is to deliver a best-in-class shopping and savings experience for our millions of customers while driving incremental and sustainable sales for our merchant partners.


To be successful in the role, you will need to be a well-rounded 'business athlete’ - a creative, analytical, and technically proficient problem solver who understands both the dynamics of the business and the tech landscape. The ideal candidate is resourceful, motivated, and self-sufficient, with demonstrated success in spearheading cross-functional projects that drive the growth and success of a business.

  • Product: Perform modeling/analytics to assist new product and pricing strategies for various lending products

  • Strong communication skills: Impeccable written and oral communication credentials, coupled with strategic influencing skills and the ability to drive agreement through intellect, interpersonal and negotiation skills
  • Clear results orientation: display an intense focus on achieving both short and long term goals. He/she should be able to drive and execute an agenda in an uncertain and fluid environment

title: Software Engineer II
description:
Overview:

At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer’s and partner’s needs and solve their challenges.

Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve.

You’ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about—locally and globally.

Come make an impact every day at Zebra.

What We're Looking For:

Designs, develops, analyzes, and maintains software solutions for the organization’s products and systems (Aurora Imaging Library, a machine vision SDK). Performs system integration of software and hardware to ensure optimal performance and program consistency. Develops, validates, and tests software functionality and associated documentation. Work is reviewed for overall adequacy, but allows for greater independence in day-to-day responsibilities. Follows established processes and contributes to improving existing methodologies.

This is a hybrid position requiring you to work on-site at our office in Montreal, QC for a minimum of three days a week.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Designs, develops, and tests software components as part of a larger project, ensuring alignment with project objectives and timelines
  • Creates and maintains documentation detailing specific software functionality and design specifications
  • Participates in code reviews and provides constructive feedback
  • Recommends and implements solutions to complex technical challenges, ensuring compliance with quality processes and standards
  • Modifies and enhances existing software by improving functionality, scalability, and performance to meet evolving business needs
  • Evaluates Aurora Imaging Library performance on Arm systems, analyzes profiling and benchmark results, identifies bottlenecks, and implements optimizations.
  • Stays up to date with the latest technologies and software engineering methodologies (C++, C#, Python, Agentic AI tools), applying them to projects as needed
  • Proactively seeks out opportunities to enhance performance and productivity by recommending new tools or methodologies
  • Demonstrates sound judgment to determine appropriate actions for software development and testing tasks
  • Assist less experienced staff with existing practices and processes

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  • 2+ years of relevant software engineering experience with a Bachelors Degree. 0+ years of experience with an Advanced Degree
  • Equivalency: Equivalent work experience will be considered in lieu of a degree
  • Familiarity with programming languages (C++, C#, Python), operating systems, algorithms and software development frameworks (Agentic AI tools)
  • Experience optimizing software performance using techniques such as SIMD, parallel processing, or Arm Neon

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced Degree in Computer Science or Software Engineering or related field.
  • Basic understanding of software development life cycles (e.g., Agile, Scrum)
  • Experience with FPGA development workflows, including Vivado IP Integrator and high-level synthesis (HLS)
  • Experience with debugging, testing, and troubleshooting software systems

title: Asst. Manager - Quality
description:
Job Description :

About us

With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations.

Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other.

Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.

About the Function: Supply Chain & Manufacturing is where our brands are made, moved and delivered to the world.

With over half of our people working across more than 100 sites, this is a complex, large-scale operation that brings together production, logistics, engineering and supplier partnerships.

It’s fast-paced and hands-on, with teams working together to ensure quality, efficiency and sustainability at every stage. From sourcing ingredients to getting products into customers’ hands, you’ll play a role in delivering the brands people know and love.


Experience: 4-7 yrs, in Food technology/chemical engineering from FMCG & Beverage


Qualification:

BSc/MSc Food Tech, Biochemistry, Chemistry

BE/ B.Tech M.Tech- Food Tech


Key Responsibilities


A. Regional Quality Governance

  • Support implementation and governance of Quality and Food Safety standards across assigned manufacturing sites.
  • Monitor and review site Quality performance against defined regional KPIs, standards, and objectives.
  • Support periodic Quality performance reviews with Unit Quality and manufacturing leadership teams.
  • Support deployment of Regional and Corporate Quality initiatives at site level.

B. Quality Performance & Data Analytics

  • Analyse regional Quality data, consumer complaints, deviations, audit findings, process performance, and Quality KPIs.
  • Develop and maintain appropriate dashboards, reports, and management summaries for Regional Quality reviews.
  • Use data and trend analysis to identify emerging risks and prioritise improvement opportunities.
  • Track Quality improvement plans and evaluate the effectiveness and sustainability of actions.

C. Problem Solving, RCA & CAPA

  • Support and lead investigations of significant or recurring Quality issues across manufacturing sites.
  • Facilitate structured problem-solving using appropriate tools such as 5 Why, Fishbone, FMEA, DMAIC, Pareto, and CAPA.
  • Review CAPA effectiveness and challenge inadequate or ineffective actions.
  • Identify opportunities to replicate successful corrective actions across other sites.

D. Quality Systems, Food Safety & Compliance

  • Support implementation, maintenance, and improvement of Quality and Food Safety Management Systems.
  • Provide guidance to Unit Quality teams on Quality standards, procedures, regulatory requirements, and system expectations.
  • Support internal, external, certification, customer, and corporate Quality audits.
  • Monitor audit findings, action plans, closure, and effectiveness.
  • Support Management of Change, risk assessment, deviation management, and Quality incident processes.
  • Identify systemic compliance gaps and drive regional improvement actions.

E. Site Support & Quality Improvement

  • Conduct periodic Quality assessments and site visits to evaluate Quality system effectiveness and implementation.
  • Support sites in improving Quality maturity and capability.

F. Consumer & Market Quality

  • Support investigation and resolution of significant market and consumer Quality complaints.
  • Analyse market/retail Quality data to identify trends, recurring issues, and potential systemic risks.
  • Ensure effective corrective and preventive actions are implemented for market Quality issues.

Working with us
Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you, so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.

We recognise and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package including:

Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.

We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.

Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.

Ready to bring your best? This could be your opportunity.

title: SCADA / Relay Settings Engineer - Power Solutions
description:
Job Overview:

Primoris Power Solutions is seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented SCADA / Relay Settings Engineer to support the design, configuration, testing, and commissioning of electrical protection and control systems for utility, industrial, renewable energy, and substation projects. The ideal candidate will possess expertise in protective relay settings, SCADA integration, automation systems, and power system analysis while ensuring compliance with utility, NERC, IEEE, and customer standards.

This position plays a critical role in supporting the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of electrical transmission, distribution, generation, and renewable energy facilities. The SCADA / Relay Settings Engineer will collaborate with engineering, construction, operations, and commissioning teams throughout the project lifecycle from design through energization.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Protective Relay Engineering

  • Develop, review, and implement protection and control relay settings for transmission, distribution, generation, and substation facilities.
  • Perform protection system coordination studies and short-circuit analyses.
  • Create relay settings files for SEL, GE, ABB/Hitachi, Siemens, Beckwith, Schweitzer, and other microprocessor-based relays.
  • Analyze one-line diagrams, schematics, and protection philosophies to establish protection requirements.
  • Conduct relay setting calculations and peer reviews to ensure accuracy and compliance with applicable standards.
  • Support relay acceptance testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, and post-event analysis.
  • Investigate relay operations and provide root-cause analysis for protection system events.

SCADA & Automation Systems

  • Configure, integrate, and test SCADA systems for substations, renewable energy facilities, battery energy storage systems (BESS), and industrial power projects.
  • Develop and validate point lists, communication mappings, and data acquisition requirements.
  • Configure RTUs, PLCs, HMIs, gateways, and communication processors.
  • Support communication protocols including: DNP3IEC 61850ModbusICCP/TASE.2Ethernet/IPOPC
  • Develop and execute SCADA factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT).
  • Troubleshoot communication networks and field device integration issues.

Project Support

  • Support engineering design reviews and constructability evaluations.
  • Work closely with project managers, field engineers, commissioning teams, and client stakeholders.
  • Develop technical documentation, testing procedures, commissioning plans, and turnover packages.
  • Participate in project scheduling, issue resolution, and risk mitigation activities.
  • Provide technical recommendations for system upgrades, modernization efforts, and cybersecurity improvements.
  • Support emergency response and outage activities as required.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering from an accredited institution.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in power systems engineering, relay protection, SCADA engineering, or substation automation.
  • Experience developing protection settings for utility transmission and distribution systems.
  • Working knowledge of power system protection principles, including: Line protectionTransformer protectionBus protectionFeeder protectionGenerator protectionDifferential protection
  • Experience with SCADA and substation automation architectures.
  • Strong understanding of electrical drawings, relay schematics, and control diagrams.
  • Ability to interpret utility standards and protection philosophies.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
  • Valid driver's license and ability to travel approximately 20-40% as project needs require.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional Engineer (PE) license or ability to obtain.
  • Experience with renewable energy facilities, battery storage systems, or utility-scale solar projects.
  • Experience with Schweitzer Engineering Laboratories (SEL) products and software.
  • Familiarity with: AcSELerator QuickSetASPEN OneLinerETAPSKM PowerToolsCAPESEL RTACWinIGSGE EnerVista
  • Knowledge of NERC CIP, NERC PRC, IEEE, and applicable utility standards.
  • Experience performing commissioning on energized utility systems.
  • IEC 61850 configuration experience including GOOSE messaging and MMS communications.

Company Overview:

Primoris Power Solutions simplifies complex power projects by assembling the perfect team and plan for your specific needs. Whether you need stand-alone engineering, construction services, or a fully integrated solution, we've got you covered. We offer a full suite of project delivery methods, including Design-Build (DB) and Engineer-Procure-Construct (EPC).

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation paid weekly.

  • Best-in-class; Medical, Dental, Vision, and LTD/STD.

  • 401(k) with company match, vested day-one.

  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan [ESPP].

  • Tuition Reimbursement.

  • Paid Time Off, Holiday Pay, and Community Service Paid Time Off.

  • Pet Coverage "For our Furry Friends"

  • Legal Assistance Coverage

  • Award winning safety programs.

  • Overtime opportunities.

  • Growth Opportunities.

  • And more.

title: Helathcare Facility Administrator
description:
PURPOSE AND SCOPE: The Facility Administrator is responsible for the leadership of the clinical facility ensuring all clinical, operational, and business objectives are met. The Facility Administrator is authorized to make daily decisions to ensure patient and staff safety, the execution of some tasks may be delegated to the nursing leader where appropriate. Develops a culture of trust, empowerment, and collaboration among all center staff. The Facility Administrator shall ensure that the Center complies with the requirements of any governmental or regulatory body having jurisdiction in the premises. Assists the Medical Staff to ensure that medical practices and procedures meets applicable standards. Ensures provision of quality patient care and the role is responsible to the ASC Governing Body for clinical reporting and for operational oversight.


PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:


Environment of Care & Quality

· Manage site employees, environment, clinical processes and procedures, and workflow to deliver high quality of patient care

· Ensure compliance of state requirements and licensure updates including understanding of CLIA requirements, pharmacy requirements, and DEA anesthesia regulations

· Implement and maintain all aspects of Environment of Care requirements for patient safety and NFPA 101: Life Safety Code

· Plan personnel, equipment, and medications needed for medical emergencies; incorporate into Emergency Preparedness Plan; ensure maintenance of equipment

· Ensure proper medical records management and HIPAA compliance

· Oversees the continuous and data driven Quality Assurance and Performance Improvement Program of the center, including collection and analyzing of data per policy

· Through the use of internal tools (SoCA, FA Checklist, etc.) and feedback delivered in external inspections, develop facility-specific action plans to achieve ASC quality standards.

· Responsible for managing general liability and risk exposures to patients and employees by conducting risk assessments according standards, regulations and policies, and then developing and implementing an associated center specific management plan.

· Ensure adverse events are reported, documented and necessary follow up is provided in compliance with policy and state requirements

· Ensure effective communication with patients, dialysis clinics, hospitals and physician(s), to address any concerns/ issues

Facility Operations

· Participate in Governing Body Meetings; included but not limited to coordination of meetings in compliance with Governing Body Bylaws, documentation preparation and maintaining meeting minutes.

· Provide support to the Medical Executive Committee as requested by the Medical Director and in accordance with the Medical Staff Bylaws.

· Maintain compliance with ASC regulations including CMS conditions for coverage, state regulations, and accrediting agency standards where applicable.

· Participate in review business and finances of the site, including financial reports, market trends, and staffing models to ensure efficiencies, manage inventory and expenses, and optimize workflow

· Engage w/ sales partner to develop strategies to find new markets and develop new business opportunities

· Oversee front desk staff to ensure all processes, procedures, and expectations being adhered to, including but not limited to, appropriate scheduling, patient follow-up, and data integrity

· Ensures all staff meet organization's customer service standards

· Collaborate with ancillary departments within center to ensure alignment in meeting center-specific and company-wide goals

· Collaborate with Sales Partner to identify and visit local dialysis clinics as needed to provide information/education on available vascular access services for ESRD patients

· Create and continually enhance internal physician partnerships to optimize patient care and business outcomes

· Act as a liaison between the local dialysis clinics, the Access Center, and physician practices to meet patient needs.

· Facilitate the application process for physician privileges and compliance with Medical Staff By-Laws, including assisting with the credentialing process

· Coordinate inventory/supply management and vendor services to ensure cost containment, timely distribution and competitive pricing, as well as maintain the security and integrity of facility

· Responsible for efficient utilization of medication, laboratory, inventory, supplies and equipment to achieve supply cost goals as set forth in the annual budget

· Support billing, billing issues and collection activities

· Ensure facility is adequately staffed to meet patient needs and the safety and quality of the employees and patients.

· May assist w/ patient care on an as needed basis and in accordance w/ professional licensure (if applicable)

People Management & Leadership

· Lead, coach, and develop employees to optimize performance; partnering with Human Resources on employee matters

· Create a highly engaged and motivated culture, resulting in increased retention and employee morale

· Identify and address performance gaps as appropriate in accordance with company policy

· Drive employee performance review and employee engagement/recognition activities for center

· Participate in the recruitment, interview, and decision-making process to hire new highly-skilled staff

· Ensure appropriate training and oversight of all staff, including front desk employees

· Ensure completion of all employee training, including new hire orientation, compliance training, and mandatory in-service training

· Ensure all required and appropriate documentation is completed, including current licensure

· Other duties as assigned

PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORKING CONDITIONS:

· The physical demands and work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

· Daily work includes desk and personal computer work and interaction with patients, facility staff and physicians. The position may require travel between assigned facilities and various locations within the community. Minimal travel to regional, Division and Corporate meetings may be required as well.

· The position may provide direct patient care that regularly involves heavy lifting and moving of patients of up to 200 lbs and assisting with ambulation. Coworkers may provide assistance. The position may require frequent prolonged periods of standing and the employee must be able to bend over. There is a two-person assist program and “material assist” devices for the heavier items.

At the same time, this role puts you on the first line of defence against risks. As such, you will help implement and manage risk management programs, disaster recovery and business continuity plans. Passion for service

JLL’s unmatched excellence is only made possible by team work—a core value we want you to possess. At JLL, we make sure that you become the best version of yourself by helping you realize your full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment. We will empower your ambitions through our dedicated Total Rewards Program, competitive pay and benefits package.

description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 91,000 professionals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers, and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. About JLL’s Government, Education, and Non-Profit Division:

JLL Public Institutions’ Government, Education, and Non-Profit division is a focused consulting practice and national leader in advisory to federal, state, and local governments and universities and colleges throughout the U.S. Our professionals consult at the nexus of transformative development, the future of real estate, social infrastructure, energy, and sustainability, cutting edge research and innovation for a broad range of real estate assets and uses. We work as part of a dynamic team, with JLL professionals from across the firm, to benefit our clients’ diverse and purpose-driven real estate needs.

Senior Analyst Position:


We are currently seeking a Senior Analyst to join our advisory practice. This role will be responsible for supporting existing consulting engagements – real estate development, acquisitions, dispositions, portfolio optimization, public-private partnerships – and the growth of our business. A key function of this position will be to apply analytical techniques to creatively solve a broad range of real estate-related challenges. Advanced Microsoft Excel modeling skills are required, including the ability to fully understand existing real estate development, financing, and operating models and to develop novel approaches and refinements to existing models.

Responsibilities include:

  • Analyze complex real estate development projects, asset portfolios, property operations, and comparable transactions using financial modeling to determine highest and best use and market values, and to advise on strategic initiatives
  • Conduct economic, demographic, and market research using JLL and third-party data sources to support due diligence and feasibility analyses
  • Demonstrate critical thinking and support conclusions and recommendations with clear analysis and evidence
  • Leverage JLL-approved AI tools to work more efficiently and enhance analysis, with responsibility for reviewing, validating, and stress-testing outputs before use
  • Develop report outlines and contribute written and graphic content for client deliverables
  • Effectively communicate results of analysis to internal team members and clients through written documents and presentations
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with internal JLL teams and clients
  • Support business development through contributing to client proposals, pitches, and relationships

Preferred qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a business-related field (e.g., real estate, finance, accounting, economics)
  • 2-4 years of analytical and financial modeling experience – recent graduates with strong internship or real estate experience welcome
  • Familiarity with industry concepts, practices, and procedures associated with real estate development, finance, and operations, such as net operating income, loan-to-value, debt service coverage, and capitalization rates
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and proficiency in Microsoft Office applications
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present analytical findings clearly and professionally
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments concurrently with strong attention to detail and organization
  • Demonstrated initiative, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within both large and small teams
  • Willingness to travel as needed

title: Technology Operations Associate
description:
Veryon provides software to business and commercial aviation operators, helping them manage maintenance, tracking, and compliance. Our Technology organization spans Engineering, Data Intelligence, DevOps, Technical Program Management, IT & Security, and Customer Support, with teams across North America, Europe, and Asia.


The Technology Operations Associate serves as the operational backbone of the Technology leadership team. This role helps keep technology releases on track, supports financial discipline across technology spend, and ensures leaders and teams have clear and timely communications and reporting.


This is an excellent opportunity for an early career professional to gain direct exposure to the CTO and senior Technology leaders while developing hands on experience across technology operations, project management, financial processes, release management, and executive communications.


Technology Operations & Executive Support

• Act as a trusted extension of the Technology leadership team, anticipating needs and following through on priorities
• Support Technology leaders with recurring operational activities, reporting, communications, and coordination
• Connect teams across North America, Europe, and Asia to maintain alignment on priorities, timelines, and expectations
• Follow up with stakeholders at all levels to ensure commitments are completed and issues are surfaced early
• Handle confidential financial and business information with appropriate discretion


Operations Review & Reporting

• Own Technology content for the monthly company Operations Review
• Pull relevant metrics and information from internal systems
• Gather highlights, lowlights, priorities, and updates from Technology managers
• Consolidate information into clear and accurate executive level reporting
• Maintain visibility into progress, risks, priorities, and upcoming initiatives


Technology All Hands

• Coordinate and run the monthly Technology All Hands
• Maintain distribution lists and coordinate scheduling with senior leaders
• Manage the meeting agenda and collect team content within established deadlines
• Coordinate leadership presentations and team updates
• Lead an engaging icebreaker or team activity to strengthen connection across the distributed Technology organization


Financial Operations

• Review vendor and consultant invoices against approved budgets and route them to authorized approvers
• Record budget variances and prepare information for each quarterly forecast cycle
• Code corporate card transactions twice each month according to Finance requirements
• Attach required receipts and documentation to corporate card transactions
• Track and document budget discrepancies for Technology leadership review
• Support Technology leaders with purchasing, procurement, expense management, and related financial activities


Release Management

• Follow established release checklists to confirm required actions are completed before go live
• Verify required documentation and approvals are attached to the appropriate tickets
• Follow up with QA and UAT stakeholders to secure required sign offs
• Monitor release readiness and identify missing actions or approvals
• Escalate potential release delays early to the appropriate Technology leaders


Project Management

• Track status, milestones, dependencies, and risks for key Technology projects
• Maintain accurate project tracking information and follow up with project stakeholders
• Prepare monthly updates highlighting what is on track, what is at risk, and what is coming next
• Support Technology leaders and managers with project coordination and follow through
• Help maintain shared visibility across Technology initiatives and priorities


Logistics & Coordination

• Support Technology leadership with meeting coordination, calendar management, and scheduling
• Assist with team events and activities across a globally distributed organization
• Support purchasing and procurement activities
• Coordinate logistics for meetings, events, and other Technology initiatives

title: VP, Strategy
description:
Job Description :

About us

With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker, Guinness and Don Julio, to local favourites like Crown Royal and Bulleit, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations.


Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other.


Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.

About this role

Lead the development and execution of Diageo North America's commercial strategy, with particular accountability for Route-to-Market, distributor strategy, customer and channel strategy, and commercial transformation. Serve as the strategic partner to US Sales leadership to accelerate growth, improve commercial effectiveness, and strengthen execution across customers, distributors, channels, and markets.


The role is accountable for identifying and driving the strategic choices, operating models, and transformational initiatives that shape commercial performance. This includes shaping channel and customer strategies, optimizing distributor partnerships and economics, and evaluating growth opportunities that improve market performance and strengthen competitive advantage.


As a senior leader, the role will lead Diageo's highest-priority commercial transformation initiatives, influence Executive leadership decisions, and build strategic capability across the commercial organization.


Key Accountabilities:

  • Lead the development and evolution of Diageo's Route-to-Market strategy, identifying strategic opportunities to accelerate growth across channels, customers, distributors, and markets.
  • Serve as the strategic advisor to the President US Sales and senior commercial leadership team, helping define priorities, assess market opportunities, and make critical commercial investment decisions.
  • Own the strategic and economic assessment of major commercial choices, including Route-to-Market models, distributor partnerships, channel and customer economics, resource allocation, and commercial investments, ensuring decisions maximize sustainable growth and value creation.
  • Shape Diageo's long-term distributor strategy and partnerships, including assessment of distributor capabilities, economics, incentives, operating models, and potential structural changes to Route-to-Market.
  • Lead end-to-end commercial transformation initiatives - from diagnostic and strategy through business case, leadership alignment, implementation design, and tracking of value delivery - to improve commercial effectiveness, sales productivity, distributor performance, resource allocation, and execution quality.
  • Lead strategic assessment of evolving consumer, competitive, regulatory, and customer trends impacting the beverage alcohol landscape.
  • Support annual and long-range planning processes by identifying key strategic growth drivers and risks.
  • Lead market assessments, strategic partnerships, and other special projects impacting commercial growth.
  • Develop Executive Committee, Board, and North America leadership presentations that communicate strategic recommendations clearly and influence key business decisions.

Experience/skills required:

  • 12+ years' professional experience, including 8-10 years’ experience across strategy consulting, corporate strategy, and experience within the consumer goods industry
  • Demonstrated track record leading enterprise-wide or commercial transformation programmes, partnering with Executive and Senior Leadership teams to shape long-term business strategy and deliver measurable commercial impact
  • Deep strategic, commercial and financial expertise, with a proven ability to connect enterprise strategy, commercial strategy, customer and consumer insights, competitive dynamics and market economics into clear strategic choices
  • Exceptional communication, stakeholder management and executive influencing skills, with extensive experience preparing and presenting recommendations to Executive and Board-level audiences
  • Proven people leadership experience, with a track record of developing high-performing teams, strengthening organisational capability and leading through influence in complex global organisations

Working with Us

Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.

We recognise and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package including:

Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.

We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.

Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.

Ready to bring your best? This could be your opportunity.

If you require a reasonable adjustment, please ensure that you capture this information when you submit your application.


Recruitment Scam Warning

Protecting candidates is very important to us. All communications regarding your application will come from an email address ending in @diageo.com. In our recruitment process, we'll never ask for money.

description:

Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?

Únete a nuestra misión de liderar el futuro de Snacking. Hazlo con orgullo.

Apoyar a los equipos de category planning convirtiendo los planes de categorías para su ejecución por parte del equipo de ventas

Cómo contribuirás

  • Apoyar a la formulación de los planes de los clientes y su posterior seguimiento
  • Coordinar y gestionar el establecimiento comercial de la activación de ventas
  • Proporcionar experiencia en la gestión con el cliente, canal y comercio, y ofrecer recomendaciones para el lanzamiento de nuevos productos
  • Validar los fees de las plataformas de lanzamiento, hacer un seguimiento del rendimiento y completar la reconciliation cuando sea necesario
  • Preparar soluciones para el cliente (por ejemplo, activaciones o eventos personalizados) en cooperación con el equipo de activación del cliente
  • Evaluar la ejecución de las actividades vs los plan-drivers y la implementación de los aprendizaje derivados en las siguientes activaciones

Qué aportarás

El deseo de impulsar tu futuro y acelerar tu carrera junto con los siguientes conocimientos y experiencia:

  • Capacidades organizativas y de priorización
  • Capacidad de resolución de problemas
  • Búsqueda de soluciones nuevas e innovadoras
  • Trabajo en equipo
  • Tener una mente abierta y ser promotor de resultados
  • Se valorará el conocimiento del consumidor y la categoría

More about this role

We are looking for an eCommerce Analyst to join our commercial team in Ecuador. This person will be responsible for driving the digital strategy of "Tienda Mondelēz" as an enabling channel within the traditional trade (TT), ensuring efficient operations and an integrated omnichannel experience aligned with the sales and trade marketing teams.

What you need to know about this position

  • Tienda Mondelēz Strategy: Develop and execute the digital store strategy as an enabling channel in TT, with daily monitoring of key management indicators (sell out, coverage, and investment).
  • Omnichannel Articulation: Maintain constant communication with sales and trade marketing teams to ensure the digital strategy is aligned and executed in an omnichannel manner.
  • Web Platform Management: Own the information, configuration, and maintenance of the web platform. Act as the first line of support for customer and sales force inquiries, and manage daily operations in partnership with the agency team.
  • Continuous Improvement: Lead the regional administration of the continuous improvement process for digital platforms.
  • Administrative Management: Manage budgets and purchase orders related to the e-commerce operation.

What extra ingredients you will bring

  • Analytical mindset with a data-driven approach to decision-making.
  • Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Proactivity and problem-solving ability in dynamic digital environments.
  • Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and align commercial and digital strategies.
  • Passion for digital commerce and continuous improvement.

Education / Certifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Industrial Engineering, Economics, or related fields.
  • Advanced Excel proficiency. Power BI knowledge is a plus.

Job specific requirements

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in eCommerce, digital commerce, or commercial analysis roles.
  • Experience managing digital platforms and commercial KPIs (sell out, coverage, investment).
  • Knowledge of the traditional trade (TT) channel and omnichannel strategies.
  • Experience coordinating with agencies and cross-functional teams.
  • Fluent Spanish. English is a plus.

title: Calibration Technician III
description:
Join the Pharmaceutical Calibrations and Instrumentation (PCI) team! We are seeking a Calibration Technician III that can perform calibrations onsite at our client pharmaceutical facilities in South San Francisco, CA and other sites as needed. If you prefer working at a fast pace, "on the go" instead of at a desk, have a passion for performing quality work, and have a strong electronics or instrumentation background, this position may be just for you! Up to 50% travel is required based on project and client needs. At this time the role is minimal travel outside of the San Francisco area but could change in the future.


This position will focus on performing preventive maintenance, qualifications, relocations and calibrations on a variety of instruments such as electronics, temperature devices, pressure gauges, centrifuges, incubators, balances, and others as found in pharmaceutical manufacturing and laboratory environments. The Calibration Technician III reports directly to the Team Leader, Manager, or Director depending on the organizational structure. Typical Hiring Range is $42-$47 per hour.


Expectations:

Calibration Technicians complete calibrations, qualifications, and PMs with accurate and timely GxP documentation, following PCI and/or client specific policies and procedures. They are expected to take a proactive role in supporting the Team and in providing client support and are expected to build a high level of trust with internal and client personnel. This trust is developed through consistently upholding PCI Values and demonstrating Honesty, Integrity, Pride, Accountability, Teamwork, and Commitment.


In addition to the above expectations, the Tech III is expected to have a broader knowledge base of instrumentation and regulatory compliance. They will continue to train on new instrumentation areas and build an understanding of pharmaceutical and FDA requirements. Increased client interaction will occur and the Tech II will develop a deeper understanding of PCI’s services and how clients can expand the use of these services.


In addition to the above expectations, the Tech III is expected to identify and execute tasks that enhance the ability of PCI to provide an ‘added value’ service for clients and provide guidance and direction on technical issues. Tech III’s have a higher level of technical experience and expertise to troubleshoot issues, as well as assist in providing innovative, creative, effective, and long-term solutions. Typical Hiring Range is $42-$47 per hour.


Responsibilities/Assignments:

Calibration Technician I

  • Under supervision, completes calibrations and qualifications in a safe, timely, and accurate manner, following PCI and client specific policies and proposals.
  • Able to perform, with guidance, basic pressure, temperature, humidity, time and CO2 calibrations.
  • Is adept at handling PCI and client owned equipment and test equipment with care.
  • Identifies project supply and equipment needs and conveys to the appropriate resource to ensure availability.
  • Works to understand client needs and requirements through effective communication and develops client relationships through excellent customer service. Ensures client requests are conveyed to the appropriate PCI management resource and met in accordance with management direction.
  • On average, 90 - 95% of work time will be utilized completing scheduled calibration and maintenance events.
  • Timesheets and expense reports are completed weekly with accurate labor and expense codes.
  • Maintains a neat and professional PCI work area and projects a professional image at all times.
  • Always considers safety when executing tasks and projects. Ensures that PCI work areas are safe, neatly organized and professional on-site and in an office environment.

Calibration Technician II (in addition to those listed above)

  • With minor supervision, completes calibrations, qualifications, and PMs with accurate and timely GxP documentation, following PCI or client specific policies and procedures, and in a safe manner.
  • With guidance, able to perform flow, conductivity, pH, mass and dimensional calibrations.
  • Is attune to potential new opportunities for PCI when at a client site or interacting with a client and relays this lead back to Leader/Manager.
  • Completes timesheets with correct labor code charges (weekly) and assists other PCI Associates in proper coding of time and expenses.
  • Responsible for proper handling and maintenance of PCI and client equipment, including testing and standards equipment.
  • Learning to troubleshooting and perform repairs, but the majority of work will continue to be scheduled calibrations and maintenance events
  • Able to identify and report any safety issues at the work site, including educating peers on safety practices.

Calibration Technician III (in addition to those listed above)

  • Without direct supervision, completes calibrations, qualifications, and PMs with accurate and timely GxP documentation, following PCI or client specific policies and procedures, and in a safe manner.
  • Provides effective solutions to client needs and requirements, effectively communicates with clients, and develops client relationships through excellent customer service.
  • Able to manager small projects and supervise technicians on those projects.
  • Identifies potential value-added business opportunities at client sites and shares with appropriate PCI Team Manager.
  • Develops basic quotes or proposals; assists with development of complex proposals.
  • Professional, diplomatic, and tactful with potentially sensitive issues; has a good understanding of the business case. Comfortable dealing with all levels of management and clients, respected by peers and clients.
  • Handles PCI and client owned equipment and test equipment with care and trains other Associates on proper use and handling.
  • Ensures safe work practices are followed by other PCI Associates.
  • Plans and makes sure project supplies and equipment are ready and available. Works with appropriate company resources in advance to ensure all project needs are met.
  • May assist in PCI onboarding process and serves as a role model and mentor to other technicians through professional actions/ethics and technical skills.
  • Is familiar with all PCI service offerings and is comfortable exploring potential leads while at client sites.

Skills Required:

Calibration Technician I

  • Basic understanding of Traceability, Substitution of Standards, and Test Accuracy
  • Skilled with pneumatic, mechanical, and electrical instrumentation; as well as manual and computer-based process control loops and systems; understands and applies basic concepts of calibration and requirements including accuracy testing.
  • Ability to climb stairs; climb on equipment such as tanks. Moderate to heavy lifting.
  • Understanding and awareness of safety requirements and safe practices.
  • General electrical panel knowledge and electrical safety procedures.
  • Working knowledge of MS Office suite.
  • Must have a valid driver’s license and good driving record.
  • Reliable, confident, eager to learn, and enjoy working with people.
  • Listens well and asks questions to learn more.
  • Displays good organizational skills.

Calibration Technician II (in addition to those listed above)

  • Expanded understanding of Traceability, Substitution of Standards, and Test Accuracy and Uncertainty Ratios.
  • Expanded understanding of calibration concepts and requirements including accuracy testing requirements.
  • Able to make independent decisions within defined scope of work, seeks clarification and directions when needed. Must be self-driven and demonstrate ability to work with little direction.
  • Basic understanding and application of GMP’s and Life Science Industry regulations.
  • Basic understanding and application of instrument, equipment, and loop calibrations of various parameters in manufacturing, utilities, and laboratory environments.
  • Basic understanding of calibration concepts and requirements including accuracy testing requirements.

Calibration Technician III (in addition to those listed above)

  • Thorough understanding of calibration concepts and requirements including accuracy testing requirements.
  • Thorough understanding and application of GMPs and Life Science industry regulations.
  • Thorough understanding and application of instrument, equipment, and loop calibrations of various parameters in manufacturing, utilities, and laboratory environments.
  • Effective communication and problem solving skills with clients and coworkers.



Experience & Education Required for the Calibration Technician III:

A two-year degree in Life Sciences, Engineering, Electronics, other related technical field or equivalent military training and four years of applicable (Metrology, Instrumentation, Calibration) experience or the equivalent combination of education and experience. Quality System/Pharmaceutical experience is preferred.


PCI is proud to serve pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, and clinical research industries nationwide by providing calibration, commissioning and consulting solutions. At PCI, calibrations are performed by highly technical, cGMP/GLP-trained personnel who are knowledgeable in quality guidelines enforced by the FDA, EPA and ISO/IEC 17025:2017. PCI is an FCX Performance Company and a Subsidiary of Applied Industrial Technologies (NYSE: AIT); a leading industrial distributor that offers more than 6.5 million parts to serve the needs of MRO and OEM customers in virtually every industry.

Applied® provides engineering, design and systems integration for industrial and fluid power applications, as well as customized mechanical, fabricated rubber and fluid power shop services. As a General Assembly Technical Leader (Flawless Launch), you will lead the design and standardization of cutting-edge Bill of Equipment (BoE) that transforms how we build vehicles. · Lead Bill of Equipment (BoE): Direct the design, development and continuous improvement of Bill of Equipment (BoE) in General Assembly. Develop strategies to standardize equipment to meet future product requirements. About the Function:

Supply Chain & Manufacturing is where our brands are made, moved and delivered to the world. With over half of our people working across more than 100 sites, this is a complex, large-scale operation that brings together production, logistics, engineering and supplier partnerships. It’s fast-paced and hands-on, with teams working together to ensure quality, efficiency and sustainability at every stage. From sourcing ingredients to getting products into customers’ hands, you’ll play a role in delivering the brands people know and love.

About the role:

  • The Senior Executive – Bi-Products Process (DDGS & CO2 Operations) will be responsible for end-to-end management of the Distillers Dried Grain Solids (DDGS) manufacturing process within the Grain Distillery, ensuring safe, efficient, and compliant operations.
  • The role will oversee production planning, process execution, drying operations, product handling, storage, and dispatch readiness while ensuring achievement of production targets and optimal utilization of plant resources.
  • The incumbent will work closely with Manufacturing, Quality, Maintenance, Supply Chain, and EHS teams to ensure uninterrupted operations, process optimization, and adherence to product quality standards.
  • The role will drive operational excellence across the DDGS process by monitoring critical operating parameters, ensuring compliance with approved SOPs, maintaining product consistency, and implementing continuous improvement initiatives to enhance productivity, yield, and cost efficiency.
  • The individual will be responsible for managing manpower deployment, coordinating maintenance activities, ensuring high standards of safety and housekeeping, minimizing process losses, and optimizing consumption of utilities and consumables.
  • Key performance measures will include DDGS production plan achievement, product quality compliance, plant availability and reliability, yield improvement, utility consumption, safety performance, inventory management, process loss reduction, and audit compliance.

Qualifications & Experience:

  • The ideal candidate should possess a B.E./B.Tech in Chemical Engineering, Food Technology, Biotechnology, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline, with 2–5 years of experience in distillery, ethanol, alcohol, grain processing, feed manufacturing, or similar process industries.
  • Candidates should have hands-on exposure to DDGS operations, drying systems, process control, production planning, quality management, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, team management, and stakeholder management skills, coupled with a strong focus on safety, quality, and operational excellence, are essential for success in this role.

description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

What this job involves

As a Lead of Preconstruction, you turn a project brief into a proposal the business can sign and a package the Build team can run. You lead estimating, bid packaging, and constructability from pursuit through award, ensuring every project is priced, scoped, and fundable before it moves to construction. This role also will manage one or two preconstruction managers and have a strong MEP cost estimating/engineering background


What your day-to-day will look like

  • Develop estimates, bid templates, and detailed take-offs using estimating and takeoff technology (e.g., COSTX or equivalent).
  • Lead vendor strategy with the Project Manager: share documents, schedule walks, issue RFIs and clarifications, and collect and level bids.
  • Assemble the full proposal package: detailed scope, procurement plan, exclusions/qualifiers/assumptions, safety and logistics plans, critical-path
  • schedule, lump-sum vs. GMP recommendation, resource plan, design and permit strategy, commissioning plan, equipment/move lists, and finishes plan.
  • Support Target Value Design and translate construction documents into a formal bid package, scopes of work, and bid-form structure.
  • Feed Go/No-Go and compliance review with commercial backup and client-ready deliverables.
  • Hand off the baseline to the Construction Manager at Move-to-Construction: scopes, vendor coverage, long-lead list, exclusions, and schedule assumptions.
  • Remain available after handoff to resolve re-buy or missed-scope questions.

Required qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, or related field.
  • 7+ years of experience in commercial preconstruction, estimating, or bid packaging on lump-sum and GMP work.
  • Hands-on estimating experience and the discipline to maintain basis-of-estimate files that survive a handoff.
  • Proven vendor coverage practices: walks, RFIs, apples-to-apples scopes, no single-source surprises on bid day.
  • Ability to write exclusions, assumptions, and a procurement plan that holds up in compliance review.
  • Experience building a critical-path bid schedule and work-package structure a Construction Manager can inherit.
  • Strong leadership, organizational, and communication skills.

Preferred qualifications

  • PMP or equivalent project management certification.
  • Direct experience with estimating take-off technology and construction management technology.
  • Target Value Design experience with an architectured cost model.
  • Comfort with mission-critical, workplace, or landlord-controlled interiors, infrastructure and sitework projects.

The Hospitality Associate at Opensity Solutions is responsible for delivering exceptional guest experiences while ensuring smooth day-to-day hospitality operations. Experience: Minimum of 2+ years of relevant hospitality, guest services, or customer service experience required. Experience in a fast-paced client-facing environment preferred.

Work on client complaint cases that include topics such as: account issues for personal client who own a variety of products from deposit accounts, mortgage loans, auto and other loans, and credit cards; and client complaints that Truist receives from various regulatory agencies or senior leaders. 4. Document cases thoroughly and ensure that client concerns have been adequately addressed in a timely and professional manner.
5. Working to address client concerns while demonstrating Truist’s Purpose, Mission and Value systems.
6. Be an active participant in on-going training as the banking landscape changes.
7. Prioritize and organize tasks and work queues to meet deadlines; process information with a high degree of accuracy.
