title: Project Management Assistant - cFSP
description:
Why Join Clinical Functional Service Partnerships (CFSP)?

At IQVIA, our Clinical Functional Service Partnership (CFSP) models offer the best of both worlds: the opportunity to work as an integrated member of a leading sponsor's team while benefiting from the global expertise, career development and support of IQVIA. CFSP roles provide the opportunity to develop specialist expertise on a dedicated program, with the flexibility to expand across sponsors and therapeutic areas as your career progresses.

Through our long-standing partnerships with top pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies, you will contribute to the delivery of cutting-edge clinical research programs that bring innovative treatments to patients worldwide. Our professionals support studies across all phases of development and a broad range of therapeutic areas, gaining valuable experience in diverse and dynamic research environments.


Project Management Assistant

At IQVIA, as a Senior Project Management Assistant (PMA), you will play a critical role in the operational delivery of clinical trials, partnering closely with Clinical Trial Leads and global cross-functional teams to ensure studies are executed efficiently, compliantly, and inspection-ready. Acting as a senior member of the trial team, you will coordinate key study activities across systems, documentation, finance, training, and vendor oversight, driving operational excellence and consistency throughout the clinical trial lifecycle.


This is an exciting opportunity to join a leading sponsor environment where you will leverage your expertise in clinical operations, trial coordination, quality, and process improvement to support regional and global studies. Beyond study execution, you will serve as a trusted subject matter expert, mentoring colleagues, contributing to capability building across the PMA community, and helping shape best practices within one of the world's leading clinical research organizations.


Key responsibilities

• Establish and manage performance dashboards, analyze event triggers/alerts and determine appropriate follow up for Project Leader (PL) or other function(s) to act upon.

• Coordinate project schedule and ensure timely updates of all key milestone and partner with PL on related calls.

• Coordinate and support the risk and issue management process.

• Manage all aspects of the Project Finances including Estimate at Completion (EAC), monthly expenses, invoices and reconciliation.

• Demonstrate compliance with the Vendor and Purchase Order (PO) Management process.

• Implement and maintain baseline and change control processes.

• Ensure PL has timely and accurate data on areas including cost, schedule, scope, utilization, change orders and quality to support better decision-making.

• Develop and maintain relevant sections of Project Management Plans.

• Review and support project resource allocation within project budgeted for assigned portfolio/ projects.

• Prepare correspondence, including meeting minutes, for project team and/or customer.

• Organize and partner with PL in managing internal project team and customer meetings.

• Prepare project status reports and presentation materials for internal project team and customer meetings.

• Manage and coordinate core file reviews and support audits as needed. Drive e Trial Master File (eTMF) filing compliance focusing on completeness, timeliness and quality.

• Manage project specific eTraining and oversee compliance.

• Coordinate and support onboarding of new Key Project Team Members and system access.

• Monitor project metrics and make required updates in IQVIA systems to ensure accurate and timely reporting is available to senior management.

• Participate in regional initiatives to support Project Management Analyst (PMA) community and aid personal development.


What we’re looking for

• Bachelor's Degree Life sciences or other related field Req

• Minimum 2 years of prior relevant experience as a PMA.

• Communication - strong written and verbal communication skills including good command of English language.

• Problem solving - problem solving skills.

• Results-oriented approach to work delivery and output.

• Collaboration - ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with coworkers, managers and clients.

• Cross-collaboration - ability to work across geographies displaying high awareness and understanding of cultural differences.

• IQVIA Core Competencies - ability to demonstrate all IQVIA competencies (Client Focus, Collaboration, Communication, innovation, Ownership).


Build Your Future with IQVIA

If you're looking for a role that combines clinical trial delivery, project leadership, sponsor partnership and career growth, we would love to hear from you. At IQVIA, you will have the opportunity to work on innovative studies, collaborate with industry-leading sponsors, leverage cutting-edge technology and develop your career within a global organization dedicated to transforming healthcare and improving patient outcomes worldwide.

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at

All information and credentials submitted in your application must be truthful and complete. description:

Evening - 08 Hour (United States of America)

This is a Stanford Health Care job.

A Brief Overview
Under general supervision, this manager is responsible for patient registration functions and eligibility management and is the primary point person to facilitate optimal performance of the front-end registration process/revenue cycle at Stanford Health Care.

This is a people manager role and is accountable and responsible for a team of employees who provides front-end data quality for the patient registration activities across assigned Patient Access Services patient front-facing locations. The manager ensures that these essential functions (primary duties) are performed efficiently and effectively throughout the assigned areas, which includes maintaining an adequate trained staff to handle all patients in in-patient and out-patient clinic settings.

Locations
Stanford Health Care

What you will do

  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a team
  • Demonstrated project management skills
  • Demonstrated customer service and relationship management skills and knowledge
  • Demonstrated conflict management skills
  • Demonstrated ability to manage management priorities with organizational goals and priorities


Licenses and Certifications

  • None


These principles apply to ALL employees:

title: Principal Data Analyst
description:
Principal Data Analyst

Principal Data Analyst


At Capital One, data is at the center of everything we do. When we launched as a startup we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Analyst at Capital One you will leverage analytic and technical skills to innovate, build, and maintain well-managed data solutions and capabilities to tackle business problems.


About the Team


The Bank Tech Analytics team is a group dedicated to advancing data-driven decision-making and operational excellence across the enterprise, delivering comprehensive services for Bank Tech while actively contributing back to the broader organization. The team provides core capabilities spanning metrics and insights frameworks, applied analytics, operational efficiency automation, and AI integration. Through continuous stakeholder partnerships and automated data pipelines via Snowflake/Onelake and Databricks, Bank Tech Analytics transforms complex information into actionable insights and custom reporting solutions. This work enhances the developer experience, equips leaders to drive strategy, and delivers high-impact value by fostering enterprise-wide collaboration and pioneering innovative analytics transformations.

On any given day you will be challenged on three types of work – Innovation, Business Intelligence and Data Management:

Innovation

  • Use Open Source/Digital technologies to mine complex, voluminous, and different varieties of data sources and platforms
  • Build well-managed data solutions, tools, and capabilities to enable self-service frameworks for data consumers
  • Demonstrate ability to explore and quickly grasp new technologies to progress varied initiatives

Business Intelligence

  • Partner with the business to provide consultancy and translate the business needs to design and develop tools, techniques, metrics, and dashboards for insights and data visualization
  • Drive analysis that provides meaningful insights on business strategies

Data Management

  • Drive an understanding and adherence to the principles of data quality management including metadata, lineage, and business definitions
  • Work collaboratively with appropriate Tech teams to manage security mechanisms and data access governance
  • Build and execute tools to monitor and report on data quality

Our ideal candidate will have:

  • Degree specialized in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
  • Scripting experience in (Python, R, Spark, and SQL)
  • Strong desire and experience with data in various forms (data warehouses/SQL, unstructured data)

title: Clinical Documentation Integrity Lead - Service Line (Remote)
description:
If you're ready to be part of our legacy of hope and innovation, we encourage you to take the first step and explore our current job openings. Your best is waiting to be discovered.

Day - 08 Hour (United States of America)

This is a Stanford Health Care job.

A Brief Overview
The Clinical Documentation Integrity (CDI) Service Line Outcomes Lead is responsible for partnering with service line & physician leadership to optimize documentation tools, improve processes, and develop strategies to reduce administrative burden on our providers, while maintaining high quality and integrity documentation. This leader will serve as a direct partner to service line leaders with the aim to improve query turnaround, identify & facilitate targeted education opportunities, and strengthen overall buy-in and engagement.

Locations
Stanford Health Care

What you will do

  • Responsibility for management and optimization of the positive relationships between CDI and the service lines assigned, meeting regularly with SL Physician Champion and Chair/Chief.
  • Drive increased workflow efficiency through monitoring and escalating queries as appropriate.
  • Performance of CDI targeted audits and analysis of the findings, related to documentation and coding, to build physician education, identify areas of individual and service line opportunity, and facilitate short and long-term resolutions.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert and authoritative resource on interpretation and application of CDI practices, coding rules and regulations, and conducts risk assessments of potential and detected compliance deficiencies, as well as documentation opportunities within the service lines assigned.
  • Assists in monitoring and evaluating CDI and coding quality in relationship to best practices, while completing project-related reviews and providing relevant feedback to peers, coding, CDI leadership and quality partners, as necessary.
  • Coordinates data collection and analysis, in collaboration with quality teams, related to patient care activities, documentation opportunities, coding opportunities and clinical outcome performance gaps.
  • Coordinates the development of working sessions of multi-disciplinary teams in goal setting and problem solving.
  • Optimizes service line clinical documentation integrity programs, including related provider and multidisciplinary education content creation, delivery and evaluation of effectiveness.
  • Leads multidisciplinary and multi-departmental CDI projects to achieve strategic goals and objectives.
  • Partners with other CDI leads, IT and other technology partners to create and optimize documentation tools, process and strategies to reduce administrative burden on our providers, while maintaining high quality and integrity documentation.


Education Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Nursing, Medicine, Health Information Management or similarly related field of study.

  • At least two currently active:

    - COC, CPC, or CCS certification

    - Certified Data Management Professional (CDMP) certification, Certified Analytics Professional (CAP) certification, or similar

    - CRCR or other revenue cycle certification

    - Health Care Quality (HACP, CPHQ, HCQM) certification

    - Case Management Certification (CCM) or clinical certification

    - Physician Educator Certificate Program (PECP) certification, or other education certification


Experience Qualifications

  • Five (5) years of progressively responsible and directly related inpatient clinical experience. At least 5 years of CDI, or provider education related work experience. Outcomes data reporting and analysis experience.
  • ICU/ED and Academic Medical Center experience preferred.
  • Case management, utilization review and/or direct provider interaction experience, preferred.
  • Experience in public speaking, as well as educational content creation and delivery of formal multidisciplinary education, preferred.
  • Experience with Vizient, Premier, Elixhauser and other risk adjustment methodologies, highly preferred.


Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Expertise in coding and CDI practices., maintaining expertise in Medicare/Medicaid rules and regulations, as well as current trends and developments.
  • Knowledge of, but not limited to, current CMS coding guidelines and methodologies, MS-DRGs, APR-DRGs, HCCs; current version of CM/PCS and AMA CPT coding guidelines and conventions, staying abreast of CMS rules and regulations and incorporating those changes into daily practice.
  • Extensive knowledge and experience in computer systems, reporting software and electronic medical record systems used in functional area.
  • Demonstrated leadership ability, organizational savviness, and critical thinking skills.
  • Ability to develop and maintain strong, collaborative and supportive working relationships with peers, physicians and other clinical professionals.
  • Must have demonstrated interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills in dealing with multidisciplinary teams and variety of ongoing activities.
  • Knowledge of project management processes and systems with the ability to lead teams and manage high-profile projects to produce results within schedule and budget.
  • Knowledge of statistical analysis and reporting practices pertaining to quality improvement and program evaluation.
  • Ability to work independently, creatively, and innovation-focused in high-volume, fast- paced, and highly political work environments.
  • Ability to work independently in performing duties with minimal supervision with a high degree of self-motivation.
  • Expertise in developing and delivering training and education to clinical, CDI and coding professionals regarding CDI practices, coding, and documentation requirements, as well as knowledge distribution to multidisciplinary teams.


Licenses and Certifications

  • At least 1 currently active:
  • CCDS - Cert Clinical Document Spec .
  • CCDS-O or CDIP .
  • Nursing\RN - Registered Nurse - State Licensure And/Or Compact State Licensure preferred .

title: AI Platform Developer Specialist
description:
Role Description:
AI Platform Engineers are software developers who build, maintain, and evolve the FNZ’s deployment framework that underpins FNZ's AI and non-AI products.

The AI Platform Engineer will work within FNZ's Client Application Deployment Framework and internal Launchpad, ensuring AI services such as AI Foundry, LLMs, RAG platforms, MCP gateways, model serving infrastructure, storage, caching, and associated cloud services are delivered using the same engineering standards, governance, operational processes, and FinOps principles applied across FNZ's broader platform estate.

The role requires a strong Platform Engineering mindset, combining expertise in cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, IaaC, CI/CD, observability, security, and automation with knowledge of modern AI infrastructure patterns, agentic workloads, model lifecycle management, and AI governance requirements.


Specific Role Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain reusable cloud infrastructure and platform capabilities using Terraform, Azure, Kubernetes, and Infrastructure-as-Code best practices.
  • Implement and operate AI infrastructure services including Azure AI Foundry (preferred), LLM platforms, MCP gateways, RAG solutions, vector databases, storage, and caching services.
  • Build, maintain, and optimise CI/CD pipelines, automation frameworks, and deployment processes using GitHub, GitHub Actions, and modern Platform Engineering practices.
  • Enable product teams to securely deploy and consume AI and cloud services through standardised platform patterns, self-service capabilities, and golden paths.
  • Implement security, identity, access control, data governance, and compliance controls for cloud and AI workloads, including management of sensitive and regulated data.
  • Establish observability, monitoring, distributed tracing, logging, and usage instrumentation to ensure platform reliability, operational visibility, and AI workload performance.
  • Drive FinOps and cost optimisation initiatives by implementing infrastructure, cloud, and AI service usage monitoring, reporting, and governance controls.
  • Support the lifecycle management of AI services and models, including onboarding, upgrades, deprecation planning, rollout of new capabilities, and operational support.
  • Collaborate with Product, Platform Engineering, Security, AI Governance, and Operations teams to design scalable, secure, and resilient platform solutions.
  • Evaluate emerging cloud, AI, and Platform Engineering technologies, contributing to the continuous improvement of FNZ's Application Deployment Framework (ADF) and overall platform strategy.

Infrastructure (IaC) implementation

  • Implement infrastructure architecture designs to support agentic workloads, including models, LLM and MCP gateways, RAG, storage, and caching for agentic loops and inference
  • Implement data governance controls (e.g. access control and handling of PII within RAG stores)
  • Iterate as agent patterns and provider offerings evolve

Support for product development

  • Assist product teams with configuration and deployment of infrastructure aligned to their use cases
  • Ensure appropriate cost and usage instrumentation (e.g. token/API usage) for each AI product
  • Ensure access controls are in place around the product’s LLM and tool usage.
  • Assist product teams in evidencing the above when seeking approvals.


Note: development of harnesses and agents sits with other teams

Production support and lifecycle management

Provide an escalation point for AI related production support queries.

Participate in monitoring and feedback loops between AI Governance, Product, and Project teams, including supporting model version deprecation, preview evaluations, and rollout of replacement models for across projects.
Assist InfoSec and project teams with stale or toxic data and memory cleanup as the need arises.

Experience required
Primary Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher (min A- average for under-graduate, first class for post-graduate);
  • Experience deploying and operating LLM-based solutions in Azure or other major cloud providers.
  • Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol).
  • Familiarity with AI gateways, model routing, and model management platforms.
  • Experience implementing RAG solutions including vector databases, caching strategies, and retrieval pipelines.
  • Understanding of agent orchestration frameworks.
  • Knowledge of AI security and governance controls.
  • Experience implementing data residency and regulatory compliance requirements.
  • Experience building reusable platforms, developer self-service capabilities, and golden-path architectures.
  • Experience developing Terraform modules, providers, or reusable infrastructure frameworks.
  • Experience with HashiCorp Vault, Key Vault, or equivalent secret-management technologies.

Preferred Experience:
Microsoft Azure experience

Essential Technical Skills:

  • Terraform and Infrastructure-as-Code
  • Microsoft Azure (Preferred)
  • Azure AI Foundry (Preferred)
  • Kubernetes (Production Operations and Troubleshooting)
  • GitHub / GitHub Actions
  • Open Telemetry and Distributed Tracing
  • Monitoring and Logging Platforms
  • Azure Networking and Hybrid Connectivity (Preferred)
  • LLM, RAG and MCP

Your Opportunity

As a Java Software Engineer Intern, you’ll contribute to the design, development, testing, and maintenance of software applications and services. You’ll work with engineering teams to translate requirements into reliable, scalable solutions and gain exposure to the complete software development lifecycle.

You may contribute to applications supporting connected vehicles, cloud platforms, enterprise services, data processing, or other technology initiatives across GM.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop and enhance software applications using Java and object-oriented programming principles.
  • Collaborate with software engineers, architects, product managers, and business partners to understand requirements and deliver effective solutions.
  • Design, implement, and test RESTful APIs and backend services.
  • Write clean, readable, maintainable, and well-documented code.
  • Participate in code reviews and apply feedback to improve software quality.
  • Troubleshoot defects, investigate technical issues, and contribute to root-cause analysis.
  • Create unit and integration tests to validate application functionality and reliability.
  • Work with databases, data models, and SQL queries as part of application development.
  • Use Git and modern CI/CD practices to support efficient software delivery.
  • Contribute to Agile ceremonies, technical discussions, and sprint planning.
  • Learn and apply secure software development and DevSecOps practices.
  • Document technical decisions, solutions, and implementation details.
  • Support continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to simplify processes and reduce manual effort.

What You’ll Bring

  • Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Experience programming in Java through coursework, projects, internships, or personal development.
  • Understanding of object-oriented programming, data structures, algorithms, and software design fundamentals.
  • Familiarity with relational databases and basic SQL.
  • Knowledge of software development practices, debugging, and testing.
  • Familiarity with Git or another version-control system.
  • Interest in developing backend services, APIs, cloud applications, or enterprise software.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to break complex problems into manageable steps.
  • Ability to learn quickly, ask thoughtful questions, and take ownership of assigned work.
  • Collaborative approach and strong written and verbal communication skills.

Why Join GM?

This internship is more than an opportunity to write code. It’s a chance to build your professional network, learn from experienced engineers, contribute to meaningful projects, and discover how your skills can help shape the future of transportation.


Your journey starts here. Join General Motors and help create the technology that will move the world forward.


Hybrid

This role is categorized as hybrid. The successful candidate is expected to report to the assigned GM office three times per week, at minimum, or as dictated by business needs.







About GM

Our vision is a world with Zero Crashes, Zero Emissions and Zero Congestion and we embrace the responsibility to lead the change that will make our world better, safer and more equitable for all.

Why Join Us

We believe we all must make a choice every day – individually and collectively – to drive meaningful change through our words, our deeds and our culture. Every day, we want every employee to feel they belong to one General Motors team.

title: Service Operator
description:
7207 - Plano - 4448 W Plano Pkwy, Plano, Texas, 75093

CarMax, the way your career should be!

Position Overview

As a Service Operator, you will play a vital role in delivering exceptional customer service and ensuring smooth operations within our Service Department. From assisting customers in person and over the phone to supporting service processes before, during, and after repairs, you’ll be the friendly, knowledgeable point of contact that keeps everything running efficiently. This is your opportunity to join a best-in-class team at CarMax, where innovation, integrity, and putting people first are at the heart of everything we do.

Why CarMax

At CarMax, we are the nation’s largest retailer of used cars with stores from coast to coast, and we are still growing. We’re rethinking the way people buy cars – and our associates help us do just that. We believe work should feel meaningful and rewarding, with opportunities to make an impact every day. Whether you’re advancing your career or growing your skillset, we are here to drive you forward.

Role Responsibilities

  • Respond promptly and professionally to all incoming service calls, demonstrating empathy and a customer-first mindset
  • Assist Service Consultants and Customer Advisors with customer interactions as needed to ensure seamless service experiences
  • Schedule service appointments and provide accurate routing of calls and inquiries
  • Deliver timely written messages to the appropriate team members for follow-up
  • Manage repair requests by coordinating and scheduling appointments efficiently and perform reminder calls for upcoming appointments and contact customers when special-order parts arrive
  • Maintain compliance by auditing sublet invoices, loaner logs, and dealer tags according to CarMax guidelines
  • Follow CarMax Environmental, Health and Safety (EH&S) requirements and maintain a clean and orderly work area.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with proven ability to deliver outstanding customer service
  • Exceptional telephone etiquette and active listening abilities to ensure positive customer interactions

  • Proficiency in data entry and record-keeping, with intermediate computer skills including spreadsheets
  • Capability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, multitasking effectively while collaborating with cross-functional teams
  • Flexibility to work varied shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays, while maintaining professional appearance and integrity

About CarMax

At CarMax, we revolutionized the used car buying experience over 30 years ago by introducing transparency and integrity into the process. Our commitment to customer experience, innovation, and community has made us the nation’s largest used car retailer. With over 250 store locations and over 30,000 associates, we are proud to have been recognized as one of the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For® and are committed to helping our communities thrive.

As an associate, you are part of an innovative movement to empower the modern customer and drive progress. Your work fuels change—sparking ideas, overcoming challenges, and shaping what’s next. Join us in creating a better future– for our company, our customers, and the communities we call home.

CarMax is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

$15.50 - $24.40

Associates that are considered full-time hourly or commission/incentive eligible:

  • For 8 hours of pay for each of a total of 6 paid scheduled holidays per year plus 1 floating holiday. If such an Associate does work on a scheduled holiday due to business need, they are eligible for Holiday Premium Pay.

Associates considered full-time salaried are entitled to paid time away with no specified limit as needed for sick, vacation, bereavement, jury duty, holidays, floating holiday, etc. subject to manager approval.

title: Performance / Commercial Analyst
description:
The Hall & Kay way… it’s a people thing.

At Hall & Kay, we deliver complex fire protection and security solutions to protect what matters most to our clients. As technical experts our focus is on the lifetime value of a project. Meaning we can design, supply, install, test and maintain all types of sprinkler, gas suppression, fire detection, and integrated security systems. With 140+ year trading experience and a strong project delivery culture, we are proud to have built lasting relationships with some of the UK’s most respected companies in all areas of industry and construction.

Summary of Role

To analyse financial and operational data to provide actionable insights that drive business performance, optimise service delivery, and support strategic decision-making across the organisation. Bridge the gap between finance, operations, and business units to enhance profitability and operational efficiency.

What you will be doing

  • Prepare and analyse monthly, quarterly, and annual financial performance reports comparing actual results against budgets and forecasts. Identify variances, trends, and drivers of financial performance across service lines, business units, and geographic regions.
  • Monitoring of key financial metrics.
  • Analyse operational metrics such as service delivery efficiency, utilisation rates, productivity, quality indicators, and customer satisfaction scores.
  • Identify operational bottlenecks, inefficiencies, and opportunities for process improvement.
  • Conduct cost-benefit analyses for operational initiatives and improvement projects.
  • Track and report on operational KPIs, creating dashboards and scorecards for stakeholder visibility.
  • Collaborate with operations, service delivery, sales, and leadership teams to understand business challenges and opportunities.
  • Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations for non-financial stakeholders.
  • Support business case development for new services, contracts, investments, and strategic initiatives.
  • Provide analytical support during contract negotiations, pricing reviews, and client profitability assessments.
  • Maintain and enhance financial and operational reporting systems, dashboards, and data visualisation tools.
  • Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity across multiple sources and systems.
  • Automate routine reporting processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
  • Develop ad-hoc analyses in response to management requests and emerging business questions.
  • Identify opportunities to enhance analytical processes, reporting frameworks, and decision-making tools.
  • Recommend and implement improvements to financial and operational performance measurement.

What we will need from you

  • Professional qualifications in Accounting, Business, Economics, or related quantitative field (or progress toward them) preferred but not essential (depending on work related experience)
  • 3-5 years in financial analysis, management accounting, business analysis, or commercial finance role within a service organisation (essential).
  • Demonstrated track record of delivering impactful insights that influenced business decisions. Experience working with large datasets and reporting systems (essential).
  • Advanced Excel proficiency including pivot tables, complex formulas, and data modelling (essential).
  • Experience with business intelligence and visualisation tools (Power BI, Tableau, or similar) (essential).
  • SQL or database query skills (desirable).
  • Understanding of financial statements, management accounting principles, and cost analysis (essential).
  • Statistical analysis and forecasting techniques (essential).
  • Experience of working with Corrigo (desirable).
  • Strong problem-solving abilities with attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to synthesize complex data from multiple sources into coherent insights.
  • Commercial acumen to understand business drivers and operational realities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with ability to present complex information clearly.
  • Skilled at creating compelling presentations and visualizations for diverse audiences.
  • Ability to synthesize complex data from multiple sources into coherent insights and influence business change.
  • Understanding of service business models, cost structures, and value drivers.
  • Awareness of operational processes and service delivery metrics. Client and commercial mindset.
  • Collaborative team player who builds strong cross-functional relationships.
  • Adaptable and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with competing priorities. High integrity in handling confidential financial and operational information.

Reporting Relationships

This role will be Finance focused but will require close collaboration with Service Director, Service Managers, Commercial Managers, and other functional departments.

What you can expect in return

  • Competitive & negotiable salary depending on experience.
  • 25 days holiday plus bank holidays and option to buy 5 days
  • Contributory company pension scheme
  • Life Assurance
  • Health care scheme
  • Hours: 36.5 hours per week (Monday to Thursday 8.45 – 16.40, Friday 8.45 – 16:00)

description:

Facility Condition Assessment – Technical Director, Asset Services


JLL Real Estate Due Diligence (JREDD) – Asset Services

  • Serves as a senior leader within the Asset Services business of the JLL Real Estate Due Diligence (JREDD) division, providing strategic direction, national operational oversight, and executive-level client engagement for Facility Condition Assessment (FCA) in accordance with ASTM E2018, as well as Regulatory Compliance Audit (RCA) services.
  • Reports to and partners directly with the Global Leader of Asset Services to shape and execute the business strategy, drive sustainable revenue growth, and uphold the highest standards of technical and professional excellence across the Asset Services platform.
  • Provides enterprise-level leadership across technical operations, talent development, quality and risk management, and service innovation to advance JREDD’s position as the premier provider of real estate due diligence services.
  • Directs complex, multi-market client portfolios and serves as a key executive relationship owner, representing Asset Services in strategic business development pursuits, industry forums, and client-facing engagements.
  • Champions the development and continuous improvement of service delivery frameworks, technical standards, and operational processes to support scalable, high-quality FCA execution nationally.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Leads and oversees national production operations of the Asset Services – Facility Condition practice, including supporting accountability for revenue targets, gross profit margin, and overall financial health of the business line.
  • Exercises senior-level review authority over Facility Condition Assessment reports, ensuring alignment with JREDD quality standards, client-specific protocols, ASTM E2018, and applicable regulatory frameworks.
  • Establishes and cultivates executive-level client relationships across key accounts, proactively identifying opportunities to expand service scope, resolve escalated issues, and align delivery with clients; evolving portfolio objectives.
  • Collaborates with the Global Leader of Asset Services to define and implement the strategic vision for the business, including market expansion, service line innovation, and competitive positioning within the broader platform.
  • Provides support for executive oversight of project management staff nationally, ensuring consistent application of policies, technical standards, and operational procedures across all geographies and service engagements.
  • Serves as one of the division’s senior subject matter experts in areas including building systems and conditions, MEP, structural, building envelope, seismic risk, and ADA compliance in the context of Facility Condition Assessments.
  • Drives enterprise-level business development efforts, including leading pursuit strategies, responding to RFPs, and presenting JREDD Asset Services capabilities to JLL Integrated Facility Management (IFM) accounts, JLL Real Estate Management Services (REMS) verticals, institutional clients, and investment managers.
  • Leads the design, development, and governance of standardized service templates, scope frameworks, and field assessment tools to ensure scalable, repeatable delivery of FCA services.
  • Actively monitors industry trends, regulatory developments, and emerging best practices to inform service evolution and maintain Asset Service’s technical leadership position.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Provides senior leadership and formal supervision across multiple functional and operational teams within the Asset Services – Facility Condition practice.
  • Partners with the business leader to make final decisions regarding staff recruitment, selection, promotion, advancement, and corrective action for direct reports and their respective teams.
  • Establishes and monitors staffing strategies, workforce planning, and resource allocation to align with budgeted revenue goals and service delivery demands nationally.
  • Oversees performance management processes, including review cycles, development planning, and compensation recommendations for direct reports and their teams.
  • Serves as a senior mentor and coach to the Asset Services team members to build bench strength and cultivate future leaders within the business.
  • Models and reinforces leadership behaviors aligned with JLL’s values, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and professional excellence.

QUALIFICATIONS, EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor’s degree (BA/BS) in architecture, engineering, or a related technical discipline; advanced degree preferred.
  • Minimum 15 years of progressively responsible commercial building evaluation experience, including extensive application of ASTM E2018 and Facility Condition Assessment methodologies across diverse asset classes.
  • Minimum of 12 years of experience in client management, strategic account development, and leadership of multi-disciplinary technical service teams.
  • Minimum of five (5) years of senior leadership experience with direct management of multi-level teams and demonstrated accountability for business line financial performance.
  • Demonstrated track record of driving revenue growth, managing operational costs, and scaling technical service organizations in a national or multi-market context.
  • Expert-level knowledge of FCA scope requirements, and specialty applications including seismic, roofing, building envelope, conveyance, ADA, and MEP evaluations.

CERTIFICATES AND/OR LICENSES

  • Active licensure as a Professional Engineer (PE) or Registered Architect (RA) required.

COMMUNICATION SKILLS

  • Exceptional ability to comprehend, analyze, and interpret complex business and technical documents and translate findings into actionable strategic recommendations for executive and client audiences.
  • Distinguished written and verbal communication, interpersonal, and consultative skills, with the ability to represent JREDD and Asset Services at the highest levels of client and industry engagement.
  • Proven ability to navigate and resolve sensitive, high-stakes issues with clients, regulatory bodies, and internal leadership, demonstrating sound judgment and diplomatic effectiveness.
  • Accomplished presenter with experience delivering strategic briefings, technical content, and business case arguments to C-suite and board-level audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to inspire and influence clients, stakeholders, and team members to advance organizational objectives and service excellence.

FINANCIAL KNOWLEDGE

  • Advanced knowledge of financial terms, principles, and performance metrics. Demonstrated ability to develop business cases, interpret financial statements, and manage complex P&L responsibilities across a multi-team service organization.

REASONING ABILITY

  • Exceptional analytical and strategic problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesize complex data, competing priorities, and market intelligence to develop enterprise-level solutions. Exercises independent, expert judgment with broad impact on division performance and client outcomes.

OTHER SKILLS AND ABILITIES

  • Advanced proficiency in technology platforms and Microsoft Office Suite; familiarity with project management, data analytics, and reporting tools relevant to technical due diligence services.
  • Outstanding time management, organizational, and prioritization skills with demonstrated capacity to lead multiple high-value, concurrent engagements in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong negotiation skills with the ability to effectively engage and align key internal and external stakeholders around shared objectives.

SCOPE OF RESPONSIBILITY

  • Exercises broad, autonomous decision-making authority grounded in expert understanding of JREDD and Asset Services policies, technical standards, business practices, and market conditions to achieve division objectives and long-range strategic goals.
  • Responsible for setting and adjusting priorities, deadlines, and resource allocation across the Asset Services – Facility Condition practice at a national scale.
  • Errors in judgment may have significant short- to mid-term financial, reputational, or operational impact on the Asset Services business and the broader JREDD division.

  • Partner with Forward Deployed Engineering and Delivery on client deployments, quality, utilization, and the conversion of proven work into scalable offerings and client proof points.

  • Apply AI testing and governance standards before client use and ensure compliance, security, quality, and operational readiness across the portfolio.

  • Advise strategic pursuits on solution feasibility, differentiation, and delivery risk. GTM owns pursuit strategy and execution.

Cross-Functional and Client Leadership

  • Represent the portfolio with clients and senior stakeholders, adapting solutions based on market conditions, competition, deal dynamics, and executive feedback.
  • Work closely with Forward Deployed Engineering, Global Innovation & Architecture, AI Infrastructure & Hosting, the AI Practice, and scaled-delivery teams.

Team Leadership

  • Build and lead a high-performing global team of solution professionals, technologists, architects, and subject matter experts with strong technical depth and client-facing capability.
  • Coach the team in solution design, financial modeling, offering management, delivery quality, and executive client engagement.

title: Compounding (Mixing) Operator, 1st Shift
description:
Job Title:

Compounding (Mixing) Operator, 1st Shift

Summary:

The Custom Compounding Operator safely and efficiently performs mixing and milling operations using mechanical production equipment to prepare high-consistency silicone rubber in accordance with customer specifications, production instructions, quality standards, and safety requirements. The role operates multiple mixers, mills, and related equipment; accurately follows batch instructions; maintains production records; communicates relevant production information; and maintains a clean, safe, and organized work environment.

Responsibilities Include:

  • Follow all company safety, health, environmental, quality, and operating procedures.
  • Verify that required safety equipment is available and equipment guards and safety controls are properly positioned before beginning work.
  • Review batch cards, electronic production records, and work instructions to determine required materials, quantities, weights, temperatures, processing sequences, and other specifications.
  • Safely operate multiple mixers, mills, and related mechanical production equipment.
  • Measure, weigh, load, mix, mill, and process materials according to established instructions and customer specifications.
  • Monitor equipment and production processes and promptly communicate unsafe conditions, equipment problems, material concerns, production deviations, or quality issues.
  • Accurately complete and maintain batch records, production records, electronic entries, and other required documentation.
  • Follow established procedures for material identification, handling, processing, packaging, labeling, and finishing.
  • Perform required production and quality checks in accordance with applicable work instructions.
  • Maintain the assigned work area in a clean, safe, and orderly condition, including required housekeeping during shift transitions and following production runs.
  • Receive and communicate important production information with coworkers and supervisors during shift changes and throughout the workday.
  • Work collaboratively with production, quality, maintenance, warehouse, and other support employees to meet production requirements.
  • Participate in required safety, quality, equipment, and job-specific training.
  • Use required personal protective equipment and follow applicable material-handling and chemical-safety procedures.
  • Support continuous improvement activities related to safety, quality, housekeeping, productivity, and operational efficiency.
  • Perform other job-related duties as assigned.
  • Starting pay $22.80 with scheduled increases at 90 days, 6 months, and 1 year.


Qualifications:

The following are required for the role:

  • High school diploma or GED.
  • Ability to read and follow written production instructions, batch documentation, safety procedures, and work assignments.
  • Ability to perform basic arithmetic, including calculations involving quantities, weights, and measurements.
  • Ability to accurately complete written production records and required documentation.
  • Ability to communicate effectively regarding work assignments, production information, and operational or safety concerns.
  • Ability to communicate in the language used for safety instructions, production documentation, training, and emergency communications at the facility.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a manufacturing or production environment.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and adapt to changing production priorities.
  • Ability to safely operate manufacturing equipment after required training and qualification.
  • Ability to follow detailed operating procedures and quality requirements.
  • Ability and willingness to work the assigned shift, including required overtime, weekends, or holidays based on operational needs.
  • Ability to meet the physical requirements of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Ability to comply with required personal protective equipment (PPE) and applicable safety, quality, environmental, and workplace requirements.
  • Ability to satisfy applicable pre-employment requirements for drug test and background in accordance with company policy and applicable law.

The following are preferred for the role:

  • 1+ years of current experience in a manufacturing, production, warehouse, chemical processing, or similar industrial environment.
  • Experience operating mixers, mills, extrusion equipment, or other mechanical production equipment.
  • Experience following batch cards, work orders, formulas, recipes, or other detailed production instructions.
  • Experience completing batch records, production documentation, or electronic manufacturing records.
  • Experience measuring, weighing, mixing, or processing production materials.
  • Experience with material handling practices, manufacturing safety requirements, quality requirements, or manufacturing housekeeping standards.
  • Experience working in a team-based or shift-based production environment.
  • Experience with continuous improvement principles or practices.

What We Offer:

The base salary offered is determined by factors including but not limited to education, experience, skill sets, and geography. If you are interested in this position, we’d ask that you apply! #BePartoftheSolution

In this senior individual-contributor role you will establish interfaces and decision rights across engineering, asset operations, test execution, automation, virtual test, infrastructure, data, quality, and reliability while remaining close to implementation through architecture reviews, investigations, prototypes, and critical issue resolution.

  • Define and drive the target architecture and long-term roadmap for PVTP, spanning physical test, virtual test, automation, simulation, test assets, execution services, and platform operations.

title: Enterprise Application Administrator I
description:
Who we are:

As a global leader in digital infrastructure, QTS designs, builds and operates advanced data centers that support strategic AI, cloud and digital transformation initiatives. We are driven by a mission to connect the world for good and our people make it possible. Every single day, the creativity, dedication and genuine care for our communities are what push us forward and make this a truly special place to be.

The Enterprise Application Administrator I provides day-to-day ownership and operational support for the QTS long tail application portfolio: the standard SaaS and business applications that sit outside the Tier 1 enterprise platforms but still carry QTS identities, licenses, and business data. Working within Enterprise Technology, Enterprise Applications, this role onboards applications into central administration, configures and maintains them, and supports their users, so that every application has an accountable administrator, a known license position, and a secure, auditable access lifecycle. This is an entry-level administrator role that works from established Enterprise Applications standards and runbooks, under the direction of the Manager, Enterprise Applications. It protects daily operations by closing ownership gaps in the portfolio and gives the business a single, reliable point of support for the tools it depends on.

What You Will Do: (Job Responsibilities)

  • Onboard new and transferred long tail applications into central administration using the Enterprise Applications intake standard: confirm the business owner, record the application in the Enterprise Application Master Tracker, validate data classification and access model, and complete the administrator handover checklist.
  • Perform tenant administration for assigned SaaS applications: maintain administrator roles, security and authentication settings, tenant-level configuration, and integration settings to QTS standards, keeping administrative access least-privilege and documented.
  • Manage licenses for assigned applications: track entitlements, assignments, and utilization; reclaim unused or inactive licenses; and provide accurate license and usage data to the Software Asset Management function ahead of renewals.
  • Execute user provisioning and deprovisioning through ServiceNow requests and, where enabled, single sign-on (SSO) and SCIM provisioning through Microsoft Entra ID, partnering with Enterprise Identity and Data Protection; support periodic access reviews with accurate user and role data.
  • Plan, test, and implement configuration changes through the QTS change management process, including vendor-driven releases and feature changes; maintain configuration records so every change is traceable and repeatable.
  • Serve as the primary support point for assigned applications: resolve incidents and service requests within agreed service levels, troubleshoot access and configuration issues, escalate to vendors when required, and publish knowledge articles that enable Service Desk first-contact resolution.
  • Produce recurring reporting on application health, user access, license utilization, ticket volume, and upcoming renewals, and keep Master Tracker records (owner, administrator, SSO status, renewal date, cost) complete and current.
  • Coordinate with vendors as the day-to-day technical contact: open and track support cases, monitor release notes, maintenance windows, and roadmap changes, and provide operational input to renewal and contract discussions.
  • Monitor SSO certificates, application registration secrets, and integration credentials for assigned applications, and coordinate renewal before expiration to prevent sign-in or integration outages.
  • Create and maintain administrator runbooks, standard operating procedures, and application records so that support is transferable and no application depends on a single person.
  • Support internal and external audit and customer-assurance activities (e.g., SOC 2, ISO/IEC 27001, PCI DSS) by producing access listings, change records, and configuration evidence for assigned applications.
  • Support application retirement and consolidation: remove access, export or archive data per retention requirements, terminate licenses, and update portfolio records.


What You Will Need to Be Successful: (Required Qualifications, Education, Experience, Certifications)

· Education: Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in information technology, information systems, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

· Experience: 1 to 3 years of experience in IT support, application support, or SaaS administration within a business environment.

· SaaS administration: Hands-on experience administering at least one business SaaS application, including users, roles, permissions, and configuration settings.

· Identity fundamentals: Working knowledge of single sign-on (SAML, OpenID Connect), multifactor authentication, and the joiner, mover, and leaver user lifecycle; exposure to Microsoft Entra ID.

· Service management: Experience working in an ITSM ticketing tool (ServiceNow preferred), meeting service levels, and documenting resolutions.

· License administration: Experience tracking license assignments and utilization and identifying licenses to reclaim.

· Data and reporting: Proficiency with Microsoft Excel for tracking, reconciling, and reporting operational data.

· Controlled environment: Ability to work within change management, least-privilege access, and documentation requirements in an audited environment.

· Communication: Clear, customer-focused written and verbal communication with business users and vendors.

Nice to Have: (Preferred Qualifications, Education, Experience, Certifications)

· Experience in a data center, critical-infrastructure, hyperscale, colocation, or another high-availability operating environment.

· Experience within a private-equity-owned or high-growth organization, including comfort operating with pace, ambiguity, and evolving priorities.

· Experience configuring enterprise applications and SCIM provisioning in Microsoft Entra ID, and familiarity with a Microsoft-first environment (Microsoft 365, Entra, Intune) and ServiceNow-based workflow.

· Experience administering a broad portfolio of business SaaS platforms (e.g., collaboration, e-signature, project management, design, and line-of-business tools).

· Exposure to SaaS management or software asset management tooling and renewal processes.

· Basic scripting or automation skills (e.g., PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, Power Automate) to reduce repetitive administration tasks.

· Experience building operational reports or dashboards in Power BI.

· Experience supporting SOC 2, ISO/IEC 27001, PCI DSS, or SOX ITGC audit evidence requests.

· Relevant credential(s) such as ITIL 4 Foundation; CompTIA A+, Network+, or Security+; Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC-300) or Microsoft 365 Fundamentals; or vendor administrator certifications (e.g., ServiceNow Certified System Administrator).


TOTAL REWARDS

This role is also eligible for a competitive beneﬁts package that includes: medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; 401(k) retirement plan; ﬂexible spending and HSA accounts; paid holidays; paid time off; paid volunteer days; employee assistance program; tuition assistance; parental leave; military leave assistance; QTS scholarship for dependents; wellness program, and other company beneﬁts.

This position is Bonus eligible.

In addition to a variety of benefit packages, QTS goes above and beyond for our employees:

title: Regional Head of Communications, AMEA
description:
As Regional Head of Communications for Svitzer AMEA (Asia, Middle East and Africa), you will lead the development and delivery of the region's communications, public affairs and stakeholder engagement strategy. As Regional Head of Communications for Svitzer AMEA (Asia, Middle East, and Africa), you will lead the development and delivery of the region's communications, public affairs and stakeholder engagement strategy. Working closely with the Managing Director, Regional Leadership Team and Global Communications function, you will play a pivotal role in shaping how Svitzer communicates, engages and connects with its people, customers, media, governments and industry stakeholders.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to drive strategic communications aligned with the business goals of Svitzer and the AMEA region and global brand positioning, providing high-level advice to senior leaders and managing critical reputation, engagement, and brand visibility work. Operating at both strategic and operational levels, the role is accountable for internal communications; media relations; crisis communications; public, government and industry affairs; marketing communications; event management, and digital and social media for the Region.

You will be responsible for strengthening Svitzer's regional reputation and brand presence, driving employee engagement, supporting commercial growth and ensuring clear, consistent and impactful communications across the region.


Who we are

Svitzer is a global leader in towage services, aiding our customers in safely and efficiently manoeuvring their large vessels in and out of ports worldwide. The way we do business is governed by our values: Constant Care, Humbleness, Uprightness, Our Employees, Our Name.

Founded in 1833, Svitzer builds on almost 200 years of experience, and our powerful tugboats and experts in towage work tirelessly to keep goods flowing, businesses thriving, and communities connected. Today, Svitzer is a leading global port and terminal infrastructure provider, serving approximately 2,000 customers in 143 ports and 40 terminals across 37 countries through a fleet of 446 vessels. Most of our business is to support container vessels, cargo ships, cruise ships and navy vessels but we also attend to emergencies like vessels being adrift or offshore fires. And we have started exploring new digital and green products and partnerships in an exciting journey, leading the way for towage to generate a cleaner, greener future for our industry.


What you can look forward to

You will have the opportunity to work closely with senior leadership, influencing regional business priorities, organisational direction and corporate reputation across the diverse AMEA region. You will shape Svitzer's brand positioning and industry voice, while bringing our strategic priorities around growth, safety, decarbonisation and people leadership to life through impactful communications. Working in close partnership with the Global Communications team, you will connect regional initiatives with global strategy while ensuring local relevance. This is an opportunity to make a tangible impact on how our people connect with the business, how customers experience our brand and how key external stakeholders perceive Svitzer.


What you will do:

You will lead an integrated communications agenda that connects our people, strengthens our brand and supports our business ambitions. From advising senior leaders and shaping strategic narratives to engaging employees and managing external stakeholders, you will operate across the full spectrum of corporate communications.

As a senior leader, you will play a critical role in building organisational alignment around Svitzer AMEA's strategic and cultural priorities, including culture transformation, decarbonisation, growth, safety, and people leadership.

You will bring together internal and external communications, media relations, public affairs, marketing communications, digital and social media, events and crisis communications into a cohesive regional approach.

Working in close partnership with country and operational leaders, you will ensure that communications are relevant, impactful and accessible to our diverse workforce, including colleagues working in frontline and operational environments.


Your main responsibilities will be:


- Strategic Communications: Develop and execute the regional communications and public affairs strategy, providing trusted advice to the Managing Director and Regional Leadership Team on business priorities, reputation and organisational change. Represent Communications at leadership forums and planning sessions

- Internal Communications & Engagement: Lead the regional communications rhythm through leadership updates, town halls, employee campaigns and digital channels, fostering transparency, alignment, recognition and employee engagement. Support and coach frontline leaders on communication effectiveness as part of culture activation and wider leadership skillset development. Champion peer-led storytelling and local engagement initiatives to foster a culture of recognition, safety, and fairness – and deliver on our communications principles including staying true to our maritime roots.

- External & Commercial Communications: Strengthen Svitzer's market positioning and reputation through media relations, Develop messaging frameworks, media releases, statements, and briefings, Support Commercial team with market entry communications and marketing support, positioning, tactics and materials. Identify thought leadership and influence opportunities through events, sponsorships, award submissions, memberships and speaking opportunities etc. Deliver cultural and community engagement moments in collaboration with Regional People & Culture team.

- Public Affairs & Stakeholder Engagement: Build and strengthen relationships with government authorities, regulators, industry associations and other key stakeholders, supporting Svitzer's advocacy and industry positioning. Work with AMEA Regional Leadership Team and other key SMEs on public affairs engagement and advocacy activity.

- Brand, Digital & Social Media: Oversee social media planning, campaigns, content, analytics for Region, collaborate with global colleagues on content syndication and brand consistency, contribute to key digital platforms such as website, and social platforms alongside accompanying content calendars

- Issues & Crisis Communications: Serve as a key member of the crisis response team.

Develop and maintain media holding statements, stakeholder advisory and scenario-based messaging.

- Leadership & Collaboration: Partner with Regional People & Culture, Commercial and operational teams to bring business priorities and cultural initiatives to life. Manage external agencies and communication partners, ensuring effective delivery and impact.

Who we are looking for:

We are looking for a candidate who:

  • Qualifications in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, or related field
  • Minimum 12 years' experience in senior communications and/or public affairs, including B2B and/or regulated industries experience
  • Experience advising senior executives and working in matrixed, global organisations
  • Proven success in developing and delivering integrated communications strategies
  • Experience with media, crisis response, social media, and stakeholder engagement
  • Familiarity with maritime, logistics, transport, oil and gas, mining or industrial sectors preferred
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong political and issues radar and business acumen
  • Ability to think both strategically and tactically
  • Resilient, agile and able to thrive in high-pressure and ambiguous environments
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to influence and engage senior stakeholders
  • Proven leadership and team development capability
  • Deep understanding of brand and reputation management
  • Experience in delivering multi-channel internal communications programs including mobile, desktop, and digital signage platforms
  • Understanding of or exposure to industrial relations and change communications in operational environments
  • Demonstrated ability to support culture change and DEI initiatives through communications

Building a Diverse Workplace

In Svitzer we value the diversity of our talent and will always strive to recruit the best person for the job – we value diversity in all its forms, including but not limited to gender, age, nationality, race, sexual orientation, disability, or religious beliefs. We are proud of our diversity and see it as a genuine source of strength for building high performing teams.

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that members from some under-represented groups are less likely to apply for jobs if they don’t meet every single qualification. At Svitzer we are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles, and we are excited about hearing from you!

How to Apply

To apply for this role, please click on the 'Apply Now' button and create a Candidate Home to manage your applications.

title: Product Line Manager
description:
Nordson Test & Inspection, a global leader in world-class metrology equipment and inspection systems, is seeking a highly motivated and talented Product Line Manager Automated X-Ray Metrology to join our team in Aylesbury, United Kingdom. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we are looking for candidates who share that same commitment.


Summary of the role

As Product Line Manager, you will manage the product lifecycle to ensure that it meets the requirements of customers, conduct Voice of Customer activities with key global customers in our focus markets, and set the development of the product roadmap. You will create the product development strategy and work with multiple teams involved in the process to deliver a product that will satisfy the customer base. You will work with other department heads such as the Sales teams, Applications Engineering, Customer Service Representatives, Development Engineering and Operations. You will establish the key features of a product and use market trends and customer buying habits data to create specifications and prototypes. You will also develop strategies for positioning and pricing products, as well as the strategy for end-of-life and simplification.


You will be responsible for setting the direction, leading and managing the Product Line globally to maximise sales revenue and profitability, in alignment with the financial and strategic plans for the Test & Inspection business. As a key member of the cross-functional Product Line team, you will drive excellence in all aspects of the business through implementation and application of the Nordson NBS Next and ASCEND strategies.


You will have the opportunity to work in a dynamic and collaborative environment, where your ideas and contributions will be valued and respected.


Role and Responsibilities

Product Line Roadmap

  • Assume ownership of the Product Roadmap for the Automatic X-Ray Semiconductor Metrology Product Line, with market input from customers, Sales and Applications, technical input from Engineering, and manufacturability input from Operations.
  • In close collaboration with the Regional Sales teams, and backed up with market intelligence, develop a product and feature roadmap which meets future customer needs and delivers revenue growth through the development of Top New Products.
  • In close collaboration with the Engineering team, specify the product requirements for development, adjusting and refining them as needed in line with market requirements, and identify and incorporate new technology innovations into long-term Product Roadmaps.
  • In close collaboration with the Operations Director and team, identify and mitigate risks related to manufacturing, sourcing and quality for the roll-out of Top New Products on the Product Roadmap.
  • Manage and communicate relevant market intelligence, ideas, competitive activity and other relevant information to Engineering, Regional Sales, Service and Applications teams. Using input from the Regional Sales teams, identify competitor products and systems that should be benchmarked against our own products to help identify how we differentiate against them.
  • Together with the Regional Service Managers for service and spares, manage the product lifecycle to maximise aftermarket revenue, while ensuring the ongoing rationalisation and simplification of the product portfolio.

Strategic Product Marketing Contribution

  • Support the Business Development Director in creating annual and strategic marketing plans which are suitable for the Product Line, and develop and present business proposals for emerging markets and applications for Test & Inspection products.
  • Develop collateral and content for Regional Sales teams, such as sales presentations, brochures, application notes, specification data sheets, web information and other promotional activities, either individually or with the Marketing team.
  • Support product training for Regional Sales teams, internal staff and representatives.

Product Line Commercials

  • Assume commercial responsibility for the Product Line, and specifically Top New Products revenue and gross margin.
  • On an annual basis, support the development of our five-year strategic plan, identifying market and business opportunities and strategic direction for the Product Line with regard to Product Innovation.
  • Define the price lists for the Product Line, regularly reviewing and optimising them in line with the Gross Margin commitments for the business. Ensure that pricing is optimised regionally and all price lists are current and accurate at all times.
  • Where appropriate, work with the other Product Line Managers to maximise sales opportunities across all product lines, and support the service and spares organisation in ensuring that revenues are maximised.
  • Provide accurate monthly and quarterly forecasts for the Product Line, and specifically Top New Products.

Skills and Qualifications

  • Professional engineering and/or business qualifications; Master’s and/or PhD degree preferred.
  • A technical background, preferably in electronics, and experience or knowledge of the semiconductor, electronics or capital-equipment market.
  • Strong business development and product management experience, including strategic ownership of product roadmaps.
  • A breadth of business and technical knowledge covering engineering, including technology innovation, product specification, system architecture and product development, combined with commercial understanding.
  • Experience applying Voice of Customer methodologies to identify unmet customer requirements and translate them into product strategy, requirements and roadmaps.
  • Experience with new product development and Stage-Gate or equivalent launch processes, together with the ability to develop business cases and apply financial and commercial judgement.
  • Excellent influencing and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage a range of cross-functional stakeholders and create alignment without direct authority.

Travel

Travel 30–40% to trade shows, key accounts, and other relevant Test & Inspection sites both in the UK and overseas.


Benefits

We offer a flexible work schedule, a comprehensive benefits package, and opportunities for growth and development. Our benefits do further include:

  • Employee Incentive Plan
  • Pension scheme
  • Possibility to join our Healthcare scheme Aviva, including optical and dental support
  • 25 vacation days
  • Free parking

About Nordson Test & Inspection

Nordson Test & Inspection manufactures world-class metrology equipment and inspection systems to ensure electronic products are built to meet the highest standards. We use X-ray inspection, acoustic imaging, and optical inspection technologies to create testing systems that enable the identification of even the smallest defects at high resolution. By joining our team today, you will help us bring innovative ideas to life.


Nordson Test & Inspection is a global team that works to create machines and systems that improve the manufacturing process for a wide range of industries, including electronics, aerospace, automotive, energy, lighting, and medical. We offer a supportive culture in a growing and dynamic work environment. Whether you're just beginning your career or you're a seasoned professional, there's a place for you to belong at Nordson Test & Inspection. We offer hourly and salary positions in production, maintenance, customer service, quality, engineering, and more. We actively invest in our teams to help you build your skillsets and advance your career.


Our recruitment process is designed to identify the best qualified candidates for the role, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and equitable interview process. We are looking for candidates who have a passion for inclusion, diversity and equity, and the ability to contribute to a culture where all employees feel valued, respected, and included.

title: Senior Manager, Enterprise Risk Management - Adherence Monitoring
description:
Senior Manager, Enterprise Risk Management - Adherence Monitoring

Do you want to be part of an organization that’s dedicated to helping Capital One meet its most critical Risk Framework standards – for our customers, our communities and our associates? As part of Enterprise Risk Management (ERM), you’ll work with talented associates to drive teams and technologies across the company to meet our rigorous standards around risks, controls, issues, events, and risk assessments. This includes enabling our organizations to maintain accurate and complete risk statements, controls and all elements of the Capital One risk management framework. You’ll also bring your unique perspective and experiences to help us be rigorous, curious and creative.


Enterprise Risk Management is the center of risk management for our company and covers all categories of risk, governing policies and standards, risk assessments, and issue and event management. The Adherence Monitoring team within ERM is focused on developing tools and monitoring of all of our risk management processes to ensure our company effectively manages business objectives and satisfies regulatory requirements.


We are seeking a dedicated, disciplined, and innovative process professional who excels in a team environment. This individual will have experience in risk management, improving processes, identifying with the perspective of our customers, and being able to connect the regulatory environment to processes. This individual must be able to effectively communicate and influence partners across the company and across multiple levels of the organization. Strong problem solving and analytical skills, attention to detail, process/project management capability, and results driven are essential to succeeding in this role. This individual should feel comfortable working with quantitative and qualitative information and can move from the “gray” area to grounded recommendations in an organized and transparent manner.

Specific responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:

  • Collaborate with the team to drive formal adherence monitoring program across all lines of businesses and Capital One risk categories
  • Play a key role in contributing to the effective design, delivery and sustainability of our risk management framework
  • Drive strategic risk management initiatives by aligning risk imperative work with ERM objectives
  • Execute ad-hoc analysis on risk topics related to changes in Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) Policy Standards and Procedures (PSPs)
  • Collaborate with our stakeholder community (e.g. risk managers, risk leads, Independent Risk Management groups, business risk offices, front line process owners) to mature our risk management practices
  • Leverage data and analytics to manage risk and proactively identify and report on risks and trends
  • Actively support internal and external audits and exams
  • Stay abreast of the changing regulatory environment and understand the applicability and impacts to Capital One
  • Collaborate effectively across multiple levels and organizations


Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or military experience
  • At least 4 years of Financial Services experience
  • At least 6 years of Risk Management experience
  • At least 2 years of People Management experience

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Masters Degree
  • 7+ years of Financial Services risk management experience
  • 7+ years of experience in Project or Process Management
  • 5+ years of internal strategy or management consulting experience leading cross functional financial services projects and programs
  • 5+ years of people management experience
