title: Territory Coverage Associate
description:
Job Description

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Are you ready to make it happen at Mondelēz International?

As a Territory Coverage Associate, you convert staffing gaps into reliable, high-quality execution. You provide hands on support to Merchandisers and Order Writers, maintain operational consistency, uphold brand, execution standards, and ensure stores stays aligned with company expectations. Become an ambassador of world-famous brands like Oreo, Ritz, belVita, Chips Ahoy, Triscuit among other delicious industry-leading snacks.

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Represent Mondelēz: in stores with professionalism, reliability, and a commitment to execution excellence as you support Merchandisers and Order Writers across the territory.​
  • Serve as a trusted field partner: delivering strong customer service to store teams while reinforcing Mondelēz’s standards and expectations.​
  • Execute daily coverage: completing store visits using Merchandising Excellence standards, Order Writing Excellence, including capturing display photos and documenting execution through DMI & Sales force.​
  • Implement promotional displays: ensuring compliance with RTM‑negotiated plans and maintaining strong visibility of our brands.​
  • Follow assigned schedules: executing daily priorities set by your District Manager (DM) or RTM to ensure efficient and effective territory coverage.​
  • Assist with seasonal transitions: supporting new product launches, seasonal merchandising, and high‑visibility promotional events.​
  • Build and maintain relationships: partnering with store personnel—including receivers, department managers, and store leadership—to support smooth execution and collaboration.​
  • Support capability building: reinforcing foundational skills and assisting with the onboarding of new Merchandisers and Order Writers to strengthen field capability.​
  • Develop for future leadership: building the operational, communication, and problem‑solving skills that serve as a strong foundation for future advancement into management roles.​
  • Stay Safe and Compliant: Embrace the physical nature of the role—including lifting, bending, and moving product—while following all safety protocols, operational guidelines, and company vehicle policies to ensure safe and responsible driving across the territory.

Key Competencies Required:

  • Coverage and Execution Excellence– Skilled in stepping into Merchandiser and Order Writer roles to maintain consistent shelf standards, product rotation, and display execution across the territory.
  • Customer Service Mindset – Friendly, approachable, and committed to creating a positive experience for store teams and shoppers.
  • Digital Readiness – Confident using mobile tools and applications to follow schedules, document execution, capture display photos, and complete coverage tasks accurately.
  • Adaptability and Initiative – Flexible and proactive in responding to coverage needs, seasonal priorities, and unexpected store challenges with a solutions-oriented mindset.
  • Time and Task Management – Organized and efficient in completing store visits, managing coverage assignments, and maintaining consistent execution across multiple locations.
  • Physical Readiness – Energetic and capable of lifting, bending, and moving product throughout the day with pride and purpose.
  • Capability Support– Confident reinforcing foundational skills and supporting the onboarding of new Merchandisers and Order Writers to strengthen field capability.

  • Be at least 18 years of age and have a valid driver's license issued by the state in which the person resides.
  • High School Diploma or GED required; college degree preferred.
  • 1-3 years of experience in retail or consumer goods preferred.
  • Live inside the geographical boundaries of the team.
  • Flexible Schedule availability required including weekends.
  • Ability to travel across assigned markets.
  • Ability to perform physical activities (frequent lifting, bending, and carrying up to 25 lbs., occasionally over 50 lbs., pushing, pulling, etc.).
  • Mondelez International also offers a company vehicle, which includes a gas card and vehicle maintenance program.

title: General Manager
description:
The General manager is designed for a proven hospitality leader who wants full ownership of a restaurant’s performance — from guest experience to financial results. This is a high-impact leadership position within a growing restaurant group, offering the opportunity to build strong teams, drive operational excellence, and play a key role in the long-term success and growth of the business.


The General Manager is the senior leader responsible for overseeing all aspects of restaurant operations, including service execution, culinary and beverage standards, cleanliness, safety, and brand presentation. This role leads and develops the management team and hourly staff to ensure consistent, high-quality execution across every shift.

The General Manager maintains full accountability for labor management, cost controls, inventory systems, reporting, and compliance, while partnering closely with the Director of Operations and culinary leadership to drive performance, support marketing and business development initiatives, and ensure operational systems function effectively at all times.


Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Operations

  • Lead, coach, and develop the operations and culinary leadership teams to ensure consistent execution of standards.
  • Ensure all venue management processes and systems are established, followed, and executed daily.
  • Maintain full compliance with all state and federal regulatory requirements, health codes, and safety standards.
  • Ensure all managers are properly trained, informed, and up to date on policies, procedures, and operational expectations.
  • Complete all administrative responsibilities accurately and on time, as assigned by the Director of Operations.
  • Ensure reservation and guest management systems (including OpenTable and related platforms) are properly configured and fully operational.
  • Oversee timely reporting and resolution of all maintenance and facility issues.

Guest Experience & Brand Standards

  • Uphold and reinforce hospitality-driven service standards across all departments.
  • Ensure every guest is attended to and treated with professionalism, warmth, and respect.
  • Maintain consistency, accuracy, and integrity in the presentation of all food and beverage menu items.
  • Collaborate with leadership to develop and refine service standards, menus, and guest engagement initiatives.
  • Ensure the venue consistently meets brand standards and is maintained in “mint condition” at all times.

Financial Performance & Business Development

  • Participate in weekly marketing and business development meetings to support revenue growth and brand awareness.
  • Establish and maintain proper par levels and inventory management systems, including active tracking and controls.
  • Maintain full P&L responsibility, including reporting, analysis, and corrective action planning.
  • Ensure tips are handled, distributed, and managed in compliance with company policies and applicable regulations.

title: Intelligent Service Account Engineer
description:
Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient climate solutions for buildings, homes and transportation, it's our responsibility to put the planet first. For us at Trane Technologies, and through our businesses including Trane® and Thermo King, sustainability is not just how we do business—it is our business. Do you dare to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities? Do you want to contribute to making a better future? If the answer is yes, we invite you to consider joining us in boldly challenging what's possible for a sustainable world.

Learn about our benefits designed for you to Thrive at work and at home.

We boldly go.

Where is the work:

Monday to Thursday, work onsite with your colleagues. Fridays, choose your work location, balancing what your work requires.

What's in it for you:

The Intelligent Services Account Engineer has the deep technical expertise of an Optimization / Energy Engineer and the interpersonal skills of an Account Manager. He or she is an expert at converting data into actionable insight and utilizing that data to deliver results for the client becoming a trusted advisor. Duties include routine on-going consultative services that help our clients continuously optimize their facilities and fulfill their mission more efficiently. Routine consultations provide insights into the client’s energy use, building operations, technical support/training needs, indoor environmental quality, asset management, and anything else that provides value to the client. Beyond the development and delivery of consultation reports, the Intelligent Services Account Engineer is responsible for energy project development, retro-commissioning, design assistance, walkthroughs, and continuously assisting the sales teams with securing a larger share of assigned clients’ business, earning them as customers for life. Success in this role is measured by assigned accounts’ energy reductions delivered to clients, and the amount of pull-through business delivered to Trane.

What you will do:


Key Result: Intelligent Services Consultation Development and Delivery

Key Actions:

  • Facilitate the development and delivery of Intelligent Services consultation reports in a timely and professional manner
  • Research facilities energy usage and provides interpretation of utility bills to clients
  • Monitors and analyzes energy consumption and costs; develops recommendations for facility improvements, energy consumption, and conservation including performance against standards and benchmarks
  • Monitors assigned contract hours with the goal of maintaining and improving contract margins, reaching applied time goals, and exceeding contractual obligations and customer expectations

Key Result: Sales Support

Key Actions:

  • Maintains position as the customer’s most trusted advisor
  • Actively participates in strategic account planning and leader to leader meetings
  • Presents compelling technical business case presentations for comprehensive projects as required
  • Leads sales process when appropriate
  • Generates numerous leads for assigned accounts, especially Energy Services and Controls
  • Helps the sales team to quality and quickly close or abandon opportunities
  • Fully understands Trane’s energy solutions and is able to present products and solutions depending on customer business
  • Clearly understands and communicates Trane’s comprehensive suite of offerings from time and material to paid for through savings comprehensive solutions projects
  • Support sales team in the acquisition of new Intelligent Services clients
  • Participate in high level walkthroughs and facility assessments

Key Result: Engineering / Project Development

Key Actions:

  • Leads the technical analysis of facilities and their usage to determine creative solutions and savings opportunities
  • Identifies, develops, estimates, and proposes Energy Conservation Measures (ECMs)
  • Leads concept development associated with various engineering projects
  • Conducts field survey work as needed to assess new opportunities and develop various projects
  • Coordinate technical solutions with external partners as needed
  • Assists with initial opportunity assessments for guaranteed energy savings projects, when needed

What you will bring:

  • 5-7 years experience, preferred
  • Design and application knowledge of facility HVAC, control, lighting and electrical systems
  • Four year electrical or Mechanical Engineering / Design degree, preferred
  • Certified Energy Manager, preferred
  • Experience with building automation and control systems strongly preferred
  • Must have strong communication skills and ability to work with internal and external teams
  • Must have strong business acumen skills and able to provide financial analysis to customer
  • Must have a good understanding of technical proficiencies required to deliver solutions
  • Must have the aptitude to learn new industry related material/practices for continued growth


Physical Requirements:

  • The majority of a regular workday requires sitting.
  • Frequent standing and walking.
  • Excellent speaking, hearing as well as good vision.
  • May be required to climb ladders, carry/ lift 10lbs.

Working Conditions:

  • This position works in a typical office environment in a hybrid role where the successful candidate can “flex for their day” when needed, work fully remote two days a week, and often travels within the region (minimal overnights, approximately 4 times a year) to meet with clients on assigned accounts.
  • Various customer facilities, spending time in Mechanical / Equipment rooms, surveying rooftop equipment and so on.

Other Job Requirements:

  • Valid driver’s license
  • Provide proof of personnel auto insurance
  • Must have reliable personnel vehicle
  • Flexibility to work overtime / weekends as required

Personal Characteristics:

  • Facility Solutions Background & Perspective
  • HVAC, Lighting, Controls, Building Envelope, Construction
  • Strong numerical skills
    • Problem resolution skills
    • Organization, reasoning and strong analytical skills
    • Inter-personal and Sales
  • Highly assertive
  • Ability to work independently as well as in a team environment
    • Diplomacy in managing relationships
    • Ability to lead in a team environment
    • Excellent oral and written communication skills
    • Effectively meet the needs of internal and external customers
  • Executive Presentation Skills
  • Business & Management
  • Financial Selling, Contracts, High-Level Owner
  • Process Oriented, Team Oriented
  • General Attributes
  • Impeccable Business Ethics, Professional image, Exceptional Organizational Skills, Innovative, Customer Focused, Good Business Judgment
